After the battle, make sure to check the throne room ahead and go to the west side, head to the lower section and you'll immediately see a spirit NPC that looks like it's praying. Approach it and you can find an item next to it, pick it up to obtain x1 Shabriri Grape. If you turn back, you'll see a passage that goes outside, formally arriving at Liurnia of the Lakes. If you return to the Roundtable Hold, you'll find Nepheli Loux, the warrior who helped you in fighting Godrick, at the northeast side, by the library. Don't forget to speak to her so that she can give you x1 Arsenal Charm.

Now, if you want to use Godrick's Great Rune, you will need to fast travel to the Limgrave Tower Bridge site at Stormveil Castle. Work your way through the reanimated Colossal Statues, interact with the waygate portal and continue forward to reach the Divine Tower of Limgrave. Continue to the top until you reach the peak where you'll find a glowing sigil at the center. Approach and interact with it to restore the power of the great rune. Godrick's Great Rune blesses the player's character by raising all attributes.

title: Divine Tower of Limgrave
text: This is the location where you can restore Godrick's Great Rune to full strength and have it grant you its power. To reach the location, take the long bridge east of Stormveil Castle from the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace. Many players won't have this Site of Grace initially, as it requires you to have navigated the ballistae gauntlet from Stormveil Main Gate or from having navigated most of Stormveil Castle and approaching from the opposite direction.
Some tips, if coming from the Stormveil Main Gate Site of Grace:
Summoning just as you enter the area is helpful, as it will provide additional targets for the ballistae
Run forward about 50 yards until there is an opening to the right
Sprint for the large open arch, but beware: a tough enemy will try to stop you
Once through, the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace is a short sprint away!

You can loot the Boltdrake Talisman from a body ascending the stairs toward the tower. This leads to a long Stormhill bridge covered with Giant Golems. You can choose to fight them or run through them. Killing the Giant Archers will give you a chance to gain the Golem Greatbow. Before using the waygate, you can safely drop down behind the ledge to find a Soft Cotton and the Ash-of-War Scarab helm.

Interact with the waygate at the end of the bridge to reach the other side. This will take you to the front steps of the Divine Tower of Limgrave. Step to the center to activate the lift. Continue forward, and there will be another Site of Grace. Continue heading up the stairs and you'll eventually reach a site where you can restore the power of the Great Rune. This is only available after defeating Godrick the Grafted at Stormveil Castle. You will then obtain Godrick's Great Rune. You must have defeated Godrick; otherwise, the gate of the tower will be locked.

place.title: Divine Tower of Limgrave
notes: Notes and Tips for the Divine Tower of Limgrave Location in Elden Ring go here.
There is a Two Fingers on a mound of earth at the top of this tower, in the centre of eight meteorite fragments.

The door entering this divine tower faces east-northeast, and the entrance to the top faces north-northwest, an angle of ninety degrees from entering the tower. The tower is covered with what appears to be molten rock on its north face.

title: The Student of Raya Lucaria Academy
text: ## Liurnia of the Lakes: South
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (South) Points of Interest
Speak to some NPCs.
Clear out Malefactor's Evergaol.
Acquire some Important Items as you explore.
Find Patches and collect upgrade items for your Flasks.
Acquire the Academy Glintstone Key and explore Raya Lucaria Academy.
Optional: Fight the dragon, Glintstone Dragon Smarag.
Explore the Lakeside Crystal Cave
## Speak to Boc the Seamster

Congratulations! You've completed the first of many Legacy Dungeons in Elden Ring, and you've beaten the first Demigod, Godrick the Grafted. If you were following our walkthrough for Stormveil Castle, you should formally arrive in Liurnia of the Lakes from the throne room of Godrick the Grafted. As soon as you enter the new region, you'll find the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace, examine it to discover the checkpoint, and if you were also following the walkthrough and have encountered Boc twice, you should find him here kneeling by the Lake-Facing Site of Grace, a cliff above to the entrance to Stillwater Cave. Make sure to talk to him and he'll offer to alter your armor. If he's not there when you first find the grace just rest.
## The Wandering Maiden

You can also find Hyetta's initial location, found near the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace. But for her to show up, you must complete Irina's questline in the Weeping Peninsula, which is to deliver a letter to her father, Edgar who is at Castle Morne. Hyetta is initially found next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace. Hyetta says she roams The Lands Between in search of the distant light, drawn to her destiny by a guiding shine she feels in the back of her eyes when eating Shabriri Grapes. She will ask for one and if you choose to supply one to her, she will reward you with the As You Wish Gesture.
## The Student of Raya Lucaria Academy

Next, if you move towards the southwest, you should find the Church of Irith, it's easy to find and you'll meet a new NPC here named Thops, he is a student at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. You can find him sitting on a bench inside the destroyed church. By the statue, don't forget to grab the Sacred Tear material for your flask. As for Thops, if you speak to him, you can learn some spells from him in exchange for Runes. First, you must donate 10 Runes, and then you can learn some Sorcery spells from him.

These are just basic spells, but if you are not playing as an Astrologer and if you need to but the basic sorcery like Glintstone Pebble, then you can learn it from Thops for 1000 Runes. Eventually, if you speak to him again, he will share that he wishes to return to the academy, this means you will need to find a second Academy Glintstone Key for him later on which can be found in the academy. This church has a graveyard section, you may want to check it to find some Warming Stone, an Academy Scroll. just be cautious since there are Skeleton enemies there.

title: Church of Irith
text: Church of Irith is one of the first locations you can visit once you enter Liurnia of the Lakes after completing Stormveil Castle (or using the alternate route into Liurnia). Of note in this church are the Sacred Tear in front of the Statue of Marika and the NPC Thops sitting on a bench at the side. Thops will sell you some low-level sorcery spells after donating 10 Runes to him. You can also speak to him about an Academy Glintstone Key and he will mention wanting to return to the academy. When you've obtained two such keys, you can donate one to Thops and he will move to the Raya Lucaria Academy. If you return to the church after Thops leaves, there will be a Teardrop Scarab where he used to sit. Killing it awards the Ash of War: Thops's Barrier. If it does not drop the Ash of War, double check that you do not have this specific item already.

title: Malefactor's Evergaol
text: Near the Church of Irith and the Lake-Facing Cliffs site, you can go northwest from the map to find the Malefactor's Evergaol. There is a mini-boss here, Adan, Thief of Fire who drops the Flame of the Fell God incantation spell and you can also find the Sacrificial Twig that can be found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.

Unlike most evergaols, this one does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock. The transporter mechanism is active as soon as you reach the area. Enter the portal to challenge the boss imprisoned within Adan, Thief of Fire. Adan is a very straightforward fight. Despite his stout stature, he is quite agile and capable of quick dodge rolls. His main form of attack is his Flame of the Fell God spell, where he summons a large orb of fire that explodes after a short delay, dealing damage in a large radius and setting the area ablaze.

This attack is easy enough to avoid due to the clear telegraph and slow animation. He will also use a combo of multiple swings with his flail, ending in a spinning attack. This move has a long animation and can easily be exploited by ranged players.
## Exploring the South Section

If you want to find a new set of Armor, you can find the Sage Set in the nearby cave of the Lake-Facing Cliffs site, Stillwater Cave. You can just run through and ignore the enemies if you can work your way around it. But if you are also aiming to clear out the cave, we recommend that you have a Torch to light up dark sections and to stock up with Neutralizing Boluses to alleviate the buildup and yo cure Poison. Stillwater Cave is inhabited by poison blooms and bats, and it is filled with poisonous miasma - it also has a mini-boss at the end, the Cleanrot Knight.

Stillwater Cave is a dark cave comprised of many pits where Poison Flowers and their giant counterparts bloom undisturbed. It is recommended to bring along a Torch and a handful of Neutralizing Boluses to counteract the poison build-up inflicted by its denizens. The Site of Grace is found shortly after entering the cave.

You can skip these if you are rushing to the boss. Hug the edge and head southeast until you see another servant around the bend. Jump down into the pit from here and run past all the Poison Flowers to find a tunnel in the southeast. This tunnel is filled with Servants of Rot but they are all in a rested state and will take a long time to get combat-ready, allowing you to simply weave around them to get to the mist gate at the end and challenge this dungeon's boss: The Cleanrot Knight.

place.title: Malefactor's Evergaol
walk: Adan is a very straightforward fight. Despite his stout stature, he is quite agile and capable of quick dodge rolls. His main form of attack is his Flame of the Fell God spell, where he summons a large orb of fire that explodes after a short delay, dealing damage in a large radius and setting the area ablaze. This attack is easy enough to avoid due to the clear telegraph and slow animation. He will also use a combo of multiple swings with his flail, ending in a spinning attack. This move has a long animation and can easily be exploited by ranged players.
Adan drops the Flame of the Fell God incantation upon defeat, allowing you to summon the same orb of fire that he does.

title: Stillwater Cave
text: Stillwater Cave is a dark cave comprised of many pits where Miranda Sprouts and their giant counterparts bloom undisturbed. It is recommended to bring along a Torch and a handful of Neutralizing Boluses to counteract the poison build-up inflicted by its denizens. The Site of Grace is found shortly after entering the cave.

The cave itself is rather small and there is a very straight forward path you can take to get to the boss. Also be mindful not to roll or dodge when walking on poison water, as poison will get on your armor and hasten and lengthen poison build up.
From the Site of Grace, hug the right wall and refrain from dropping down into the pits below as they are hotbeds for the Miranda Sprouts.
There will be a single Giant Bat and some Cave Moss, you can try and stealth kill it.

There is a single Servant of Rot along the way. These are the mushroom-faced humanoids that cast poison bolts at targets from a distance. Take him out and jump the gap to reach the ledge ahead where two more servants await.
Enter the tunnel to the left of the two Servants of Rot you just killed (after jumping the gap). Pick up some Cave Moss and Budding Cave Moss.

You'll come to a room with a lootable corpse in some deep poison water. Before doing anything, look up and target lock and you'll find x2 Giant Bats above the body, dispose of them with range attacks.
After killing the two bats, turn right and look up once more to find more bats hanging from the ceiling, please note that one of these will be a stronger variation of bats.

After clearing the room, you can safely pick up the two treasures in this room, one of them being the Sage Set. Take note that the poison water in this room is deep, and your poison bar will fill slightly faster.
Go back out of the room by backtracking through the tunnel, back to where you killed the 2 Servants of Rot and continue.
Hug the edge and head southeast until you see another servant around the bend.
Jump down into the pit from here and run past all the Miranda Sprouts to find a tunnel in the southeast.

This tunnel is filled with Servants of Rot but they are all in a rested state and will take a long time to get combat ready, allowing you to simply weave around them to get to the mist gate at the end and challenge this dungeon's boss: The Cleanrot Knight.
## Boss: Cleanrot Knight

The Cleanrot Knight is an imposing figure wielding a spear and a sword. After traversing through the mist gate, the boss will almost always run towards you and use his Impale attack. This is his most dangerous move and if the attack connects, he will raise you high in the air, deal tremendous amounts of damage and inflict the scarlet rot status on you. Dodge to the side when you see his spear glowing. Use your best spirit summons to distract him and take potshots at the knight from behind. Watch out for the water on the floor which will rapidly cause you to build up the poison stat. The Cleanrot Knight drops the Winged Sword Insignia upon defeat.

Stillwater Cave is a good source of Cave Moss should you require it for farming. Nearly every stretch of the cave has nodes of this material to collect from. Exploring the cave will also yield a good amount of Budding Cave Moss as well as Crystal Cave Moss crafting items. In general, the Giant Miranda Sprouts are not worth killing as they are highly resistant to magic and release a deadly poison at melee range. It's best to skip these while exploring the cave.

title: Finding Important Items in the Field
text: Once you're back to exploring the center section or south area of Liurnia, you'll want to grab a few items first and probably stop over some locations. We will be listing down the coordinates of the item and/or location marked on the Elden Ring Map so that you have a better picture of where the

Academy Scroll: It can be found just north of Church of Irith. It's by one of the big gravestones where the Skeleton Mages are rising. You can present this scroll to a sorcerer such as Sorceress Sellen so that you can gain access to additional Sorceries that you can learn. Sorceress Sellen is at Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave.
Map (Liurnia East): Found in the south of the swampy lake, in the middle by a monument with enlightened texts on it. A bit north from the Lake-Facing Cliffs site.

Laskyar Ruins: This ruins location can be found just a bit north of the monolith where you got the map fragment. You can find some useful items here such as a Ritual Pot, a Wraith Calling Bell, Smithing Stone [3], and the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (2). Don't forget as well to discover the site of grace for the ruins. In the middle of the ruin is a waygate that will take you right in front of the South Raya Lucaria Gate grace site, take it and unlock this site because you'll need it later.
Map (Liurnia North): This map fragment can be found just a bit south near the Academy Gate Town Site.
Golden Seed: You can find one by an illusory sapling. It can be found near the Academy Gate Town Site and the Academy Gate Town.

title: Patches, a Crystal Tear, a Church, and More Items!
text: If you travel northwest, open the map, and place a beacon on the small isle near the telescope. You'll find the Scenic Isle Site here. You will only find Patches here if you didn't kill him and decided to forgive him during your encounter with him at the Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. You can check his wares and purchase any items that you need. Continue moving northwest and you'll find another isle that has the Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear.

From the isle where you got the crystal tear, move west and you should find the Folly on the Lake Site. You can find it inside a gazebo, on the southwestern side of the lake. Travel north from this site and you should find the Rose Church. White-Faced Varre can be found in this location and if you exhaust his dialogue, you can acquire the Festering Bloody Finger. There are also some items that you can find here such as the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12] and the Bloodflame Blade incantation that drops from a Teardrop Scarab found along the marshes outside of the nearby island. Note that there is another scarab nearby that does not drop anything.

Also from the Folly on the Lake Site, if you travel to the east, you should find the Boilprawn Shack. You can find the site for this location, as well as a new NPC, Blackguard Big Boggart. Make sure that you exhaust his lines and befriend him so he can be summoned later on for the Magma Wyrm Makar fight. Note, Blackguard Big Boggart will not speak with you beyond a line or two unless you speak with Rya first and she tells you about her stolen necklace. You first meet her at Liurnia of the Lakes under the pavilion next to the Birdseye Telescope north of Laskyar ruins. Exhausting her dialogue she will ask you to retrieve a necklace from someone who stole it.
You can visit Blackguard Big Boggart's page to learn more about his questline and to find a list of items that can be bought from him.

Now from the Rose Church, continue northwest and you should find the Temple Quarter. For this location, you can grab some materials such as Bloodrose and kill the Albinauric and Glintstone Flower enemies to farm Runes. In one of the destroyed buildings, however, there is a treasure chest containing the Icerind Hatchet weapon.

place.title: Patches
notes: When Patches surrenders, he is converted to an NPC and can no longer be attacked by summoned phantoms. However, Patches may still be killed by summoned players if enough damage is done to kill him outright before he reaches half health.

The "Cheers for that" line of dialogue spoken when the player stops interacting with him after purchasing from his emporium seems to change after completing his questline. Prior to that, the line is spoken with a high-pitched intonation and drawn out a little; afterward it is said quicker and in a lower pitched tone, which sounds more genuine.

Patches is a regular reoccurring character in various FromSoftware titles. He first debuted in Armored Core: For Answer as "Patch the Good Luck" and has since appeared in Demon's Souls as "Patches, the Hyena", Dark Souls as "Trusty Patches", Dark Souls 3 as "Unbreakable Patches", and in Bloodborne as "Patches the Spider".

title: Rose Church
text: There is not much to do at this church other than speak to White Mask Varre at the entrance, if visiting for the first time. He will give players a Festering Bloody Finger. Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (12) can be found on the ground along the southern walls and the area is rich in Bloodroses. Beware of the single Lesser Sanguine Noble assassin that emerges from the center of the church when you get close, as well as the multiple Albinaurics outside its walls. When the assassin is cleared, he drops another Bloodrose.

place.title: Rose Church
notes: Elden Ring Rose Church Notes and Tips goes here.

title: Boilprawn Shack
text: This location is needed for Rya's questline. After speaking with Rya, you will get a quest to receive this stolen necklace.
Speak to Blackguard to haggle Rya's Necklace and to be able to purchase Boiled Prawn and Boiled Crab from him. Continue speaking to him to eventually obtain a new Gesture: Spread Out.
An alternative to paying 1000 runes for the necklace is to kill him, but it is unnecessary.

title: Temple Quarter
text: The Temple Quarter in Liurnia of the Lakes is a ruined area that is inhabited by Albinauric and Glintstone Flower enemies. You can harvest some materials here such as Bloodrose, Trina's Lily, and Miquella's Lily. In one of the destroyed buildings, there is a treasure chest containing the Icerind Hatchet weapon.

title: Find the Academy Glintstone Key
text: Now, the next legacy dungeon you will need to explore is the Raya Lucaria Academy, mainly found at the center of Liurnia of the Lakes region. The only way in is by passing through the South Raya Lucaria Gate which is actually blocked by a barrier and can only be entered if the person is holding the Academy Glintstone Key. If you were exploring and stumbled upon the South Raya Lucaria Gate through the Academy Gate Town you should find a corpse of a Raya Lucaria Sorceror that's lying near the South Raya Lucaria Gate, if you loot the corpse, it holds the coordinates (Meeting Place Map - ) for the Academy Glintstone Key.

The coordinates or location of the key will take you to a lake area that is guarded by the Glintstone Dragon Smarag. When you arrive, if you want to just grab the key, make sure you are riding your mount, and quickly run behind it. You'll see that it's guarding some corpses, the Raya Lucaria Sorcerer corpse holds the Academy Glintstone Key, while the other two holds a Dragonwound Grease and Kukri. The choice is yours if you want to fight this dragon or just avoid it - with the key, you can now enter Raya Lucaria Academy via the South Raya Lucaria Gate.
## The Magical Dragon

Glintstone Dragon Smarag can be found due south of the Crystalline Woods site of grace, in central Liurnia of the Lakes. You will arrive at this location while exploring the lake area north of Temple District, he is usually asleep and guarding the Academy Glintstone Key, x6 Kukri, and a Dragonwound Grease. Regardless of class focus, get into your most highly protective gear against magic, fire (unknown which his breath attacks inflict), and physical and aim to execute the majority of the fight from horseback, getting off your steed only to gain I-frames, especially during his dive attack, an easy to prepare for attack because of the long buildup animation.

As often as possible try to hit Smarag's head. With enough pressure, he will go to the ground and open himself to a critical strike. Poise damage is minimally inflicted against the legs, wings, and torso, though Banished Knight Oleg's additional pressure against Smarag's flanks is enough to push the meter to full, so don't dismiss those areas of attack altogether. The majority of damage you will be able to inflict will be against the flanks and wings because Smarag so often holds his head out of reach, even with a double jump.

Most of Smarag's attacks will deal significant damage, but a vitality stat of 20+ should be enough to survive a single hit from any of his attacks. For a more detailed strategy and if you want to find our video guide on how to defeat this boss, check our Glintstone Dragon Smarag page - successfully defeating this dragon rewards you with 14,699 Runes and a Dragon Heart which you can use at the Church of Dragon Communion to learn unique Incantations - make further preparation after the battle as you make your way to Raya Lucaria Academy.

place.title: Academy Glintstone Key
notes: If you are at the door (with the key) and it still won't open, try stepping backwards about 1 meter.
The first key found outside the Academy can also be offered to Thops before use, but he will politely refuse.

title: Lakeside Crystal Cave
text: This cave is located on South-Western Liurnia, carved among the cliffs by the shore. It is also directly south from the Scenic Isle Site of Grace.

After entering the cave you will find yourself in a large open area and in front of the grace is a chest containing an Arteria Leaf. Stick to your left and jump up the hill to clear out the Demi-Humans. Follow the pathway along the cliff as normal however, don't drop down into the chasm. Enter the room at the end of the cliff, kill the Demi-Human Chieftain inside the room and open the chest containing the Spear Talisman. Afterwards, head back and to the middle of the cliff to find an area to drop down to. Once you are at the bottom, you will enter a room containing 3 Crystal Snails and another room with many more, but these will take some time to attack. Drop down again to find Soft Cotton x2 on a body on the ledge and then drop down to grab a Smithing Stone (2), Smithing Stone (4) looted from two more corpses, and a Lump of Flesh. Once you proceed, you will get ambushed by three more snails. Turn left to fight the Boss, Bloodhound Knight. He is very agile and can close gaps quickly. Upon his Death he drops the Cerulean Amber Medallion.

After defeating the boss, continue through the arena to find the Slumbering Wolf's Shack. You can meet Latenna here and there is a Rune Arc behind the shack. After completing the Village of the Albinaurics later on in this walkthrough (Liurnia West), you can return to Latenna and she will accompany you as spirit ashes.

place.title: Lakeside Crystal Cave
notes: After defeating the Bloodhound Knight boss, players may proceed to the Slumbering Wolf's Shack Site of Grace, which is only accessible through this cave and is the first location of NPC Latenna.
If you're having trouble locating the cave use this photo to help:

title: Laskyar Ruins
text: Search the northern section for a corpse with a Ritual Pot. It is sitting in front of a set of pillars.
Go to the northwestern section of the ruins to find a set of stairs leading to a dark underground hall. There is a room at the end of this hall with a chest containing the Wraith Calling Bell.

There is a gazebo in the center of the ruins with a Waygate that transports users to the entrance of the Raya Lucaria Academy, you will need a Glintstone Key to proceed through the gates. There is a Smithing Stone [3] on the corpse outside the gazebo.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2] can be looted from a corpse amongst the ruins in the southern part of this location.
Beware the powerful enemy that spawns in the middle of the ruins, in front of the gazebo.

title: Slumbering Wolfs Shack
text: At this shack, players will find Latenna and her wolf companion Lobo. If players have spoken to Albus at the Village of the Albinaurics and have acquired the Haligtree Medallion (Right), Latenna will realize that she can trust you as Albus does and will request that you bring her to the Haligtree. She will then willingly become a spirit ash companion in the form of Latenna The Albinauric.

title: Raya Lucaria Academy
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Raya Lucaria Academy Points of Interest
Find the Academy Glintstone Key to pass through the gate's barrier.
Investigate the two bridges leading to the academy's main gate.
Explore the academy.
Defeat the Monolith Guardian.
Collect the Carian Knight Set.
Fight the Red Wolf of Radagon.
Keep an eye out for Crystallized Crabs.
Explore the Rooftops of the academy.
Obtain the Academy Glintstone Key.
Find the Radagon Icon Talisman.
Acquire the Azur's Glintstone Staff.
Successfully pass through the Iron Ball trap.
Fight the hostile NPC Knight.
Face Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
Give the Academy Glintstone Key to Thops.
Academy of Raya Lucaria
Liurnia of the Lakes
Red Wolf of Radagon ◆ Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

The Academy of Raya Lucaria is a Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. Quite a different area as it has a variety of blue hues, compared to the green open spaces of Limgrave, covered in crystals not only in its environment but also the creatures that inhabit it. These range from snails to more vicious animals to the underwater crustaceans such as crabs and are heavily guarded by the academy's scholars.

place.title: Raya Lucaria Academy
notes: Find the Academy Glintstone Key.

title: Academy Gate Town
text: As you take out the enemies in this section, don't forget to grab a Smithing Stone (3) that can be looted from the ground. Continue moving north through the enemies to reach the gate or you can go around it by moving east where you'll find a corpse that you can loot to find 4x Glintstone Fireflies - the end of this path is where you'll find the South Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace and the entrance to the academy, when you're ready, go through the sigil of the gate. Important: If you do not see the prompt to pass through the sigil, try standing under the sigil itself rather than against the physical gate.
## Entering the Academy of Raya Lucaria

Go back, and head up the stairs where you'll see two Glintstone Sorcerers at the top, be mindful when you are fighting these enemies since they can use sorcery and bombard you with glintstone sorcery from afar; use your shield, time your dodges right, or even close the gap and attack them with your melee weapon since they react slow towards close-quarter combat. Kill the two Glintstone Sorcerers and open the door to continue onto the next section, the Church of the Cuckoo.

You can easily spot them if you look up and press the auto-lock button. Upon clearing the section, make sure to check behind the altar, there is a wall, and behind it is a corpse that you can loot to find a Somber Smithing Stone (3), while on the right side, resting against a wall, is another corpse that has a Golden Rune (2). Before Moving on there is also a hidden room on the right side as you enter. The first wall segment on the right side is an Illusory Wall. Break the illusion to reveal a small side area filled with stone coffins. On the other end of the area is a corpse with a Rune Arc. Now, there is another room that you can find on the left side that has the Church of the Cuckoo Site of Grace, just turn left as you pass through the arch doorway to find it - activate it and rest if needed.

place.title: Academy Gate Town
walk: Many enemies can be found lurking between the half-submerged buildings of what remains of the Academy Gate Town. The roofs and parts of many buildings stick out from the lake, giving players raised surfaces to use as vantage points or use as height advantage against the surrounding enemies. Though this area takes up quite a large portion of the map, there are few points of interest located here. At one point players may come across Diallos and interact with him while he mourns over Lanya at this location. Palm ReaderCan be found at the edge of the broken bridge that leads to the Raya Lucaria Academy.
Other than that, some notable items could be found around this sunken town as well.
The Map, for Map: Liurnia, North can be found in this location.
Ash of War: Charge Forth is dropped by a Teardrop Scarab that is attached to a ceiling under some Land Squirts.

Glintstone Craftman's Cookbook [4] can be found in this location. From the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace, head northwest and look for a sunken church building with enemies on the roof. The chest is located inside a tower that you can jump inside open the chest to obtain the cookbook. Elden Ring Interactive Map Here.
Golden Seed can be found on the ground next to a glowing sapling.
Smithing Stone (1) can be looted off a corpse. The corpse is resting against a wall.
Blue-White Wooden Shield is looted en route towards Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Academy Graveyard
text: While on the left side of the arch doorway, you'll see a path that is lit with a torch, down the slope, you'll find a Teardrop Scarab, kill it to obtain x1 Ash of War: Spectral Lance. If you continue going down the slope, you'll see another corpse that you can loot that is being guarded by another Putrid Corpse. Kill the enemy and loot the corpse at the end of the slope to find x1 Golden Rune (4) - retrace your steps back to the arch doorway and pass through the hall.

By the arch doorway, look to your right and you'll see a slope that goes up, to a corner, there is another Wandering Nobles with a torch here, kill it and walk up a bit, on the right side, there's a body hanging by the ledge, loot it to find a Golden Rune (4) - after grabbing the Golden Rune, go back down and head through the arch doorway where you'll find the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

Now go back where you left the rotating lift. Turn left and kill a Wandering Noble at the end to take the lift going down. Take off when you see the ground sticking out. Defeat the group containing 2 Avionette Soldiers and Wandering Nobles to get the Avionette Soldier Ashes.

title: The Great Hall
text: We suggest that you kill both sorcerers first and then shift your attention towards the Lazuli Sorcerer. Upon defeating the enemies on the second floor, walk towards the balcony with large arc-looking statue, look to the left, and you'll see a corpse that's hanging by the balcony's fence, loot it to find x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy - you've cleared the second floor.

Secret Wall: Upon reaching the top of the stairs (just before the boss room door), the first empty bookshelf on the left of the staircase is an illusionary wall. See picture below. This leads to a chest containing the spell Comet and a corpse behind the altar containing a Stonesword Key. Climb the ladder in this room and make your way to the terrace along the back wall. There is a hole that will drop you into another room containing the Graven-School Talisman. The pots will come alive once you approach the talisman.
## Greater Enemy: Red Wolf of Radagon

During our encounter with this mini-boss, at the start of the battle, we used the Lone Wolf Ashes to summon three wolves to help in combat. They help in attacking the Red Wolf, and most importantly, they can catch its attention, allowing our character to attack it with ranged magical attacks while it is busy fighting the wolves. The wolf has low health and it is slightly weak against Slash Damage and/or Pierce Damage.

This either happens when it uses a lunging bite attack, this move usually has a max of three hits, and after the third lunge, you can counterattack. Another will be after it leaps into the air and lands on the ground with the magical sword in its mouth, there is a chance for you to land one to two hits before it fully recovers. Just don't be greedy and remember to back away after landing your counters - as you defeat this greater enemy, it rewards you with 14000 Runes and x1 Memory Stone, you'll also find the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in this arena.

title: Courtyard
text: If you check around as well, there are some materials that you can grab such as Rowa Fruit, Herba, and Trina's Lily. If you check the northwest section of the courtyard, you'll encounter a Giant Crab that will burrow out from the ground. Killing it yields Runes and drops x1 Crab Eggs. Head west of the courtyard and you'll see a glowing sapling that is guarded by three Wandering Nobles. Kill the enemies and check the glowing sapling to find x1 Golden Seed on the ground.

Go back to where the glowing sapling is and check the right-side corner where you'll spot a corpse that you can loot. Tread carefully as you approach it since a Giant Crab will ambush you from the ground. Kill the enemy and loot to the body to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Also near this body, if you go check the ledge of the cliff on the left side of the body, there's another corpse that you can pillage to find x1 Golden Rune (4).

title: Academy Rooftops
text: Sprint across the group of Wandering Nobles, up the stairs, and take out the two sorcerers first. Remember that they react slowly when you close the gap and fight them upfront. Next, kill the Wandering Noble, which has a chance to drop Aristocrat Coat, and kill the rest of the Wandering Nobles. Go back down and head up the steps opposite to it where you'll encounter more Wandering Nobles and another Glintstone Sorcerer. Clear this area and loot the nearby corpse to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Next, go back and head towards the arch doorway that was in front of the group of kneeling Wandering Nobles. You'll find an office where you can loot a body that is hanging on the fence of the window balcony - the body contains x1 Glintstone Whetblade.

Looking up, you will notice a corpse on the roof. To reach it, jump down once more and look to your left. There is another roof with a fair amount of gap but still reachable. Perform a careful running jump to step onto the roof and prepare for an immediate ambush a Avionette Soldier. Head left and follow the spiral path of rooftops, inhabited by several Marionette Soldiers. After a jump over a gap once again, you will see a ladder on your left. Just don't go into the ladder room naively since two Marionette Soldiers are each looking for an ambush from the left and right wall. The ladder leads to the top of a bell tower, in which you can obtain the Full Moon Crossbow. Now jump down to a rooftop, on the left of which you will see the forementioned corpse bearing a Smithing Stone (4).

Jump down from the corpse and you are back to where you were before. Do the hard jump again, but this time, go straight to perform another jump. Go to the tower that you see on your right; an Avionette Soldier will ambush in the middle. Go down through broken wooden floors until you see a Crystallized Crab, which can be looted for the Lazuli Glintstone Crown. Eventually, you will reach a small room with some crabs and a body holding a Somber Smithing Stone (4).

Leaving the room, go around to your left to climb the ladder. On your left, you will see a body that you can loot to find x1 Imbued Sword Key inside a tower. Looking across from the key, and you'll see a nearby narrow platform of another towering building. Jump across and go around the platform to find another body that's sitting by the edge, to pillage and acquire x2 Smithing Stone (3).

Retrace your steps back to the ladder to see two Marionette Soldier enemies roaming the rooftops north of you. Jump across the rooftop in front of the ladder. Move North, and then look to your right, there's a dead-end by the rooftop where you'll see a corpse that can be pillaged to acquire x2 Magic Grease. Just be careful since two Avionette Soldiers will ambush you.

Jump down onto the short bridge from the chandelier and tread carefully since the upper section of the church is guarded by Lazuli Sorcerers and Glintstone Sorcerers. Check the northwest side after killing the enemies to find a corpse that is sitting against a wall, you can pillage the body to find x1 Shattering Crystal. Make sure to kick the ladder down that's at the opposite side of the short bridge, this unlocks a shortcut leading back to the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace (take note that the enemies here respawn). Head east to see an arch doorway and a balcony, each at the end of a bridge.

You can go again to the rooftop area to get a missing item, Golden Rune (4), but probably you will just want to skip it. To reach it, go to the roof where you had to make a hard jump over the big gap. Go straight this time and at the very bottom, you'll encounter another Marionette Soldier on the right side. Kill it and continue west where you'll see another Marionette Soldier roaming the narrow rooftop. Jump across the next rooftop and you'll see another body here that you can loot to pick up x1 Golden Rune (4).

title: Academy Crystal Cave
text: The Academy Crystal Cave can be accessed by following the Liurnia shallows towards the west of the Raya Lucaria Academy. The entrance is found on the western cliff below the academy, barred by an Imp Statue. Look for the entrance on our Elden Ring Map Here. Two Stonesword Keys are required to dispel the fog barrier. These caves are very dark except for the flashes of glintstone spells cast by the sorcerers within. It is highly recommended to equip a Torch whilst traversing the caves.

Shortly after the entry, you will find the area's Site of Grace. Continue on into the cave and look to the left for a Crystal Cave Moss. This cave is rich in this item so be on the lookout for them if you require them for crafting. There is a Rat with its back turned which you can assassinate or skip if you wish. A couple more Rats lie in the path ahead. Following the linear path, you will arrive in a large foggy cave with many pillar-sized crystals.

There are several Twinsage Sorcerers in this cave, armed with powerful glintstone spells. Utilize the crystal pillars to block their line of sight, as well as their projectiles. At the start of the cave, look for the lone sorcerer facing a pillar and take this chance to ambush him with a critical attack. Beware of a second sorcerer just behind that pillar and the group of three sorcerers approaching from the back of the cave. Weave around the crystals and take them out one by one, mixing in any AoE attacks when you see an opportunity to hit multiple of them. There are two more sorcerers next to each other near the north section of this cave, and one more behind a pillar a few steps ahead.

After defeating all the sorcerers, look for an opening in the northwest for a small room with a cage. You can pick up a Stonesword Key from the corpse in the cage as well as some Budding Cave Moss along the walls. Go back to the large cave area and go east through a tunnel leading to a wooden doorway. Open the door and you will arrive in a storage area of sorts with a Battlemage guarding the doorway on the left. Battlemages are tanky and can take a lot more hits than the Twinsage Sorcerers. There is also a Glintstone Sorcerer patrolling the room. Go through the room the Battlemage was guarding to find another room where a Sorcerer is standing on a raised platform. Defeat the sorcerer and loot the chest in the room for a Rune Arc. To access the raised platform, attack an illusory walls close by (screenshot here) and loot another chest to collect the Crystal Staff.

Head back to the storage area and look to the east to find the fog gate leading to this dungeon's boss: The Crystalians. This boss encounter is against a pair of Crystalian opponents. One wields a spear, while the other wields a staff. Both are protected by a thick, crystal shield, significantly reducing the damage they take from your attacks. These shields will eventually break after each Crystalian's HP reaches a certain percentage. Cracks will be visible in their shields, signifying that you can now deal full damage to them. It is highly recommended that you use a tanky summon such as the Kaiden Sellsword Ashes to distract one of the Crystalians as you focus on the other. See the Crystalians page for further details on the fight.

Defeating this pair of bosses yields the Crystal Release Sorcery spell. Continue on to the door behind the bosses to reach an elevator that will take you to a tower within the academy. Climb the tower to find a chest containing the Terra Magica spell.

title: Grand Library Outskirts
text: He can also use a flask to recover his health, and he can use a great amount of it. So apart from trying to be careful with fighting this knight, you will need to apply pressure by quickly attacking to stop him from healing. Now, we did discover one tactic that you can exploit. Bait and lead him towards the entrance of the doorway where the iron ball trap is. He will follow you, but not all the way. He will, however, keep walking side to side by the door and back inside, and he will wait for you to approach him. Remain at the sides of the stairs as you hug the fence to avoid getting hit by the iron ball and bombard him with ranged attacks when he's within your sight - successfully defeating this hostile NPC drops x1 Carian Knight's Shield.

From the garden where Moongrum was initially standing, straight ahead is a lift that you can ride to reach the upper level leading to the boss, while the left side of the courtyard goes down to a garden. This is guarded by a Glintstone Sorcerer and Wandering Noble. Go straight through the garden and unlock the door that serves as a shortcut back to the courtyard.
Once you are ready, ride the lift to the top where you'll find doors leading to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

title: Facing Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
text: This is why summoning the wolves is a good tactic since they'll just randomly run around attacking the children, and if you're lucky enough, if they spot one that is hiding, it can just attack it once, and you can find the next host. There is also one moment in combat that you will need to be aware of, when she speaks and says something about her children being born anew, get ready to get behind the bookshelves or stack of books since she will use them as projectiles to attack you.

Take note that every time she summons a spirit, white glyphs will appear on the ground that deals damage and can knock you down if you are caught or step on it. Defeating her yields 40000 Runes and rewards you with x1 Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen and x1 Great Rune of the Unborn.

place.title: Renna
notes: The "Trivia" section on the IMDB page for Elden Ring claims that "Game of Thrones" actress Maisie Williams lends her voice to Renna character in the game's story trailer. However, there are no reliable sources that support this other than people claiming to recognise her voice in various online forums.
Renna appears to have a spectral mirror image of herself attached to her at the right eye.

title: Cliffbottom Catacombs in Liurnia
text: ## Liurnia of the Lakes: East
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (East) Points of Interest
Clear out Cliffbottom Catacombs.
Examine the Highway Lookout Tower.
Travel to the Church of Vows.
Visit the Minor Erdtree of Northeast Liurnia.
Complete Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
Investigate Ainsel River (Underground).
## Cliffbottom Catacombs in Liurnia

Once you've cleared Raya Lucaria Academy, it's time to explore the east side of the map for Liurnia of the Lakes, we recommend that you start from the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site and work your way up. The Cliffbottom Catacombs can be found a bit northeast of the mentioned site. Cliffbottom Catacombs is a catacomb that is filled with imps and ogres, Walk carefully to not wake or alert the ogres or get jumped on by the imps. The catacombs also have multiple buttons on the floor that trigger traps that shoot projectiles at the player, use them to your advantage by triggering them to hit enemies. The imps in this dungeon will throw a blue pot explosion at players - this location is good to find upgrade materials such as Grave Glovewort [2] and Grave Glovewort [3] that are used to strengthen your Spirit Ashes with the help of Roderika.

Leaving the Site of Grace going down the stairs you will see the elevator room, step on the button to lower yourself down. A lever is present at the top and bottom of the shaft for you to call the elevator if it is not there. The first room after the elevator has 2 imps, one on the wall ahead and one standing on the right of the entrance. Past this room is the pair of locked doors flanked by 2 statues, the door will be unlocked by a lever found deep in the catacombs.

Stepping into the rest of the catacombs you will walk into a square room with a staircase, the stairs lead downwards going over a pit where an ogre can be seen sitting. Going forward into the next tunnel be careful of both the floor trap as well as the imp in the ceiling, there is another imp on the corner ahead that will jump you so be prepared for it.

Through this tunnel, you enter into a room with a high ceiling, and some stairs leading up on the left side, straight ahead there is a sleeping ogre between the pillars, kill it to get to the grave glovewort behind it. Up the stairs are a sealed door and an imp statue but also another ogre, this time awake and patrolling, above them are a pair of imps ready to throw grenades at you if you catch their attention. You could either rush the imps by going up the stairs and ignoring the ogre or kite the ogre down the stairs to separate the imps and the ogre to make for an easier fight.

The room sealed by the Imp statue will require a Stonesword Key to open, you will find 1 imp enemy and the Nox Mirrorhelm. Go up the stairs and carefully deal with the 2 imps in this room, a floor trap is placed right at the entrance to the room which can be used to shoot projectiles into one of the imps. Following the path out of this room, you will find yourself in the space above the initial set of stairs and entrance. There are multiple imps in this area and in the room on the left you can find 3 imps, the body there holds the scythe for you to loot.

To proceed to the lever, you have to drop down into the room under the first set of stairs leading from the locked doors. This part of the catacombs has multiple ogres roaming the halls so tread carefully. Moving around the tunnels here you can find remains with loot on them, one of which is the Prattling Pate "Wonderful".

From the room you dropped down into go east to advance, there you will find a single ogre blocking the way forward, kill them to proceed. At the end of these tunnels is a ladder, climb it to find a room with a carpet and some bookshelves. On the left, you will find an ogre looking at a tomb in front of a stone statue, going right will lead you to the lever and the way back to the start. On the tomb is the Page Ashes.

This fight is against a variant version of the Erdtree Burial Watchdog that uses a staff, spells, and has 3 heads that will do a 3 headed fire breathing attack. The fight is against just the boss without any additional enemies. The boss still uses the same movement pattern as the normal Erdtree Burial Watchdog, in their seated form floating up and towards the player before stomping down and walking towards the player to slam and slamming that down while in their standing form. While seated the Erdtree Burial Watchdog will also cast spells at players, breathing flames at them or casting seeking glintstone sorceries. Defeating this boss will reward you with Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3200 Runes.
## The Wandering Maiden... Again.

After clearing the Cliffbottom Catacombs, from this location, head northwest and you should find the Purified Ruins. You can find items such as another Sabriri Grape, a Golden Rune [3], a Cuckoo Glinstone, and the Two Fingers Heirloom talisman. Since you have another Shabriri Grape, you'll find Hyetta on the western side of the Purified Ruins. She asks for another Shabriri Grape but does not give any reward this time. Continue going north and you'll encounter the Purified Ruins Waygate that teleports you to the entrance of Raya Lucaria Academy - next, make sure to discover the Liurnia Highway North Site, found on the side of the main road

place.title: Cliffbottom Catacombs
walk: Cliffbottom Catacombs is a catacombs that is filled with imps and omens. Walk carefully to not wake or alert the omens or get jumped on by the imps. The catacombs also have multiple buttons on the floor that trigger traps that shoot projectiles at the player; you can use them to your advantage by triggering them to hit enemies. The imps in this dungeon will throw a blue pot explosion at players.

The room sealed by the Imp statue will require a Stonesword Key to open, inside you will find 1 imp enemy and the Nox Mirrorhelm. Go up the stairs and carefully deal with the two imps in this room, a floor trap is placed right at the entrance to the room which can be used to shoot projectiles into one of the imps. Following the path out of this room you will find yourself in the space above the initial set of stairs and entrance. There are multiple imps in this area and in the room on the left you can find 3 imps, the body there holds the scythe for you to loot.
BOSS BATTLE: Erdtree Burial Watchdog

title: Purified Ruins
text: This ruins can be found by following the eastern side of the lake from Stormveil Castle. There are a handful of hostile knights and spearmen, as well as one dog to defeat in this location, but they are mostly spread apart from each other so you don't need to worry about getting overwhelmed. The particular Soldier-type in this location is the Foot Soldier. These Soldiers have a chance to drop items from the Foot Soldier Set. Knights are found within the ruin walls and become animated once you approach. These can be easily countered by beginning your attack behind them to avoid extending combat.

In the large hall filled with soldiers, search near the middle of the ruins for a set of crates and pots. There is a wooden board covering the entrance to an underground room here. Inside the room is a Shabriri Grape on the corpse on the left and the Two Fingers Heirloom talisman inside the chest. Back outside, search the southwest section for a narrow path with barrels. There is a Golden Rune (3) in front of the barrels.

Check the western side of the ruins, right by the lake shore. If you've given Hyetta a Shabriri Grape in her first location, you will be able to find her here where she will ask for another grape but does not reward anything this time.
In the northeast section of the ruins, you can find a Waygate which will teleport you to the entrance of the Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Highway Lookout Tower
text: Just a bit northwest from the Liurnia Highway North Site, stopover the Highway Lookout Tower This tower is situated up a hill and is heavily guarded by specters of Noble Sorcerers and Noble Wanderers, as well as a Twinsage Sorcerer that can be found at the top floor of the tower. We recommend that you traverse the barricades while you are riding your mount since the specters will spawn as soon as you try to push through and the sorcerer at the top of the tower will start shooting sorcery projectiles at you. Climb up the ladder and loot the chest for a Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (3). Head up two more ladders, kill the sorcerer, and loot the corpse beside the enemy to find the Carian Glintblade Staff.

After clearing the location, climb back down and continue moving a bit northwest as you follow the road which takes you to the site of the Gate Town Bridge. If you spoke to Hyetta earlier, you should find her here as well. Hyetta spawns near the site of grace. She will ask for another Shabriri Grape and will ask what the grapes are. Telling her will make her puke and then thank you for telling her. After sitting down at the grace nearby she will have more dialog. After once again sitting at the grace she will move to her next location.

Now, if you want to challenge yourself and if you want a new Ashes of War, then rest until nightfall by the site and you'll find the Night's Cavalry field boss here. This field boss can be found patrolling near the Gate Town Bridge, again, only appears at night, and it drops the Ash of War: Ice Spear if you defeat it. You can visit our Night's Cavalry page to find a written strategy, as well as a video guide on how to defeat this field boss.

Next, from the Gate Town Bridge site, head east to beat the Tibia Mariner field boss. For (1) Mounted Combat, the strategy here is pretty straightforward. You ride up to the boss and hit him several times, then ride away before he hits you with his attacks. You can ignore his minions entirely as they tend to move slowly and don't hit that hard. It also makes it easy to get back to him when he vanishes and reappears. (2) Melee Combat, clear the minions first if you plan to play on foot so you don't get overwhelmed. Hit the boss a few times and then dodge to the side when he raises and splashes down. Keep repeating this, staying to his side or behind him if you can. If he disappears and reappears track him down and repeat. And (3) Magic and Ranged Users, much like melee, clear the minions first and then proceed to range the boss down with attacks. He moves slowly so you don't need to reposition very often.

Successfully defeating this boss drops a Deathroot and the Skeletal Bandit Ashes. Nearby, you'll notice a location, the Carian Study Hall, ignore that for now since it cannot yet be completed as you are missing a key item you will obtain later from this NPC.

place.title: Highway Lookout Tower (Liurnia)
walk: The hill leading up to the tower is crawling with spectral variants of Noble Sorcerers and Godrick Soldiers while a Twinsage Sorcerer sits at the top floor, sniping anyone who dares trespass with glintstone projectiles. It is highly recommended that you ride past the spectral enemies and just enter the tower immediately. Otherwise, the sorcerer will just keep taking pot shots at you as you try to defeat the enemies. You can return for them later after taking the sorcerer out.
Climb up the ladder and loot the chest for a Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (3). Head up two more ladders and you can kill the sorcerer. Loot the corpse next to him for a Carian Glintblade Staff.

title: Jarburg
text: From the last stone platform before reaching the village, jump onto the roof of the closest hut to loot 3 x Smithing Stone (3) and then touch the Site of Grace in the southeast. Head back to the first hut and walk along the cliffs behind it. Jump onto the roof of a hut in the north for a Ritual Pot, then drop down and look behind you for a Cracked Pot.

Check the hut in the northeast for another Cracked Pot and a Living Jar Shard. Head south from here and look to the right for a large decorative jar. On top of it is another Ritual Pot. Use the boulders nearby or your horse to get on top of the jar. Continue heading south and look at the large headstone to the left for one last Cracked Pot. Further south past the village proper, you will find a cluster of sarcophagi where you can loot a Golden Rune (1), 2 x Golden Rune (2), 2 x Golden Rune (3) and a single Golden Rune (6).
The village is also rich in plants used for crafting and there is no danger here. See the full list of gatherables above.
Patch 1.03 Update:

Upon loading up into Jarburg, Jar Bairn will be to the left sitting on the steps to a house, upon exhausting all his dialog and resetting the area a few times, Diallos will show up in a hut down the road (the one with the little hostile jar) and will be patching him up explaining how he put everything at Volcano Manor behind him. Upon exhausting both Diallos and Jar Bairn's dialog, the town will be attacked.

Reloading the area, Jar-Bairn can be found where he is found initially and can be given Alexander's Innards. Complete the Diallos Questline to be able to loot a Hoslow's Petal Whip, Diallos's Mask and Numen's Rune at this location. After reloading, the Companion Jar talisman can be found where he was completing those questlines.

place.title: Jarburg
notes: After patch 1.03, Jarburg has a new NPC named Jar Bairn. He is the nephew of Alexander and is a continuation of his and Diallos’ questline.

title: Travel to the Church of Vows
text: The road north has two paths: One has a Golem that is guarding access to Ainsel River Well. Ignore this, for now, you'll check this later on. Take the other path up the slopes. The area to the left of the site of grace will have an Incantation (Flame, Cleanse Me!) and the Fire Monk Gauntlets. Stay the road and access the higher ground to arrive at the Church of Vows ( and meet Miriel, Pastor of Vows who can teach you both Incantations and Sorceries, receive Scrolls and Prayerbooks, and give you information about the Lore of major characters.

This location is important because it allows you to cleanse your SIN (aggro'd NPCs) by using Celestial Dew and performing an "Absolution" at the altar. Make sure to discover and rest at the site of grace for the Church of Vows. And grab some items such as the Golden Tailoring Tools and the Gold Sewing Needle inside a chest. There is another field boss here that roams around the church at night, and this is the Bell Bearing Hunter. If you successfully defeat this boss, you'll be rewarded with the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing.

place.title: Church of Vows
walk: Upon arrival, you are greeted by Miriel, Pastor of Vows, guardian of the church. Upon your first meeting, Miriel will tell the story of the church and offer to share its knowledge on Sorceries, Incantations, as well as Lore related to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon and Lord Radagon.
Check the right side of the church's entrance for a chest containing the Golden Tailoring Tools and Gold Sewing Needle key items.

Located at the center of the church, a statue of Lady Rennala stands out. Player's can interact with the statue as an "Atone" option is displayed. If you are in possession of a Celestial Dew, atoning for your sins will reverse any antagonizations you have with NPCs, whether caused by accident or on purpose, making them friendly again. However, if the NPC has been killed atonement will not revive them. Celestial Dews are key items obtained from various sources. For details, see the Celestial Dew page.

There is a Bell Bearing Hunter boss that can be fought at the church if you come in during night time. It drops the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing upon defeat. If you are having trouble spawning the boss, rest at the Site of Grace outside, advance til night and then rest once more. The boss should spawn afterwards.
notes: The Church of Vows can be reached through a Portal. It is located at the right side, in front of the Carian Knight (hostile NPC) in Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Ainsel River Well
text: Once the Golem has been defeated simply walk through the entrance of the building to find a lever on the right wall and the elevator in the center of the building. Stepping on the button in the middle of the elevator will lower you down into the Ainsel River underground region.
## Minor Erdtree Northeast Liurnia

Before you proceed to the next location, make sure to rest and prepare since you will encounter another boss at the next location. From the Church of Vows, travel northeast and you should find the Minor Erdtree of Liurnia Northeast, along the way is also the Ruined Labyrinth Site, don't forget to discover it. When you arrive, you'll encounter the Erdtree Avatar for this location. You'll want to defeat this field boss to acquire the following Physick Flask Buffs: the Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear, Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and the Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

Next, move southwest or go back to the Ruined Labyrinth Site, on the west side you should find a Walking Mausoleum. To identify if you're near, players will hear mausoleums as they emit a distinctly loud bell sound as they walk about. They usually have a small roaming area, so they are easy to find. When you want to take on a walking mausoleum, you must attack its deposits until it comes down. This can take considerable time depending on the location.

Once the mausoleum is static, you can enter it at any time to perform a Remembrance Duplication: This is only available once per mausoleum, so pick wisely! Performing this rite will enable you to obtain the multiple Remembrance Weapons (Boss Weapons) and magic that they grant. Boss Armor is not gated behind their remembrances, but you must have defeated them to purchase from Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

title: More Smithing Stones for You!
text: At this point, you'll be needing more Smithing Stones to properly upgrade your armaments, lucky for you, there is a nearby cave here where you can gather the materials you need. From the Ruined Labyrinth Site, travel west and you should find the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. This area is similar to Limgrave Tunnels where you will need to explore the tunnel paths, gather the stones you need, fight the enemies and reach the boss at the end, the Crystalians.

When first entering the mine, you'll find an elevator. Going down it will put you in front of the Site of Grace for this area. On the way down the elevator, you might notice two doorways on the left side of the wall. If you want to reach these, go back up the elevator and destroy the boxes on the left, right before you get on the elevator then jump down. Be careful because if you fall you will die. In the first doorway, you will find x1 Cracked Crystal. Following the ledge left drop-down and enter the next doorway. You'll get 3 Cracked Crystals. Continue following the ledges down. There are lamps to guide you. At the bottom of the elevator, before you head through the doorway, look behind you and grab the x2 Cracked Crystal that are in the corners.

One on a wall to the left and one on a corpse to the right. Going behind the stairs you'll find a corpse with 1 Golden Rune [3]. This room contains a total of sixteen Cracked Crystals and one Smithing Stone [3] excluding the 2 Smithing Stones found earlier. Exiting this room leads you to an elevator with more ledges. Just like last time, stick to the left. You'll find a tunnel that leads to a ledge. On the right grab the Somber Smithing Stone [2] and the x2 Cracked Crystal. Go back to the elevator and stick to the left as you jump down.

Following the tunnel out connects you to a cavern with another support beam and another elevator. Before crossing the beam, kill the Digger on your left and grab the Smithing Stone [2]. After crossing the beam, kill the patrolling Digger but don't go up the stairs. Instead, go to the right of them and grab the Smithing Stone [3]. Go up the stairs and kill the other Digger that is patrolling, then take the elevator up so you have a shortcut if you die. This room holds eight Cracked Crystals, one Smithing Stone [3], and one Smithing Stone [2] minus what I already mentioned.

Going through the other doorway where the two Marionette soldiers dropped down from leads you to another section with two doors. As soon as you pass the doorway on the right look up and you'll see another Marionette soldier wielding bows. They won't drop down until you attack them or the other two Marionette soldiers in the room. The two on the ground both wield daggers and are guarding a chest. Kill them then the archer if you haven't yet. The chest holds a Crystal Knife.

There are also some other locations you may want to visit in the east map for Liurnia.Please note that if you've been following the walkthrough from the beginning, at this point there's not an easy way for you to reach the northern section of the area to access these locations, unless you want to do some fancy wall-climbing with Torrent and it is tedious and best left for later when you get easier access to these areas. But if want to attempt, following the steps below.

Directly northeast of the Erdtree Avatar that you found earlier, there is a short stone spire next to the impassible wall. Your goal here is to use Torrent's double jump and to get to the top of that spire, then jump directly northeast to the small edges of the impassible rock wall and climb up to the northern section.
It's recommended that you kill Erdtree Avatar before attempting this, because it will constantly grief you, making this next to impossible.
After you reach the northern section, go north to reach the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts site of grace to activate it, avoiding having to do the jump-climb again.
The northern parts of this area will now be accessible to explore the following:

Converted Fringe Tower: A tower that requires a puzzle to be solved in order to unlock it. The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue to find out what the puzzle is. To clear the puzzle, perform the Erudition gesture while wearing any Glintstone Crown in front of the door. The Hiama Glintstone Crown does not work for this.
Church of Inhibition: There is an NPC invader her, Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Defeat the hostile NPC to enter the church where you can find the Finger Maiden Set.

Frenzied Flame Village: Just a bit northwest from the Minor Erdtree. You can find items here such as Shabriri's Woe, looted off a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village, and the Frenzied's Cookbook [1], looted off a corpse inside one of the houses in the village.

Black Knife Catacombs: This area is good to gather glovewort flowers used to upgrade your Spirit Ashes. And the boss here drops the Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes if you're looking for a spirit ash item that can use spells and attack long range.

title: Frenzy-Flaming Tower
text: Above the tower is a repeatedly-burning flame of frenzy, which will increase your Madness levels if you're within view of it. You can use rocks as cover during your approach, or use the ravine to the left of the tower to come behind it, and use the Spiritspring to jump up next to it and quickly get inside the tower, which will protect you from increasing madness. There will be a Giant Rat and three rats inside, which can be difficult in the close quarters, so be prepared. The Beast-Repellent Torch can help ward off the rats while you endure the madness buildup. Climb the ladder and you will find a chest containing the incantation Howl of Shabriri. Continue to the top to find a group of Frenzied Villagers, and quickly kill them to put an end to the flame of madness affecting the area. Fire pots can be thrown from below the top level and will kill the frenzied villages through the floor boards beneath them.

place.title: Frenzy-Flaming Tower
notes: This location is likely a nod to Tolkien's Barad-dûr, the tower of Sauron.

title: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
text: Two things to note right off the bat:1) I explored the first floor of this place when I first found it so I might be missing a few items. I'll make a note when I'm missing an item.2) This area took me about an hour to get through because I wasn't using a magic imbued weapon. I highly recommend using one. Throughout most of this mine the only enemies attacking you are the Digger guards watching over the Diggers and the Marionette soldiers. The Diggers will not attack unless either you hit them or steal the material they are mining.
The Crystalized enemies in this dungeon have a rare chance to drop Somber Smithing Stone (2)

With that out of the way let's begin. When first entering the mine you'll find an elevator. Going down it will put you in front of the Site of Grace for this area. On the way down the elevator you might notice two doorways on the left side of the wall. If you want to reach these, go back up the elevator and destroy the boxes on the left right before you get on the elevator then jump down. Be careful because if you fall you will die. In the first doorway you will find x1 Cracked Crystal. Following the ledge left drop down and enter the next doorway. You'll get 3 Cracked Crystals. Continue following the ledges down. There are lamps to guide you. At the bottom of the elevator, before you head through the doorway, look behind you and grab the x2 Cracked Crystal that are in the corners.

Heading through the tunnel in front of the elevator will lead you to a fork in the path. Going right will bring you to a chest guarded by two Diggers. One of which will patrol the area. Inside the chest you'll find Somber Smithing Stone (2) 1x, and a Somber Smithing Stone (3) behind the raised icon. You can grab 4 Cracked Crystals from this room. Going to the left will lead you to an open area with one Digger on the left and three on the right. One of the Diggers on the right is patrolling the area while the other two are mining. You'll notice a support beam in the area. If you cross it you can jump on the wooden ledges that are jutting out. Near the top grab the Smithing Stone [3]. At the top you'll find a corpse with one Somber Smithing Stone [3]. This room holds six Cracked Crystals.

In the next room, looking to the right you'll notice another Digger sitting down. Down the first set of stairs are two more Diggers who are also sitting down. They will attack you when you near them, just like the previous one who was sitting. After killing them look to your right. You should see a Digger and a path that leads to a small room. Be careful when attacking the Digger outside of it because one from beneath the stairs will attack you. The small room holds 2 Smithing Stone [3]. One on a wall to the left and one on a corpse to the right. Going behind the stairs you'll find a corpse with 1 Golden Rune [3]. This room contains a total of sixteen Cracked Crystals and a further Smithing Stone [3]. Exiting this room leads you to an elevator with more ledges. Just like last time, stick to the left. You'll find a tunnel that leads to a ledge with Somber Smithing Stone [2] and x2 Cracked Crystal. Either return to the elevator shaft or carefully drop below to access a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone (3).

Either path connects you to a cavern with another support beam and another elevator. Before crossing the beam, kill the Digger on your left and grab the Smithing Stone [2]. After crossing the beam, kill the patrolling Digger but don't go up the stairs. Instead go to the right of them and grab the Smithing Stone [3]. Go up the stairs and kill the other Digger that is patrolling, then take the elevator up so you have a shortcut if you die. This level holds eight Cracked Crystals, one Smithing Stone [3], and one Smithing Stone [2] in total.

Be careful going through the tunnel leading out because a Marionette soldier will run out of the room to your right and attack you with four daggers. Kill him quickly if possible. Before going into the room they came out of look at the other doorway and look up. You'll notice two more Marionette soldiers hanging waiting to attack you. Getting close will make them fall. Both have two bows each and can be annoying if not dealt with quickly. The room the first Marionette soldier came out of holds three Smithing Stone (1) and one Smithing Stone [2]. Going through the other doorway where the two Marionette soldiers dropped down from leads you to another section with two doors. As soon as you pass the doorway on the right look up and you'll see another Marionette soldier wielding bows. They won't drop down until you attack them or the other two Marionette soldiers in the room. The two on the ground both wield daggers and are guarding a chest. Kill them then the archer if you haven't yet. The chest holds a Crystal Knife.

Go through the doorway that has a tunnel in view. The first level has no enemies on it. Go down the first set of stairs and kill the Digger. After you killed him look to the left. You should see three Diggers in a circle and two Crystal Sorcerers. Take out the sorcerers first. They have more health than the Diggers and the Diggers here won't attack you unless you attack them first. After dealing with the sorcerers, kill the three Diggers in a circle and collect the three Smithing Stone [3] and the Somber Smithing Stone [1]. There are two more Diggers in this area. After killing them all (if you want to) you can collect the eight Cracked Crystals, the Smithing Stone [2], and the Smithing Stone [3]. The last two smithing stones can be found in the collapsed tunnel in the back of the room. Looking north from the bottom of the stairs, there is a tunnel with the Shatter Earthsorcery on the right side.

The tunnel in front of the stairs leads you to an elevator. To the left of it, after you break the items there, jumping down will lead you to a small tunnel with a Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Once at the bottom of the elevator you'll sell the golden boss fog, but pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] to your left first. If you want to go back to the Site of Grace to rest and take the elevators you found along the way down.
BOSS FIGHT:

This boss is the Crystalian. It's moves are easy to predict and you can summon spirits to help you. You won't be doing much damage in the beginning until their armor breaks at half health. Strike weapons like maces and clubs will do a lot more damage in that first phase. After their armor breaks at half health all weapons will do full damage again. Getting hit with one of her throwing blades seemed to cause one resembling it to show around my wrist allowing me to do full damage.
Spirit Ashes like Banished Knight Engvall Ashes can help keep the boss stunlocked.

title: Converted Fringe Tower
text: The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue is a hint to solve to puzzle:
"May erudition light the way!"
To clear the puzzle, perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue while wearing a Glintstone Crown that lights up when you perform the gesture.
These crowns are:
Karolos Glintstone Crown
Lazuli Glintstone Crown
Olivinus Glintstone Crown
Twinsage Glintstone Crown
Witch's Glintstone Crown
Note: The Azur, Lusat, Haima and Hierodas Glintstone Crowns do not work for this.

The room at the top of the stairs will summon a School of Graven Mages, this is the only enemy in the tower, run past or defeat it and take the elevator up to get to the chest at the top and retrieve the Gavel of Haima and Cannon of Haima sorceries.

title: Black Knife Catacombs
text: The Black Knife Catacombs features many skeleton enemies and multiple moving guillotines throughout its chambers. The sewers are infested by crabs, with 2 giant crabs waiting for unsuspecting prey. This catacombs even has 2 bosses found in different rooms and with different loot, the Black Knife Assassin fight is not necessary for the player to advance through to find the lever that opens the doors to the Cemetery Shade fight.

Many of the skeletons that are found in this Catacombs exhibit a strange behavior of rolling at the player, and attack quite rapidly. Players should be careful when fighting these enemies as they can be very fast to close the gap and attack. Some of the skeletons are also special in that they cannot be killed by themselves, instead, one has to defeat the nearby necromancer which kills the skeletons automatically and permanently (until you rest or die). Going down the stairs from the Site of Grace there will be one such skeleton half way down. You can watch how this skeleton moves and attacks to learn what to expect from them later on, move back up the stairs to make the fight more manageable.

Once at the bottom of the stairs you will find the locked doors of the catacombs, flanked by 2 statues. These doors will open when you use the lever found at the end of the catacombs, the doors lead to the final boss fight of the catacombs. On the left is the way forward down a short flight of stairs. At the bottom of these stairs are 2 more skeletons, one at the crossroad and one further down the tunnel who will start rolling towards you rapidly once they spot you. Again, moving up the staircase can help with the fight to bring them into a wider fighting area or help with kiting them.

The first left on this tunnel is the room sealed by an imp statue, use a Stonesword Key here to open the room. Inside you will find 2 skeleton enemies on the left side, on the body leaning against the tombstone in the room you will find the Rosus' Axe.

Heading forward will bring you to the room with multiple guillotines, as well as 2 skeleton archers. Running past this area will lead you to a corner room with another rolling skeleton and a ladder to go down to the sewer level. In the sewer level there are many small crabs that are non-hostile, they will drop crab eggs when killed. From here you can also see the lever below the lit statue kept behind the rusted bars, the way to get behind the bars is elsewhere. Going forward will trigger the Giant Crabs to rise up from the ground, one in front but also one behind the player. A Rune Arc is found at the end of the sewer area.

To advance in this Catacombs, the player has to go to the room with the multiple guillotines and then ride a guillotine blade upwards to land on the platform above. Kill the skeleton archers in the room to stop them interfering.
