In the tunnel connected to the platform above are 2 enemies in a small space, carefully dispatch them to proceed to a long and large room with many statues of Erdtree Burial Watchdogs and multiple enemies. Keep following the path and the wall at the end of the path will disappear when attacked, revealing the golden veil for the fight with the Black Knife Assassin. There is a Golden Summon Sign before the fight that will allow you to summon D, Hunter of the Dead to cooperate with you for this fight. There are certain conditions for the summon sign to appear: It seems you must be on this stage of Rogier's quest, have completed D's quest and then have spoken with D about Rogier's quest.

On the right side of the room with the vanishing wall is a small shaft behind a Grave Glovewort. Falling down this shaft will put the player at the lever to open the locked catacomb doors. There you will find the Ghost Glovewort as well as two skeleton enemies and the lever to open the rusted gate to lead you out.
BOSS BATTLE: Black Knife Assassin

For this fight, using the Golden Summon Sign and bringing D will greatly ease the fight by having another character tanking and being focused by the boss. The Black Knife Assassin boss is fast moving, dodging many attacks as they move. They have 2 distinct attacks that are easy to predict and dodge. When their arm glows red they will fire out a red projectile at the player, they also occasionally jump up high with a large jumping attack that is easily sidestepped. Defeat this boss to obtain the Assassin's Cerulean Dagger as well as the Black Knifeprint and 3150 Runes.
BOSS BATTLE: Cemetery Shade

The fight with the Cemetery Shade features multiple skeleton enemies that assist the boss. The fight can get very dangerous when surrounded by them and hit with the green projectile from the boss, binding the player in place. The Cemetery Shade boss also has short blinks that allow it to dodge attacks as it approaches the player to attack in melee. Position yourself around the pillars to use them to absorb the binding projectiles as these move quite fast and may be hard to dodge naturally. Defeating this boss will reward you with the Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes as well as 3500 Runes. There is a chest in the room with a Deathroot found inside.

title: Church of Inhibition
text: The church is found at the top of the hill. Upon arriving, the body of a finger maiden can be found on a chair by the statue where you can obtain their armor (Finger Maiden Set) and a Sacred Tear. During your first arrival, be sure to reach the Site of Grace first, as soon after you will be attacked by an invader, Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Defeating Vyke will reward you with his weapon, Vyke's War Spear, and a Fingerprint Grape, which is necessary for advancing Hyetta's questline.

place.title: Church of Inhibition
notes: Caution should be taken upon approaching the church's perimeter, Festering Fingerprint Vyke will invade. They're a relatively tough enemy and will inflict madness build-up with ranged, AOE and physical spear attacks. The fight is made worse should the player stray too close to the Frenzy-Flaming Tower east of the church. It's recommended to disable this tower first.

title: Bellum Church
text: The Bellum Church can be found in the North side of the Liurnia of the Lakes region. Players can reach the Bellum Church either by going up the ramp on the west of the church, going through the valley and the watery areas of the north part of the lakes then up the ramp, or by following the east path atop the cliffs. Around the outskirts of the Church are many Cuckoo Knight enemies and even a Night's Cavalry that roams once the sun has set. Come in the evening time to defeat the Night's Calvary and obtain Ash of War: Giant Hunt as a boss drop. Pick up the Sacred Tear found in the front of the church amongst the flowers directly in front of the main statue piece.

place.title: Bellum Church
notes: Bellum Church is very clearly built on top of a prior structure, which you can see as the Church foundation is sitting on top of a larger foundation which you can descend through on the left side of the Church. The stone slabs from this prior structure do not match the Church slabs.

title: Frenzied Flame Village
text: Directly to the north of the Village is a crumbling tower with six Frenzied Villagers at the top. Every few seconds, a ball of fire appears above them and begins to inflict Madness on you if there is nothing solid blocking your line of sight to it. Killing the villagers at the top of the tower will stop this flame from appearing. In order to reach the top of the tower, you can either make your way to the base of the tower and climb the ladders to the top floor, or ride the wind gust that is on a lower cliff directly to the north of the tower. The path leading to this wind is west of the tower, tucked between two small cliffs. Note that Madness will continue to be applied to you while you are on top of the tower as long as any of the villagers are still alive. This can be avoided by taking cover one floor down from the top floor, then climbing the ladder as the flame begins to fade.
Nearby, players can obtain an incantation Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab. ]

It is possible that Vyke will not invade the player. Currently (March 16, 2022), and the cause is unknown. It is possible that a certain "trigger" is preventing Vyke from invading. This could be killing a certain boss, clearing a certain dungeon, advancing another NPC’s questline beyond a specific point, or having a specific item in the inventory. There have been numerous reports in comments and other forums about what this possible "trigger" is, but they have all been contradicted by other users.

Approaching from the Northern entrance, you'll find a Note: The Lord of the Frenzied Flame around the corner from the crumbling wall. Moving clockwise along the wall, there is a Frenzied's Cookbook (1). On the porch of the house adjacent to the three armor-clad, frenzied soldiers is Shabriri's Woe. Atop the wall at the south is a Stonesword Key.

title: Investigate Ainsel River (Underground)
text: To reach the underground section, you'll need to ride the lift from the Ainsel River Well that will take you down.. Beware tho that there is a single Golem enemy that is guarding this location. Once the Golem has been defeated simply walk through the entrance of the building to find a lever on the right wall and the elevator in the center of the building. Stepping on the button in the middle of the elevator will lower you down into the Ainsel River underground region.

From the Ainsel River Well Depths Site of Grace, you will see multiple Giant Ants clinging to the wall. Ignore them for a second and go right to pick up x3 Magic Grease. Now face the Ants. You can lure them down by approaching slowly, but you probably won't be able to fight them one by one. Try attacking them from range to achieve that. Go into the tunnel and pick up x8 Grace Mimic.

There is a single ant waiting to the right just past the item to ambush you. Head into the left corridor to find Smithing Stone (3). Along the way, more ants will be crawling out of the ground, or sneak up on you from behind. There is a total of at least 4 ants here, which can be fought individually. Head back to the main path, and this time, two Ants will drop down from above. There is an open cave ahead containing minor items and another Smithing Stone (3), guarded by an Ant in the far left corner.

Go right to find another room with Ghost Glovewort (1), x10 Shattershard Arrow (Fletched), and yet another Smithing Stone (3). Go up the stairs and cross the bridge to find the Ainsel River Sluice Gate Site of Grace. Go back and this time take the left path past the Smithing Stone, jumping up on the two stone ledges. You will enter a room with many ants on the ceiling and a bloated one in the center. It drops a Golden Rune (10) and a Rune Arc. Go straight ahead until you reach the Uhl Palace Ruins.

place.title: Ainsel River
walk: ## Ainsel River Well Depths

From the Study Hall Entrance Site of Grace, summon your mount and head north following the road. Once you reach the area, you'll encounter a Golem guarding the elevator. You can skip past the golem and enter the elevator; the door will automatically open once you go near it. Step on the mechanism to activate the elevator, it will bring you down to Ainsel River.

Once you reach the bottom of the well, touch the site of grace. You'll see a group of Giant Ants clinging to a wall. Ignore them for now and turn right, you'll see a Golden Rune [3] on the ground. Pick it up and head straight from your position down a tunnel. At the edge of the waterfall, there's a corpse, pillage the remains to get Magic Grease x3. There's a Giant Ant overhead that will drop down and attack you on your way out.

Head back to the cave where you saw the Giant Ants clinging to the wall. Bait them one by one or aggro them, using an AoE spell/incantation or Ash of War to quickly finish them off. Flame of the Redmanes, for example, can kill them in one hit. Enter the cave and pillage the corpse for Grace Mimic x8. Be careful, there is one ant waiting to the right just behind the wall ready to ambush you. As you move forward another ant will come up, kill it and turn left, there are two more ants there. Once you get past them, there's a Smithing Stone [3] x1.

Now go back to the main path, there will be two more ants that will drop down from above. Once you get past them you'll see a Silver Firefly x2 on the left side and a Golden Rune [1] x1 by the corpse. On the left side you'll see an ant guarding a corpse holding an item, kill the ant and pillage the corpse for a Smithing Stone [3].

Now jump up and continue following the path. You'll come across a Queen Ant with 7 ants on the ceiling abover her. Killing the queen will drop a Rune Arc x1 and a Golden Rune [10] x1. Eliminate the ants, then backtrack to where you obtained the Silver Firefly earlier. There's a path beyond the room with the Queen Ant, but we will come back to that later. You'll notice there's another path, turn left and continue following that path until you see the end of the tunnel. Immediately you'll spot a Ghost Glovewort [1] by the pillar, and just behind it is a corpse holding a Shattershard Arrow (Fletched) x10. On the left corner there's another corpse holding a Smithing Stone [3].

Once you've gathered the items, head up the stairs and go straight to activate the site of grace in the area. Then turn back and enter the room just beside the site of grace, step on the mechanism to activate the elevator and head down to the Uhl Palace Ruins.
## Uhl Palace Ruins

Once you reach the area, jump down the right side and hug the wall on your right and move forward, you'll see a corpse holding a Golden Rune [1]. There's a group of Clayman in the area. Now head up and on the left side, another corpse can be spotted, pillage the corpse to obtain a Golden Rune [3]. Hug the wall on your left to obtain a Smithing Stone [1]. More Claymen will be seen in the area, using a high level AoE spell/incantation will do the trick and one-shot these opponents. On the right side you'll spot another corpse holding a Golden Rune [2]. Just behind the wall is another Ghost Glovewort [1]. From here, you'll see two items above you but to get them, you will need to backtrack to where you encountered the Queen Ant earlier and follow that path. Once you reach the edge, jump down, you'll see a corpse, pillage the remains to obtain a Smithing Stone [4]. then jump down the platform below, another corpse lays there holding a Celestial Dew. Then you can jump down and head to the entrance.

More clayman will be present in the hallway. Once you reach the end of the hallway, you will immediately spot multiple items on the ground, but be quick to take cover as a Malformed Star will start shooting at you. The items you will obtain from the corpses on the stairs are a Furcalling Finger Remedy, Throwing Dagger x6, Magic Grease x2, and a Golden Rune [3]. Ignore the Claymen at your left for now and turn right, a group of Claymen will also be present, you can try to run past them or you can use a one-hit AoE spell/incantation or AoW to get past them. Go up the stairs and pillage the corpse there to obtain another Golden Rune [3]. There will be three Claymen by the stairs, you can just run past them. Be wary of the Malformed Star as it will keep shooting you once it sees you out of a cover. Continue running until you go under the Malformed Star and reach a ruin, enter the ruin and you will encounter a the Hermit Merchant Ainsel River. But first, pick up the Map: Ainsel River from the corpse by the pillar on your right. This merchant sells the Prisoner Set, Gravity Stone Fan, Gravity Stone Chunk, Lost Ashes of War, a Celestial Dew, Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [16], and the Perfumer's Cookbook [4].

Now turn back and head to the previous hallway, as you make your way through you'll see a corpse holding a Shield Grease. After reaching the end of the hallway, turn left: there's a path there leading to a tunnel on the left. Enter the tunnel, and at the end of it you can see a broken pillar, which you can use to platform up to reach the Malformed Star. On the left side is a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [1] x3. Heading up, jump to the right platform to pillage the corpse holding a Smithing Stone [3]. Loot these now, unless you want to circle all the way around after defeating the Malformed Star. Jump back to the previous platform and make your way to the edge on the right and hug the wall. It may be impossible to fully dodge the rocks that the Malformed Star will sling at you, so just keep rolling if you can't find cover before it starts its next attack. Then make your way up, and jump down to fight the Malformed Star. You can use the pillars as cover for when it starts shooting again.

You can jump down the edge on the right corner, then jump down again and you'll see a corpse, pillage the remains to obtain Smithing Stone [3] x3. Jump down again and hug the wall on the right and you'll eventually encounter a site of grace. Continue following the path and you'll encounter a couple of Giant Ants in the area, you can sneak attack them to avoid direct confrontation. There are also some items on the ground like a Formic Rock, Smithing Stone [2] x3, an Immunizing Horn Charm, and Crystal Dart x5. Follow the left path ahead, there's another Formic Rock on the right and on the left are two Basilisks, you can take them by surprise as they have their back turned against you. There will be two more Basilisks up front as you make your way through, there will also be more Formic Rocks present in the area. As you move forward, there's a Formic Rock on the right, just behind it is another Basilisk guarding a corpse, pillage its remains to obtain Soap x4. At the edge of the cliff you'll see a couple of Aeonian Butterflies and a corpse holding a Somber Smithing Stone [3].

Now head back to the previous area where you sneaked up on some Giant Ants, then turn left. There are three more Giant Ants in the area, you can also sneak up on each of them as they are not that close to each other and all of them have their backs turned against you. Continue moving forward then turn left on the first corner, there's a corpse holding Melted Mushroom x3. Turn around and head straight, there's a Ghost Glovewort [2]. Turn around again and head right. At the end of the tunnel, you will encounter Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella, this will be a boss fight, to learn more about strategies and tactics on how to defeat this boss, visit its page right here.

Once you've beaten the boss, you'll receive the Frozen Lightning Spear Incantation and gain 12,000 Runes, a site of grace will also appear. Now head inside the tower and open the chest to obtain the Great Ghost Glovewort.

Now fast travel to Ranni's Chamber and go down stairs. Once you're outside, summon your mount and continue heading north-east to reach Renna's Rise. Go inside and climb up the ladder and go upstairs. Use the waygate to fast travel to the Ainsel River Main.
## Ainsel River Main

Once you've been transported, head straight and you'll see a tomb, pick up the item and you'll obtain Miniature Ranni. There's a lot of Silver Fireflies in the area, along the way you'll discover a site of grace. Rest at this site of grace and then choose the option to "Talk to miniature Ranni" and it will initiate a dialogue.

Get up and head straight until you reach Uhl Palace Ruins again, you will encounter another Malformed Star, use the pillars as cover when it starts shooting at you. Slay the Malformed Star and you will obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [7]. On the left area there's a corpse holding a Golden Rune [7], turn right and you will see another corpse holding a Smithing Stone [4], then up the stairs is another corpse holding a Human Bone Shard, which is being guarded by one Clayman.

Now go towards the Giant Miranda Flower, just beside it is a corpse holding a Stonesword Key. Head towards the waterfall, be wary of two clayman in the area, go to the right side corner of the waterfall, you can pick up the Clayman Ashes there.

Turn back and find the tunnel that leads down where you'll see two Formic Rocks on the right side. Enter the tunnel and in the middle, there's a corpse on the left side, you can pick up a Stimulating Boluses from that corpse. There's also two Giant Ants that will drop from above. Continue heading down and you'll see two Winged Ants, each guarding a corpse that holds items, the one on the left holds a Golden Run [10] x8, and the one on the right holds Shield Grease x2. Then a Shield Ant can be seen blocking the path ahead.

Continue heading down and you'll see a a Starcaller at the edge, you can perform a backstab to instantly kill the enemy or deal crit damage. There's a couple of Formic Rocks on the left side. Turn right and you'll see another Starcaller, kill it to get past, now hug the wall on your left and continue moving forward then jump down, move forward and jump up the platform, then walk towards the pillar and you'll see a chest in the middle, opening it will give you the Wing of Astel.

Go back and jump up the platform and hug the wall on your left, you'll see a corpse at the edge holding a Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Jump down and go back up the tunnel where you encountered Winged Ants.
Once you reach that area, turn left and go down the path, then enter the hallway on the left, from here you have already reached Nokstella, Eternal City.
## Nokstella, Eternal City

Jump down twice, then you'll immediately see a site of grace in the area. There is a Magic Grease x3 in the ruins directly to the left. Now go to your right and hug the wall towards your right and cross the stream of water, you will encounter a Nox Swordstress mounted on a Giant Ant, skip past this or kill it, then proceed going forward, you'll encounter two more Nox Swordstress in the area beside a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [6]. There's also another corpse in the area holding a Drawstring Holy Grease x2.

Go over to the cliff on the right and stay on the edge, continue following the path and you'll encounter a corpse holding a Silver Tear Husk x3. Turn around and hug the wall on your right while moving forward, then turn right, you'll see a group of Serpent Snails in the area guarding a corpse that holds a Celestial Dew.

Head south-east then go up the main stairs, then turn left and enter the room where you'll see a Nox Swordstress guarding a chest that contains the Ant's Skull Plate. Then go back outside and continue heading back up stairs, there's a Night Maiden guarding a corpse holding Fan Daggers by the right handrail of the stairs. Continue heading up and you'll encounter Silver Tears in the area.

At the top of the stairs, turn left and go around the building hug the outer right wall. At the end of the path there's a corpse holding Archer Ashes. Go back to the building and enter the room, more Silver Tears will await for you in the area. Inside the room there's a chest containing Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2].

Go outside and continue following the path, you'll encounter another corpse holding a Golden Rune [10] by the right side of the hallway. Be wary of the Silver Tear that will drop from above. Enter the room on your left, there's a chest that contains a Somber Smithing Stone [7].

Go outside and head up the stairs and go left, you'll have to use a Stonesword Key to enter the mist. Once inside you will encounter two Nox Monks guarding a chest containing the Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets.

Head outside, on the bridge a giant Silver Sphere will try to roll at you. You can use the statue on the bridge to stop the sphere from rolling, then you can proceed to attack it until it dies. There's a corpse on the bridge holding a Golden Rune [10]. Now cross the bridge and enter the building on the right. There's a chest inside containing a Great Ghost Glovewort, a Silver Sphere will spawn upon entering the room. You can use the chest to momentarily stop the sphere from completely rolling at you, then you can proceed to attack it.

Go back outside, turn right and head up the stairs. There's a corpse on the left handrail holding a Golden Rune [10]. Once you reach the top turn right and then left, there's a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [6] by the door. Now go back outside and head to the room with an open door, Silver Tears will drop from above, and behind them is a chest containing the Somber Smithing Stone [7]. Take the exit on your right and at the end of the bridge is a Teardrop Scarab, kill it to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [6].

Continue going up the stairs and enter the room. You will encounter two Silver Tears that will transform into humans and will start attacking you once you get close enough, there's also a Nox Swordstress inside. The chest at the end of the room contains the Moon of Nokstella.

Take the exit on the left side of the room and drop down. Enter the building you see and step on the mechanism to trigger the elevator, it will bring you down. Upon reaching the bottom, you'll see an illusory tree, pick up the Golden Seed beside it. Face north and drop to the edge, you'll see a corpse holding a Stonesword Key. You are done now and can warp to the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace. Select the option "Talk to Ranni" while resting there, if you want to follow her questline.

There is a Ghost Glovewort [9] to to the left of the elevator you came down with, then go through the tunnel. There are three Basilisks here, as well as a Smithing Stone [4] and Smithing Stone [5]. Defeating the Baleful Shadow here grants you the Discarded Palace Key to be used in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Go inside, take the elevator down and touch the Lake of Rot Shoreside Site of Grace. You are now done with Nokstella, see Lake of Rot for details on how to get through there.

title: Uhl Palace Ruins
text: To the right, you can see the elevator that is next to the previous site of grace. Walk across the stone arcs and loot a Smithing Stone (4), then jump down to the left for a Celestial Dew. Ideally, take out the Clayman from above, or try Guerilla tactics; they are fairly slow. Pick up some tier 1 upgrade materials on the ground, as well as small Golden Runes and Formic Rock. Go to the right past a statue and follow the river. you will see more ruins and more Clayman. Be careful and take cover since a Malformed Star will start shooting at you. Duck behind the various pillars, picking up a Ghost Glovewort (1) and Smithing Stone (1) x3 from a corpse on the ledge.

You can also leave these for now and come back after you have taken out the Malformed Star. Make your way across the pillars to the ruins on the left, then follow the path up to the Malformed Star. After defeating it, drop down to the left (facing the "tower"), the fall is lethal otherwise. Make your way inside the ruin to find the Nomadic Merchant who sells some cookbooks, Lost Ashes of War, and another Celestial Dew. Pick up the Map from a corpse on the right. Go back out and to the right to pick up x3 Smithing Stone (3) and drop down to find the Ainsel River Downstream Site of Grace.

Now clean up the loot in the area, there should be two Golden Rune (3) and Ghost Glovewort (1) and (2) on the far side and along the river, a Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Throwing Dart, Magic Grease x2, and another Golden Rune (3) on the central stairs. Up the stairs and to the right there is Shield Grease in a corner.

Head back to the site of grace and further downstream the river to find another room with multiple Ants. On the left, you can find the Immunizing Horn Charm, x5 Crystal Dart, and x3 Smithing Stone (2). Continue this way and be ready for two Basilisks to the left, two more up ahead, and another one to the right further down the tunnel. The last one guards x4 Soap.

Go to the end for a nice view of the Lake of Rot. You can also pick up some Aeonian Butterflies and a Somber Smithing Stone (3) here. Head back into the Ant cave and pick up Ghost Glovewort (1) and Ghost Glovewort (2). If there are Ants remaining here, make your way past them, then head left to pick up Melted Mushroom x3. Turn the other way and pick up another Ghost Glovewort (2), then get ready to face the boss, Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella, by entering the tunnel to the left. Defeating the boss rewards you with Frozen Lightning Spear and 12,000 Runes in hand - don't forget to check the chest inside a room underneath the massive skeleton and throne to find the Great Ghost Glovewort - for now, there's nothing else that can be done in this zone right now so we'll head back up to Liurnia of the Lakes and explore its western shores.

place.title: Uhl Palace Ruins
walk: See Ainsel River for the southern part and Ainsel River Main for the northern part.

title: Seek the Converted Tower
text: ## Liurnia of the Lakes: West
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (West) Points of Interest
Clear out the Village of the Albinaurics
Complete other Locations
Visit The Four Belfries
Meet Smithing Master Iji
Complete Caria Manor
Meet Renna and her Allies
Complete Siofra River (Underground)
## Folly on the Lake - Site of Grace

If you were following our walkthrough, you've just returned from the underground map and completed some parts of it within Ainsel River. For this section, we will guide you to exploring the west section of Liurnia of the Lakes before we proceed onto the next region which is Caelid. We suggest that you start at the Folly on the Lake Site of Grace and work your way from the bottom to the top ( Elden Ring Map: Liurnia of the Lakes West Starting Point). Take note that it's entirely up to you on which location you want to complete first, you can always check the interactive Elden Ring Map to find what you need - now, your first stop, the Village of the Albinaurics.

Along the way, you will pass by a swamp that is filled with poison, so we highly recommend that you travel to the village on mount. From the site, you can find the village on the southwest side of the map. As you travel by mount, simply move northwest and run alongside the cliff. Remain on the left side, pass through a swamp section, and just ignore the enemies you run into until you reach the distressed village. You'll know when you're near once you reach the swamp section and upon going up to a rise of the land - the name of the location will appear upon formally arriving at the village.

There are some locations near the Village of the Albinaurics that you can also visit before you continue exploring the northwest side of the Liurnia Map, but some can only be accessed if you've made significant progress to Ranni's questline:

Chelona's Rise: A tower found in the very corner of the upper plateau in Liurnia's southwest. This tower is initially sealed, with an imp statue at the entrance holding a glowing book, instructing you to "seek three great wise beasts". See the tower's page for details. You can find the sorcery spell, Ranni's Dark Moon in a chest at the top of this tower. Nearby is the Altar South Site of Grace as well.
Moonfolk Ruins: A ruins section where you can gather some materials and find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Lunar Estate Ruins: The ruins of a large estate found in the southern plateau of Liurnia, accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. Once accessible, you can find a Golden Rune [8] in this ruins location.

Cathedral of Manus Celes: Located at South West Liurnia of The Lakes. Accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. You can find the Glintstone Dragon Adula roaming around only if you've dealt enough damage to it at its initial location in Three Sisters.
## Seek the Converted Tower

Return to the Folly on the Lake Site and this time, head west, before you reach the tower, you should find a Teardrop Scarab near the edge of the cliffs that drop a Somber Smithing Stone [2]. You should find the entrance of the Converted Tower, use the Erudition Gesture in front of the statue for the ladder to appear. Climb to the top to find a Memory Stone. The Erudition Gesture is obtained by giving Thops the second Academy Glintstone Key at the Church of Irith. Alternatively, if you don't have the Erudition gesture unlocked yet and you're skilled enough on horseback, the puzzle can be skipped by using Torrent to climb the wall surrounding the tower. Then just jump up on the balcony in the back and jump off Torrent - also don't forget to discover the site of grace of this tower.

place.title: Converted Tower
walk: There are a few items to be gathered at the Converted Tower. You can find a Cuckoo Glintstone just as you enter the tower. In between the tower and the walls behind it, there is a Magic Grease to be found.
You can find a Memory Stone at the top of the tower. The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue to find out what the puzzle is.

If you don't have the Erudition gesture unlocked yet and you're skilled enough on horseback, the puzzle can be skipped by climbing the broken stone wall on the sides of the tower (either on foot or by horse) and then using Torrent to jump into the balcony from the back. While the climb up the wall can be done on foot, you must use Torrent's double jump to reach the balcony.
Once you reach the balcony simply climb up the steps to reach the room at the top, with the chest in the middle of it.
After collecting the Memory Stone, the seal on the door should release.
notes: Converted Tower appears to be very frequently mistaken for the Converted Fringe Tower, that is located northwest of Liurnia of the Lakes near the Black Knife Catacombs. This tower contains the sorceries Cannon of Haima and Gavel of Haima instead of the Memory Stone.

If you choose to use Erudition, note that it takes several seconds before the ladder appears, so just let the gesture animation keep going and don't end it prematurely until you see the ladder materialize.

title: Village of the Albinaurics
text: The Village of the Albinaurics can be located at the northwest section of the map from Stormveil Castle and the nearest starting point to travel to the village is at the Liurnia Lake Shore site. As you travel by mount, simply move northwest and run alongside the cliff. Remain on the left side, pass through a swamp section, and just ignore the enemies you run into until you reach the distressed village. You'll know when you're near once you reach the swamp section and upon going up to a rise of the land - the name of the location will appear upon formally arriving at the village.

As you enter, move towards the house, check behind it to find the Village of the Albinaurics Site. Discover and rest here before you start to explore. Now, clear this section first around the house where the player will encounter First-Generation Albinaurics. Make sure to also loot the body near a stone coffin to obtain a Larval Tear, and grab the materials around to find Mushroom and Rowa Fruit. Next, turn around and heap up the hill where you'll encounter a single Depraved Perfumer, killing it may drop 5x Budding Cave Moss. If you walk forward, passing the two houses, on the right side, you'll see a disguised NPC. This turns out to be Albus, who will give you an important key item for your journey. Hit the pot to reveal him.

Before exhausting his dialogue, he will give you a key item, the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). Speak to him again, exhaust his lines, and he will eventually die due to old age. Before you continue towards the boss, make sure to check behind the stone coffin next to Albus, there's another corpse that you can pillage to acquire an Ivory Sickle. If you don't need to rest at the site, you can proceed to the boss by crossing the stone bridge on this hill.

As you cross, you'll see a golden teardrop scarab. Make sure to kill it before it disappears. On the other side, you'll see a willow tree and a bonfire. The Omenkiller boss is there, as well as a few Rotten Stray. We suggest that you kill the hounds first so that you can fight the boss one on one. Instead of going down the slope, straight to the bonfire, jump down from the right side of the cliff and kill the Rotten Stray. Once the area is clear, then you can approach the bonfire and fight the Omenkiller.

You can visit the Omenkiller page to find more information about this boss, as well as guides and strategies on how to defeat this enemy. Successfully killing this boss yields 4900 Runes and drops the Crucible Knot Talisman. Make sure to also check the right side of this small arena and you will another body at the end of the path, pillage it to find a Rune Arc.

Before you leave this location, there is just one more section you need to clear. Return to the site of the village, next to the house near it, you'll find a wooden bridge. Cross the wooden bridge, kill the First-Generation Albinaurics and make sure to loot the bodies here to find some items, as well as gathering Erdleaf Flower. One can be found resting by the tree trunk, loot it to acquire an Albinauric Bloodclot, while the other is near a ledge, pillage that body to find a Crystal Sword.

title: Minor Erdtree & Road's End Catacombs
text: Follow the road going north from the Converted Tower and you should find the Minor Erdtree for the southwest section of Liurnia. This section is guarded by an Erdtree Avatar and if you defeat it, you'll be able to acquire the Cerulean Crystal Tear and the Ruptured Crystal Tear.

Also, situated in between the Minor Erdtree and the Converted Tower, on the west side of the map, the Road's End Catacombs location can be found. Road's End Catacombs is a pretty straightforward dungeon, with just some slight changes to it. As you open the doors of the catacombs, head down the stairs and you will find the site of grace for the Road's End Catacombs. Make sure to discover it and rest if needed before exploring.

Just like the previous catacombs, this section is inhabited by Imps that love to hide around corners, on ceilings, walls, and are ready to ambush you. Head down the stairs and you will encounter the first Imp, grab x1 Grave Violet, and as you move towards the arched doorway, there is another Imp ready to ambush you on the right side corner. Get ready to dodge or put your shield up as soon as you approach the doorway. Before going down, make sure to pull the lever next to the reaper statue.

By the bush, you can gather some upgrade materials such as Grave Glovewort [2], continue going down, go straight, and you'll notice a dead end on the left. Look up, you'll find another Imp on the ceiling. Shoot it down, kill it and grab another Grave Glovewort [2] material. Be careful not to step on the pedestal that triggers arrows to shoot you. Grab the Grave Glovewort [2] on the right and another Grave Glovewort [3] ahead. Now you may think that there's nothing left to explore. But if you hit the wall of the dead-end where the Grave Glovewort [3] was, you'll reveal the illusory wall.

Beyond that path are more Imps inside a room that has an altar. Kill all the enemies and open the chest to find the Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes. Now, go back to that spot where you grabbed a few glovewort materials by the bush, there is another illusory wall next to the stairs that go back up. Kill the imp and grab some items here such as another Ghost Glovewort [2] and a Rune Arc. The path ahead is dark so equip a Torch if you're having a hard time seeing. Past the body that you just looted, move forward a bit and turn left, enter the narrow path and you'll find another body at a dead-end. Loot it to find x3 Root Resin.

Now, hit the wall in front of the body you just looted to reveal yet another illusory wall. Go down, grab another Grave Glovewort [2], and hit the illusory wall ahead to reveal another section behind it. You'll find the path that leads to the mini-boss of this location, the Spirit-Caller Snail. You can visit our Spirit-Caller Snail to find guides on how to defeat this boss - successfully defeating it drops the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3000 Runes.

place.title: Road's End Catacombs
walk: Road's End Catacombs is a pretty straightforward dungeon with 7 Illusory Walls. As soon as you enter, you will find the Site of grace. Keep going, and after facing a few Fanged Imps, you will find a lever. Pull it, then keep going, facing the little resistance you will find.

You will find several Grave Glovewort (2) to grab. When you reach the end, you'll notice that there is not much to do. Hit the wall at the very end to reveal a secret door. Beware of the Fanged Imps that are hiding on the back of the wall as soon as you enter.
Loot the final chest at the end of the tunnel to obtain a new Spirit Ashes called Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes.
## Another Secret Door

As you are making your way back to the entrance, at the bottom of the two sets of stairs leading to the exit, hit the archway next to the stairs to reveal a secret door with some Fanged Imps and the Watchdog's Staff and Grave Glovewort (3). Exit the hidden doorway and proceed up the first set of stairs. Once you are before the last set of stairs, head right and hit the second and fourth archway to reveal two secret doors. There is a single Fanged Imp as well as a Ghost Glovewort (2) and a Rune Arc to loot in the room on the left. Continue through the narrow path until you loot the Root Resin. Hit the wall in front of you to reveal another secret door. Keep going to obtain Grave Glovewort (2). Hit the wall to unveil ANOTHER secret door, which leads to a boss fight, the Spirit-Caller Snail. Defeat it to obtain the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3000 Runes.

title: Revenger's Shack - Edgar, the Revenger
text: Just north from the Minor Erdtree, you'll find the Revenger's Shack, if you followed the father-daughter questline of Irina and Edgar, resting at the shack's site will trigger a hostile NPC invader to appear, and this is Edgar the Revenger. Killing him drops the following: 316 Runes, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Shabriri Grape, Banished Knight's Halberd (+8), and x5 Raw Meat Dumpling.

place.title: Revenger's Shack
walk: Revenger's Shack is a minor location found north of the Minor Erdtree in southwest Liurnia. On your first visit, Edgar the Revenger will invade as soon as you touch the Site of Grace. Edgar is a straightforward fight as his moveset only includes physical attacks and he is easily staggered with magic. Upon defeat, he drops his halberd, a +8 variant of the Banished Knight's Halberd as well as a Shabriri Grape, a Furlcalling Finger Remedy and 5 Raw Meat Dumplings.
Inspecting the 5 corpses inside the shack will give you 5 more Raw Meat Dumplings.

title: Cuckoo's Evergaol
text: Continue moving north from the shack and you will find the Cuckoo's Evergaol. Cuckoo's Evergaol is located along Liurnia's western landmass, easily accessed on foot or horseback. This Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock. The portal mechanism in the center is active as soon as you enter the area. Enter the portal to challenge the boss within, Bols, Carian Knight.

Bols is a Troll Knight clad in Carian armor, wielding a massive greatsword. Due to his size, his movements are rather slow and his attacks have a hefty weight behind them. He compensates for this by frequently roaring, which not only increases his damage but releases a burst of pressure that staggers players. Be careful as he tends to combo into his attacks after a roar. Bols is tall enough that you can easily and safely dodge under his legs to avoid most of his attacks, but never take your eyes off him as he can quickly turn around for a devastating follow-up - successfully defeating this mini-boss drops the Greatblade Phalanx spell.

place.title: Cuckoo's Evergaol
walk: Cuckoo's Evergaol is located along Liurnia's western landmass, easily accessed on foot or horseback. This Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock. The portal mechanism in the center is active as soon as you enter the area. Enter the portal to challenge the boss within: Bols, Carian Knight.
Bols drops the Greatblade Phalanx spell upon defeat.

title: The Four Belfries
text: Continuing north from Cuckoo's Evergaol is The Four Belfries The Four Belfries is a hub for transporter waygates that lead to various locations. Each waygate requires an Imbued Sword Key to activate and is located at the foot of a belfry.

The First Belfry: The first waygate is located closest to the foot of the hill. This transports you to a small sub-area of the Crumbling Farum Azula containing the Pearldrake Talisman. You cannot access the rest of the region from this sub-area.

The Second Belfry: The second waygate is located further up the hill and to the east. This transports you to the Chapel of Anticipation, where you began the game. You can fight the first boss here which is the Grafted Scion.

The Third Belfry: The third waygate is located to the west of the second one. This transports you to an otherwise inaccessible location in Nokron, Eternal City, housing the Mottled Necklace and a Lesser Crucible Knight.

The Fourth Belfry: The final belfry is located at the peak of the hill. This belfry does not contain a waygate but instead houses a chest with an Imbued Sword Key in it. You can use this to open up any of the waygates of your choosing.

Other than that, make sure to activate the site of grace for this location. Once you're back or if you continue traveling, take the lower road north and loot the Hearse for the Carian Knight's Sword. And further ahead of the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore Site, you can find the map fragment for Map (Liurnia, West) by the monolith.

place.title: The Four Belfries
walk: Situated along a hill in western Liurnia, The Four Belfries serve as a hub for 3 waygates that transports users to various locations. Each waygate is located at the foot of a belfry and requires an Imbued Sword Key to activate.

The Second Belfry: The second waygate is located further up the hill to the east and is denoted by the message reading "Precipice of Anticipation". This transports you to the Chapel of Anticipation, the starting area of the game, to fight the Grafted Scion boss who drops Golden Beast Crest Shield and Ornamental Straight Sword, plus lootables: The Stormhawk King and the Stormhawk Deenh. Note: you are able to soak Lord of Blood's Favor in the blood of a deceased maiden near the starting area of the game, providing an alternative to going to the Church of Inhibition or killing Irina.

The Third Belfry: The third waygate is located further up the hill to the west and and is denoted by the message reading "Night Sky Unceasing". This transports you to an otherwise inaccessible location in Nokron, Eternal City, housing the Mottled Necklace and a Lesser Crucible Knight. The Knight does not drop any loot except for runes.

title: Kingsrealm Ruins
text: Just about northeast from where you got the map, you'll find the Kingsrealm Ruins, this ruins location hosts a hidden, underground area where the optional boss Royal Revenant can be fought The stairs leading down into this area is covered by an illusory floor. You can find this in the northeast section of the ruins. The floor needs to be rolled on to dispel the illusion or hit with a melee weapon to be revealed. You can visit our Royal Revenant page to find our video guide, as well as a written strategy on how to defeat this mini-boss - successfully defeating the Royal Revenant rewards the player with 3,100 Runes, you'll also gain access to the room that holds a chest containing the Frozen Needle weapon.

place.title: Kingsrealm Ruins
walk: Kingsrealm Ruins hosts a hidden, underground area where the optional boss Royal Revenant can be fought. The stairs leading down into this area is covered by an illusory floor. You can find this in the northeast section of the ruins. The floor needs to be rolled on to dispel the illusion or hit with a melee weapon to be revealed.
Royal Revenant is a very quick and agile multi-limbed creature that can teleport around the arena and release a toxic breath in a long, straight line ahead of it.

Defeating the Royal Revenant does not drop anything other than runes. However you do gain access to the small room at the end of the hall. There is a chest inside that contains the Frozen Needle rapier.
notes: Approximate location of the passage:

title: Testu's Rise
text: ## Testu's Rise Where to Find Three Wise Beasts
The entrance to Testu's Rise is initially sealed by a barrier. By the entrance, you will find an imp statue holding a glowing book that asks you to "Seek three wise beasts".

These beasts are represented as Ghostly Tortoises that spawn somewhere in the area. Each Tortoise needs to be found and attacked in order to break parts of the seal. This is the same challenge as the one at Oridys's Rise at the Weeping Peninsula except this time, a large number of Ghostly Skeletons will also spawn to hinder your progress.
The first Tortoise can be found by the cliffs northwest of the tower on the same level.
The second Tortoise is found high up on one of the trees east of the tower. Use a ranged or magical attack to hit it, and it will fall from the tree and die of fall damage.
The final Tortoise is to the southeast of the tower on a ledge halfway down the cliff.
If players rest at a Site of Grace before all of the Tortoises are killed, they may have to activate the book statue again to spawn the remaining Tortoise(s).
Go back to the now-opened door, and climb up the ladder.

When you reach the top of the ladder, turn right, and proceed up the stairs. You'll see a room with a chest in the middle of it containing a Memory Stone which increases your Memory Slots by one, allowing for the memorization of more Sorceries or Incantations.

title: Meet Smithing Master Iji
text: From the Kingsrealm Ruins, continue moving north and you can find Smithing Master Iji. This blacksmith sells Upgrade Materials such as Somber Smithing Stone [1] through [4]. This blacksmith is a gentle giant in charge of the smithing for the Carian royals, but will also provide his services to players. Make sure to talk to him when you see him. Your next step is to head to the Caria Manor, but we'll just note down some things for you:

Acquire the Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear: From Road to the Manor Site of Grace, head southeast down the slope and turn back towards the north. Loot from a small, half-bowl structure guarded by a few Lesser Spider Hand and one Spider Hand enemies.

Seluvis's Rise: One of three towers found in the Three Sisters sub-region. Three Sisters is accessible after completing Caria Manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta. So return here when you're done with Caria Manor.

place.title: War Counselor Iji
notes: Iji is the first Troll capable of speaking to the player in the game.
His helm is similar to the Nox Mirrorhelm and serves the same purpose.
He uses a Troll's Hammer to smith weapons.

title: Complete Caria Manor of Liurnia
text: Caria Manor is a major dungeon comprised of a very large estate, overlooking the lakes from the north. Its eternal warden, Royal Knight Loretta fervently guards the manor. The large estate can be found in Liurnia of the Lakes, far to the north. We will include a quick run-through of the paths to take to get to the boss of this location, as well as important landmarks. You can, however, visit the Caria Manor page for a more in-depth guide such as a list of items found in this location and more.

Caria Manor is accessed from its main gate in the south. Before the constant bombardment of glintstone arrows as you approach the gate. The estate's guardian is constantly bombarding the fields outside the manor to deter would-be trespassers. Once you reach the Site of Grace at the main gate, you are safe from these bombardments. When traversing the estate grounds, watch out for Glintstone traps. These are swords buried in the ground which spring a projectile trap that shoots a glintstone projectile upwards when walked on. These traps knock players away which is especially dangerous when on the higher levels of the estate.

The southernmost area of the estate is the Gardens. This is a very large courtyard infested with Spider Hands and their smaller counterparts. Be very careful when walking around the gardens as these Spider Hand enemies can cling to the walls of buildings, dropping down onto unsuspecting targets. They can also burrow into the ground and emerge only when prey is nearby.

The Chapel building is an important landmark found in the west of the Gardens. The upper level contains a Site of Grace and leads to the walkways in the gardens that will allow you to reach many different collectibles as well as progress to the manor's upper level. These walkways are guarded by Knight Spirits who appear as you move around the walkways. Be extra careful of glintstone traps up here as they can knock you back down to the gardens. Follow the walkways towards the east to reach a tower with a lift that will take you up to the Manor Upper Level.

The Manor Upper Level comprises the northern half of the estate. This area is raised high above the gardens and is guarded by Direwolves and Wandering Noble zombies. Past the Direwolves, you will find a large stone archway to the east. Beyond this is a long staircase leading up to the final area and boss. However, it is heavily guarded by Raya Lucarian soldiers and a Troll Knight. If you look to the south, there is a platform with a ladder that you can climb up which will allow you to circumvent all the enemies at the large staircase as you will wind up behind the troll. Consider using this path if you are rushing through or don't want to face a large group of hostiles. Behind the troll are more staircases to the left and right, each with a Page enemy.

At the very top of the staircases, you can look to the south to find a hole in the wall. This leads to an area outside with wooden platforms along the walls which you can jump down from to reach the cliffside graveyards. There are some collectibles to be found along these cliffs and they are guarded by Living Jar enemies.

Back at the staircase, continue on through the stone archway to find a large circular arena-like area surrounded by chairs. Once you step into the center of this area, Royal Knight Loretta will appear before you. She is the guardian of this manor and also the one bombarding the fields outside with arrows. She uses a combination of glintstone sorcery spells and polearm attacks in combat. Defeating her awards the Loretta's Greatbow sorcery spell as well as the Ash of War: Loretta's Slash - defeating Loretta will spawn a Site of Grace in her arena and allow you access to the back of the manor.
## Meeting Renna and her Allies

Upon completing Caria Manor, your next destination will be Ranni's Rise but be wary since you may come across the Glintstone Dragon Adula, you don't have to fight this dragon, it's optional, and up to you. At Ranni's Rise, go all the way to the top and talk to Ranni the Witch to begin her questline: The Hidden Treasure of Nokron. Take her request and she will ask you to talk to three people who are in her service, these Are Seluvis, War Counselor Iji, and Blaidd who will appear in spectral form. These three will then appear in a spectral form on the first floor of her tower - talk to Ranni again after speaking to everyone to leave.

Now, moving forward, we will guide you to complete this quest. Blaidd will be waiting in the Siofra River area and will reveal that he suspects that Seluvis knows more than he lets on. Seluvis will inform you that Sorceress Sellen has some information, and provide you with Seluvis's Introduction. Sorceress Sellen then informs the player that Starscourge Radahn stopped the stars and that defeating him is the key to Nokron's secrets.

Therefore the first step is to visit Siofra and complete it. BE WARNED: if you follow Preceptor Seluvis's questline, you will betray Ranni and fail her quest. We will not do this on this walkthrough but you can read about it on his page: Preceptor Seluvis.

place.title: Caria Manor
walk: Caria Manor is accessed from its main gate in the south. Beware of the constant rain of glintstone arrows as you approach the gate. The estate's guardian is constantly bombarding the fields outside the manor to deter would-be trespassers. Once you reach the Site of Grace at the main gate, you are safe from these bombardments. When traversing the estate grounds, watch out for Glintstone traps. These are swords buried in the ground which spring a trap that shoots a glintstone projectile upwards when walked on. These traps knock players away which is especially dangerous when on the higher levels of the estate.
## Gardens

On the left side of the gardens, you'll find two corpses, one with five Rimed Crystal Buds and another with six Glintstone Fireflies. Walking up the middle stone pathway, you'll find a Golden Rune (4), two Somber Smithing Stone (2), and a Smithing Stone (2). The right side of the gardens is where the exciting loot is at. In a room within a ruin by the rightmost wall is the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (6). Further in the ruin, you'll find the Ice Crest Shield, and as you approach the middle pathway from here, you'll find a Teardrop Scarab that drops the Carian Piercer sorcery. You can also collect a total of five Rimed Crystal Buds from the corpses in the area. Follow the stone path northwest and you'll eventually get to the Chapel.
## Chapel

Here in the chapel, you can find a corpse behind the altar that has a Smithing Stone (4). Make sure you've grabbed the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace here then exit the chapel and cross the walkways until the path splits. Start by heading down the northern walkway. Follow the path to the end to find a Rune Arc. Look down to the northwest and jump down to the walls below. Jump down again to another section of the wall in the northwest, where you'll find a ladder going down. This ladder takes you to a small room with the Sword of Night and Flame in a chest. Open the door to the west and you'll find yourself in the gardens again.

Make your way back to the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace and follow the walkways again, this time taking the eastern walkway. After turning left at the corner, you'll see a flight of stairs leading to another building. Before jumping down, go straight to head up the stairs and take the lift mentioned earlier to get to the Manor Upper-Level Site of Grace and retrace your steps back. Right at the base of the stairs, look eastward and jump down to the lower section of the wall. Loot x8 Rimed Crystal Buds and head north, where you'll find a Golden Rune (3) under the wooden stairs, then run back up the stairs and start heading south. You'll reach a large open part of the walls with a few Fingercreepers. At the far end of this area is the Urumi. Grab it, then continue following the wall southwest. Defeat or run past the Abductor Virgin at the corner, jump down to the next open platform, and grab a Somber Smithing Stone (3) on a body hanging off of the ledge to the right. Head back to the Manor Upper Level Site of Grace.
## Manor Upper Level

The Manor Upper Level comprises the northern half of the estate. Grab the Site of Grace here then head out the western doorway. This will lead you to an area raised high above the gardens guarded by Direwolves and Wandering Noble zombies. You'll find a Golden Seed right in front of you, past the staircase. Follow the path northeast, but before going up the stairs, go around to the right to find a corpse with x3 Rimed Crystal Buds. Go up the stairs, and you will find a large stone archway to the northwest. Beyond this is a long staircase leading up to the final area and boss. However, it is heavily guarded by Lazuli Sorcerers and a Troll Knight. Take a left before going through the archway to find a ladder that will allow you to circumvent all the enemies at the large staircase. Kill the wandering noble at the top of the ladder and collect the x2 Magic Grease on the body around the corner to the right. Continue up the stairs and look out for the Wandering Noble; kill it and continue around the curve to the left. This will bring you out behind the Troll Knight. Consider using this path if you are rushing through or if you don't want to face a large group of hostiles.

If you choose to fight the Troll Knight, however, he drops his weapon, the Troll Knight's Sword. At the top of the middle staircase, turn hard right and follow the side of the wall northeast, jumping around the corner when you get there. If you jump down to the lower ledge, you'll be able to grab a Smithing Stone (4). Continue up the middle set of stairs, where you'll find more staircases to the left and right, each with a Page enemy. Five Rimed Crystal Buds can be found on a corpse on the left set of stairs.

At the very top of the staircases, immediately turn around and pick up the Golden Rune (4) on the corpse off of the ledge in the middle of the two staircases. Go south, past the remaining pages, and go through a hole in the wall. This leads to an area outside with wooden platforms along the walls which you can jump down from safely to reach the cliffside graveyards. At the bottom, sneak East, and grab the Cracked Pot on the ledge. Go west, through the Living Jars, and find x8 Crystal Darts on a corpse against a tombstone on the far side. Go east from this body and jump down to encounter two more Living Pots. Jump down another platform to the east and collect the Erdtree flower. Jump down yet another platform to encounter 2x large Living Jars and 4x small Living Jars. Behind the pair of large ones, on the right side, is a Smithing Stone (3). Jump down to yet another platform, and on the lowest level of the graveyard, look to the southwest and you'll find a ruined section of Caria Manor's walls you can jump down to. On the corpse hanging off of the ledge is the Ash of War: Carian Grandeur.

Back at the top of the staircases the Troll was guarding, continue through the stone archway to find a large circular arena-like area surrounded by chairs. Once you step into the center of this area, Royal Knight Loretta will appear before you. She is the guardian of this manor and also the one bombarding the fields outside with arrows. She uses a combination of glintstone sorcery spells and polearm attacks in combat. Defeating her awards the Loretta's Greatbow sorcery spell as well as the Ash of War: Loretta's Slash.
Defeating Loretta will spawn a Site of Grace in her arena and open up the way to the Three Sisters sub-region.
## Back of the Manor

After exiting out to Three Sisters, keep heading south, following the manor's walls and the cliffs, until you find a Cerulean Teardrop Scarab. From here, look east and drop down to the ruins of a castle wall below you. On the south side of this wall, you'll find wooden platforms leading east that you can safely drop onto. Scale down the ladder here, and you'll find yourself on the upper balcony of the Chapel you were in earlier. Here, you can find and speak to Pidia, as well as pick up a Spellproof Dried Liver.

Head back up the ladder, and climb onto the roof in front of you to find five Old Fangs. Look down to the southwest, and you'll be able to jump down safely to the wall section below you. Head southeast and down and to your left are some more wooden platforms you can jump down to. Grab the three Slumbering Eggs on a corpse here then jump down to another section of a ruined stone wall. If you head all the way southeast and follow the wooden platform, you'll get to a Giant Crab guarding a Stonesword Key.

title: Seluvis's Rise
text: When first arriving at the Three Sisters, the entrance to Seluvis's Rise is blocked by a barrier. It is unlocked only after speaking to Ranni the Witch atop Ranni's Rise in the northwest and subsequently being invited by Preceptor Seluvis.
Once invited, you will find Seluvis at the ground floor who hands you Seluvis's Potion and tasks you with finding a woman named Nepheli.
You can climb the ladder behind Seluvis to reach the top floor of his tower where you will find a chest with a Memory Stone inside.

Outside, in a ruin between Ranni's Rise and Renna's Rise, there is an illusory wall / floor on the ground, that can be opened by attacking or rolling on it. This leads to a bunch of frozen characters and a note that says "Seluvis' Puppet. Do not touch". There is another Illusory Wall just to the left of this that reveals what appears to be a puppet of Sorceress Sellen.

title: Ranni's Rise
text: Ranni's Rise is found to the west of the Three Sisters sub-region. When first entering the area, you may come across Renna's Rise and Seluvis's Rise but these two are blocked by a magical seal, preventing entry. The only tower accessible initially is Ranni's Rise. Head into the tower and up to the first floor to find its Site of Grace. Look for a lift on this floor which will take you to the top of the tower where you will meet Ranni the Witch.

Ranni will ask for your servitude and will set you off on a quest to find the hidden treasure of Nokron. (If she refuses to give you the quest, try returning to the Roundtable Hold to speak to Rogier once more.) She asks that you speak to three other persons in her service: Blaidd, War Counselor Iji, and Preceptor Seluvis. These three NPCs will then appear on the first floor (in spectral form as their actual locations are elsewhere). A fog wall will surround Ranni's Rise, temporarily turning it into a safe zone. Speak to all three of the aforementioned NPCs. Iji will simply acknowledge that you are both now in service of the Lady, while Blaidd will ask you to meet him in Mistwood at the Siofra River Well. Seluvis will ask that you meet him at his tower in the south. Oblige and return upstairs to speak to Ranni, and she will tell you that she will go into a deep slumber. This will remove the fog wall. Lastly, head to Seluvis's Rise to acquire a task from him.

place.title: Ranni's Rise
notes: Ranni's Rise is part of the Trio of locations aptly named as the Three Sisters, with connections towards Ranni the Witch. The other locations are Seluvis's Rise, where Preceptor Seluvis, an ally of Ranni, stays and Renna's Rise. Named after one of Ranni's alias they used. The Snow Witch Set is found on Renna's Rise, and it is speculated that it is the name of the Snow Crone Mentor that Ranni had.

Many of Ranni's loyal retainers, allies, and other characters related to her, like Blaidd, Preceptor Seluvis, and War Counselor Iji, make an appearance in the location, albeit spectrally. Considering this location, functionally the base of operations for Ranni, it only makes sense for her agents to show up here.

Ranni's Rise is the spot of many of the quest events relating to Ranni and the Age of Stars. Swearing fealty to Ranni happens here, for example. As you progress along Ranni's questline, you will most likely have to swing by Ranni's Rise multiple times to not only get the latest objectives on Ranni's plan but also explore the multitude of stories of her allies and their relationship to her. Some encounters with Blaidd, Preceptor Seluvis, and War Counselor Iji, especially on how they change both externally and internally as characters with the progression of Ranni's plan. As Ranni achieves her objectives with the help of the Tarnished, this will affect these three characters greatly, and Ranni's Rise is where you will be able to find out how much those effects really are. Conversely, it would also show the effects of Ranni's actions on her loyal retainers.

title: Explore Siofra River (Underground)
text: For this location, we highly recommend checking our interactive Elden Ring Map to check the items that can be found, as well as points of interest for the underground section. Elden Ring Map: Siofra River Starting Point. Head to Mistwood, go down Siofra River Well and make sure to discover the Site of Grace here if you haven't. The underground section is guarded by Ancestral Follower enemies and it is recommended that you take them out or try to take the advantage of dealing enough damage at a distance.

Some foraging for materials can be done here as well. One notable material you can acquire is a Golden Centipede which will be at the corner on some rubble when you approach the large statue. It is quite bright in color and hard to miss. Other materials can be forged around the grass and will have a glow for you to recognize them. Siofra River Well is also abundant in Dewkissed Herba.

On the upper levels, there will be a corpse draped over a wall gap. Loot it to gain Budding Horn x3. If you look at the stone wall of the ruins on the upper level, you'll notice they form stepping blocks that you can traverse the top of the walls. Carefully traverse the walls to get another Golden Centipede, and other items. You will also find two Ancestral Followers in front of a hole on the ground, after grabbing everything you can on the upper section, carefully drop into the hole to find a Teardrop Scarab that will drop the Oracle Bubbles, next to the scarab is a lootable corpse.

Continue onwards till you reach a large flight of stairs next to a waterfall. There will be another body draped over the handrail where you can obtain Golden Rune (4). Directly in the waterfall, you can also obtain Soap.

You can take the next lift to the next section, exit the lift at the top, turn north and run across the bridge walkway. Enter the structure, there will be a body containing Preserving Boluses. Under the bridge area, you can walk into the river, and on one of the bridge arches, you will find Beast Liver x3. Be careful progressing from here as you may encounter a Giant Crab, but nearby you should also be able to loot some Crab Eggs.

As you move forward you will run into an Obelisk where you can light the flame. If you head up on the rocks behind there will be an Ancestral Follower. Nearby, you can loot some remains to obtain Armorer's Cookbook (6) - the last large staircase lined with obelisks will lead to Hallowhorn Grounds.

Now, this area has a mechanic to summon a special boss: you must light altars scattered around the zone. There's a map of their location on the Siofra River page. You will find Blaidd standing near hallowhorn grounds, you can talk to him to advance his quest. You should then proceed to locate and activate the pillars in the area:
First Pillar is by the site of grace Siofra River Bank.
Second Pillar is in a corner west of the first pillar.
Third Pillar is on a small island in a watery area with lightning whisps.
Fourth Pillar is by a cliff on the eastern area of the map.
Fifth Pillar is just south of Worshipper's Woods site of grace.
Sixth Pillar is west of Worshipper's Woods site of grace.
Seventh Pillar is to the right on the path toward "Below the Well" site of grace.
Eight Pillar is on the left on the path toward "Below the Well" site of grace.

When all pillars are lit, you can now enter the arena of the Ancestor Spirit boss. The deer carcass at the back of the temple starts glowing and you can interact with it to teleport to the boss' area. You won't be thrown into battle as soon as you teleport, however, and will have to walk through a mist door to fight the boss. Make sure to visit our Ancestor Spirit page to find our different strategies and also a video guide on how to beat this boss - by defeating it, players are rewarded with 13000 Runes and the Ancestral Follower Ashes.

You can exit the area by interacting with a white teleporter in the middle of the arena you fought the boss in. It might be hard to spot due to the size of the arena, but won't miss it if you start with your back to the boss door and proceed forward. As you explore, you can also take a gateway ( see on map) to access the Dragonkin Soldier boss fight. This Great Enemy drops the Dragon Halberd, and players can loot the Marika's Scarseal talisman from nearby. Dropping down from here and going north will also bring you to a Golden Seed and the "Below the Well" site of grace.

place.title: Siofra River
walk: The first time you enter Siofra River is likely by taking the lift down the Siofra River Well in Mistwood. This area is intended for higher levels (50 - 60), with upgrades of +8 and above.

Right at the bottom, you'll find the Siofra River Well Depths Site of Grace and the area here can be looted for two Ghost Glovewort (1), a Smithing Stone (4), and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy. The ruin ahead and the cavern areas here are infested with Claymen. They move slowly but be careful when dealing with them in large numbers as they can easily swarm you. In the building and waterfall area here, you can find a Smithing Stone (2), two Smithing Stone (4), and a Ghost Glovewort (1). You can also scale the ruins to get to a Teardrop Scarab that drops Oracle Bubbles. Head into the intact building next to the waterfall area and you'll get taken up to the main section of Siofra River.

Walking forward, you'll eventually get to the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace. Directly east of this Site of Grace, you'll see a pillar with a brazier you can light up. This pillar is one of eight, and all of them are required to be lit to access the Ancestor Spirit boss fight. You can find the coordinates of all 8 pillars on our interactive map in the notes section below. Slightly south from this first pillar, you'll see a large temple ruin. That's the Hallowhorn Grounds and after you've lit all eight pillars, you can interact with the deer carcass inside to take you to the Ancestor Spirit. Make your way to the temple ruin to grab the Map (Siofra River) from the bottom of the staircase. You'll also find a Ghost Glovewort (2) here and the Horn Bow on the supporting structure underneath the Hallowhorn Grounds staircase.

With the map-making navigation easier, backtrack back to the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace and scale the cliff to the southwest to find the Inverted Hawk Heater Shield. The Armorer's Cookbook (6) can be found on a corpse west of the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace. The waygate here in the south just makes traveling to the northeastern side of Siofra River quicker but doesn't take you to any place inaccessible by foot. In the water-filled area to the northeast of this Site of Grace, you can find many upgrade materials, including a Somber Smithing Stone (2), Smithing Stone (2), and Ghost Glovewort (2). Besides these, you can also find a Furlcalling Finger Remedy within a group of Land Octopuses and a Smithing Stone (4) in a room occupied by a Giant Poison Flower. You'll find a Nomadic Merchant on the level above this room and can get to him by scaling the scaffolding just to the east.

Backtrack back to the cliffs east of the Hallowhorn Grounds and if you've started Blaidd or Ranni's quest, you'll be able to find and talk to Blaidd by the cliff's edge East of him, you'll find a pillar of wind that Torrent can use to boost him up onto the ruins nearby. Parkour your way to the end and you'll find a Ghost Glovewort (3) and a Stonesword Key. In the distance, you may be able to see another unreachable ruin to the southeast. You can get there by taking one of the waygates at The Four Belfries. In that ruin, you'll be able to find a Ghost Glovewort (2) and Mottled Necklace.

Head back down from the ruin and continue scaling the cliff northeast. The ruins here will have a Smithing Stone (3) and a Somber Smithing Stone (2). There's another waygate here, we'll call it the eastern waygate, that you should come back to later. Up ahead, within some ruins is the Worshipper's Woods Site of Grace. Continue scaling up the cliff to find a Smithing Stone (2) and a Teardrop Scarab that drops the Ash of War: Square Off.

From here, scaling the cliffs get scarier as Ancestral Followers with bows and arrows can and will snipe you. Always try to break line of sight of them whenever possible and use the terrain to your advantage to block incoming projectiles. While heading north, there will be a detour you can take to the west where you can find a Golden Seed and a wall ruin you can scale for a Stonesword Key. Follow along the cliff to the north, and you'll come to a small cave behind waterfall. Inside you'll find Rune Arc. Head back off of the detour and continue heading north, where you'll eventually get to the Below the Well Site of Grace. Slightly north will be a Ghost Glovewort (3) and to the east is a staircase with the Clarifying Horn Charm. The staircase leads you to a lift that takes you back up to the surface at Deep Siofra Well in Caelid.

Head back to that eastern waygate we took note of earlier, and it'll teleport you to the northwestern section of the Siofra River, on a cliff above the waterfall here. Immediately to the north is the Dragonkin Soldier, who you can defeat for the Dragon Halberd, and next to him, under a waterfall is the Marika's Scarseal.

South of the Dragonkin Soldier, in a little ruin, is a bunch of Claymen, a Somber Smithing Stone (5), and a Teardrop Scarab that drops the Great Oracular Bubble. Outside the ruin (southwest of the Dragonkin Soldier's original position), tucked in a little corner, you can find a Ghost Glovewort (5). Head back to the spot you teleported to originally, and jump down the ledge here to get to the top of a waterfall. Here you'll find a Ghost Glovewort (4) and the path to get back down safely.

By exploring (and taking a peek at the interactive map using the coordinates below), you should have found all eight pillars that you needed to light up for a boss fight. Head back to the Hallowhorn Grounds and touch the now glowing deer carcass at the very end to get teleported to the Ancestor Spirit fog door. After defeating it, you'll be rewarded with the Ancestral Follower Ashes.

You may have seen buildings and ruins in the sky here and wondered if those areas can be explored. The answer to that is yes! Those buildings are part of Nokron, Eternal City but can only be reached after defeating Starscourge Radahn.
notes: The Gaelic word "Síofra" is pronounced "SHEE-fra" (/ʃifɹə/ or /ʃifrə/), and means "elf", "sprite", or "spirit".
The Ancestor Spirit boss can only be fought if all pillars in the area are interacted with. They are:
By the Siofra River Bank site of grace.
In a corner to the west of the first pillar.
On a small island in the watery area with the wisps.
By a cliff in the eastern part of Siofra River.
Just south of the Worshipper's Woods Site of Grace.
West of the Worshipper's Woods Site of Grace.
On the east side of the path to the Below the Well Site of Grace.
On the west side on the path to the Below the Well Site of Grace.
After lighting all 8 pillars, you'll see a popup that says "Powers gathers somewhere in horned remains".

title: Hallowhorn Grounds
text: ## Siofra River

When you first enter the temple in Siofra River, you may find that the temple is mostly empty - it's mostly barren and there's nothing to interact with. There are eight obelisks next to the stairs leading up to Hallowhorn Grounds that are unlit (one might be lit if you've lit the brazier on the way to the temple). You have to find eight braziers scattered around Siofra River and set them aflame to light these obelisks (See our Interactive Map for their location). Once all of them are lit, a message saying "Power gathers somewhere in horned remains" will pop up and the deer carcass further in the temple will start glowing. You can now head back to Hallowhorn Grounds to interact with the carcass to teleport to the Ancestor Spirit boss arena. You can find a map with the locations of these braziers on the Siofra River page.
## Nokron, Eternal City

The Hallowhorn Grounds in Nokron, Eternal City works the same way, except for the fact that there are six obelisks instead. Find each brazier (the ones here are easier to find as most of them have a singing Ancestral Follower by them, see our Interactive Map if you have trouble finding them) and interact with the deer carcass when all obelisks are lit. This carcass teleports you to the Regal Ancestor Spirit boss arena.

title: The Smoldering Church
text: ## Caelid
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Caelid (South) Points of Interest
Defeat the NPC Invader at Smoldering Church.
Clear out Fort Gael.
Complete Sellia Crystal Tunnels.
Travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
Participate in the Festival at Redmane Castle.
## The Smoldering Church

To begin the walkthrough for Caelid, let us start at the Smoldering Church, located northeast of Stormhill. You'll notice that there are multiple bloodstains around the entrance of the church, this is because an NPC Invader, Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, will appear here when you walk up to the entrance of the church. This NPC invader wields a curved greatsword and her moves can easily be read. Make sure to dodge when she does that leaping attack and you can follow up with your attacks before she recovers as soon as she hits the ground or if she uses an attack where she swings her weapon while she walks forward, use this opportunity to hit her with ranged attacks. Defeating this NPC invader drops the Sacred Scorpion Charm and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy - make sure to check inside the church to find the site of grace and two bodies holding the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14] and the Missionary's Cookbook [3].

place.title: Smoldering Church
walk: To claim the two cookbooks available in this area, loot the remains that are resting on the side of the church. You should find Missionary's Cookbook (3) and Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (14),

Before entering the church, prepare for battle as the NPC invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater shows up for battle. She deals quick attacks with her greataxe and can dodge, so time your attacks well. You will gain Sacred Scorpion Charm and Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
After the fight, you can rest at the Site of Grace found in the far end of the Smoldering Church and loot the two corpses next to it for some cookbooks.

title: Gael Tunnel
text: Now, if you want to gather some Smithing Stones and Somber Smithing Stones, you can check Gael Tunnel, southeast from the Smoldering Church. You can also find Iron Fist Alexander inside the cave. The Site of Grace for this dungeon is found in a very deep pit ahead of the entrance past two Soldiers. There is no lift to take you down so you will need to do some platforming along the edges of the pit. There is a small room next to the second ledge you drop down to on the left.
