Speak with Witch Hunter Jerren and Blacksmith Iji after starting Ranni's questline and initiate the festival in Redmane Castle.

Alternatively, you can explore the Altus Plateau, rest at any nearby Site of Grace, and head to Redmane Castle. You will find the festival is active and you will be able to fight Starscourge Radahn this way. This path isn't highly recommended because of the difficulty of this fight, but this can be done for players who want to take a shortcut or do a speedrun.
## Mohg, Lord of Blood
To take down Mohg, Lord of Blood (not to be confused with Mohg, the Omen), players need to make their way to The Mohgwyn Palace, which can be done in two ways:
Use the Waygate in West Consecrated Snowfield
Follow White Mask Varre's questline until reaching the point where you will be receiving the Pureblood Knight's Medal and use it to travel to the palace.
After defeating Mohg, you will now be able to see Leda and interact with the cocoon. Doing so will let you travel to the Shadow of Realm and play the DLC expansion for Elden Ring.

place.title: Starscourge Radahn
notes: Upon release, Radahn's boss fight was substantially critized by fans, who took issue with his huge hitboxes, high damage, and the speed of his moveset; many deemed Radahn as an unfair boss. As a result Radahn was nerfed in Patch 1.03, with his hitboxes corrected but also lowering his damage. The nerf was partially reversed in Patch 1.03.03, with the damage restored but his hitboxes remaining corrected.

His military rank is "General". According to the game files, his horse's name is Leonard. He learned gravity magic in order not to impair his steed, now that he had grown too large to properly ride it. While preparing his Meteor Crash attack, Leonard is pushed underground.
However, is effective poise is at the same level, as there is no poise-damage reduction multiplier. In terms of "effective poise", value attributed to Radahn is not the highest.
According to Fromsoft, Starscourge Radahn is placed 5th place in most fought boss gaining 139 million attempts - Elden Ring Stats Reveal How Many Times Players Attempted Malenia
## Starscourge Radahn Attacks & Counters

title: Gravesite Plain (Central)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Gravesite Plain (Central)
Get the Map for Gravesite Plain
Visit Church of Consolation
Fight Logur, the Beast Claw who drops the Beast Claw (Southeast of the first Site of Grace)
New Items for Level Scaling Mechanic: Get Scadutree Fragment and Revered Spirit Ash
Scorched Ruins: Pick up the Larval Tear in the illuminated gravesite (nighttime only)
Defeat Side Boss: Blackgaol Knight in Western Nameless Mausoleum
Get the Sacred Tower Painting
Defeat the Furnace Golem
Meeting Allies in Realm of Shadow: Go to Three-Path Cross Site of Grace
Optional: Discover Abandoned Ailing Village and defeat the field boss: Ghostflame Dragon
Take the Larval Tear south of Abandoned AIling Village in an illuminated gravesite
Explore Belurat Gaol and Defeat the Side Boss: Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze

title: Gravesite Plain
text: Upon entering the Realm of Shadow, you will see a faint light glowing before you. Walk towards this and follow the steps leading to a view of the vast land you are now in. Use the Gravesite Plain - Site of Grace to get a checkpoint here. Walk toward the northeast and look for the dirt path. Follow this path leading north and pick up the Map: Gravesite Plain in one of the stone slab to your right, similar to the base game. This unlocks the Gravesite Plain on your map and will help you navigate more easily.

While in this area, be on the lookout for a Curseblade, as this is an enemy with two blades that will attack you. After defeating it, head south and follow the dirt path. You can ride Torrent here so you can cover more distance. You can also pick up items along the way to help with crafting like Redflesh Mushroom, Whiteflesh Mushroom, and Rada Fruit on the ground. You will also encounter Shadow Undead here that can attack you while riding your mount.

Continue riding southeast and stray from the dirt path for a bit. You will come across a hostile NPC called Logur the beast Claw in the middle of the woods. Listen and follow the bird sound near the middle of the woods. This NPC drops the Beast Claw (Weapon) upon defeating it. Return to the dirt path and continue going northeast until you see a broken cart and dead bodies. Take a moment here to pick up some items like Glass Shard, Black Pyrefly, Rada Fruit, and x10 Arrow. Follow the path until you reach the area outside of the Church of Consolation. You can pick up Dewgem on top of the stones surrounding the church and in the area close to the nearby waterfall. You can follow the cliffwall going north, and you will find three Messmer Soldiers in an area along with a corpse that you can loot for x1 Blessing of Marika. Go back to the church, and you'll find a Black Pyrefly behind it.

title: Church of Consolation: First Scadutree Fragment
text: The church is located at the edge of the map and inside, an elite enemy is patrolling the aisle. It's up to you if you want to kill it or you can go around the church, stay crouched, and sneak behind the altar to pick up x2 Scadutree Fragment. However, if you opt to defeat the Black Knight, you can obtain Black Steel Greathammer, Black Knight Helm, and Smithing Stone [6] as a reward. Then, you can pick up x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the statue. This is an important item exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree that boosts your damage inflicted on enemies while boosting your damage reduction. You can use this to level up your Scadutree Blessing while resting on a Site of Grace.

Outside the church, there's a small camp of Messmer Soldiers to the east. You can eliminate these soldiers for a chance to loot a piece of their armor and then pick up x2 Fire Coil from a corpse inside the round tent. On your way back, travel to the edge of the plain, on the west side. You will find a Lump of Flesh on a corpse behind one of the stone heads.

Return to the dirt path and go towards the white tree with hanged bodies to the northeast. Continue riding Torrent and proceed to the eastern cliff where you see the waterfall. This is the other side of a ravine separating the Church of Consolation from the plains. Walk up to the small altar and pick up the Revered Spirit Ash. This is also a new item that lets you boost Spirit Ashes beyond +10 and increase the durability and damage dealt by Torrent within the realm of shadow.

place.title: Scadutree Fragment
notes: Acquired Scadutree Fragments carry over into New Game Plus.

title: Church of Consolation
text: The Church of Consolation can be located northeast of the map See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Inside, you can find x2 Scadutree Fragment by the statue of Marika. The church is guarded by a Black Knight enemy that wields a hammer and a shield. Near the church, you can also find a small campsite where you'll encounter a couple of Messmer Soldiers and a Burning Hound. Investigate the campsite and check the small tent to find a corpse that has an item. Loot the body to find x2 Fire Coil. If you also check behind the large tent, by the rocks and a tree, you can find x1 Golden Rune [1].

place.title: Church of Consolation
notes: For some players, the Black Knight drops Black Steel Greatshield.

title: To Scorched Ruins and Defeating a Side Boss
text: When you're done here, continue exploring Gravesite Plain by sticking to the edge on your right while facing north. You will come across a small gravesite west of the previous small altar. Make sure to eliminate the glimmering Shadowpot. This enemy will drop a Scadutree Fragment and other crafting materials. You can pick up a Spiritgrave Stone from one of the stone heads and x3 Black Pyrefly on the ground.

After that, head west to reach the Scorched Ruins. This is a small area where you can fight some enemies and pick up important items and the first thing you will do is to activate the Site of Grace found north of the building. If you have been following this Walkthrough, make sure to take the time to use the collected Revered Spirit Ash and Scadutree Fragment on the Site of Grace you have collected so far.

From the Scorched Ruins - Site of Grace, walk under the building and go over to the other side. Turn around and climb the stairs to your left, and take the Hefty Cracked Pot from the corpse. This is a material that can be used for crafting cracked pot items. You can also loot other crafting items on the ground here. From here, go to your right and take the stairs to your left. Then, pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1] from a corpse on the stairs here. Next, go inside the broken building and look for the corpse hidden within jars. Destroy the jars here and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune. Go up the stairs and walk towards the enemies attacking you from the opposite building. Cross the roof to the other side and pick up Black Pyrefly behind this room. Then, go back to the front of this room and open the door to reveal a chest containing the Blade of Mercy. After that, walk directly in front of this room and drop down to the balcony below it. Jump to the next platform and pick up the Bone Dart from a corpse.

The next location is an optional boss you can defeat for a reward. Head west where you will see white trees in the distance and as you get near a tall gravestone, 2 Gravebirds will swoop down to attack you. These enemies have a chance of dropping Smithing Stones so make sure to defeat them when you see one. Continue traveling west and go past the glowing worm-like creatures. These are not hostile unless you start attacking them. Continue riding Torrent until you reach the Western Nameless Mausoleum. You can go inside this building to defeat the Blackgaol Knight and earn the Greatsword of Solitude and Solitude Set as a reward.

After fighting the Blackgaol Knight, return to Scorched Ruins - Site of Grace and then continue exploring the northeastern side while scaling the edge of the plain. Keep an eye out for a cave here with a glowing light. Go inside it and interact with The Sacred Tower Painting. See the location on Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

As you head back outside, you will come across Inquisitor enemies who use Fire and Magic. Go toward the small altar with 4 pillars located behind this pack of enemies to pick up the Backhand Blade. Continue heading east toward the cliff and take the Grave Glovewort from the corpse on the stone. You might come across a Gravebird here once again.

Back to the dirt path along Scorched Ruins, you will see a tall flaming enemy. This is the Furnace Golem, an elite enemy that drops runes, Deflecting Hardtear, and Furnace Visage upon death. You will also see more of this enemy in other locations, but each of them has a unique tear drop. This enemy will also start throwing projectiles at you if you get too close. The Furnace Golem can be tough to beat because of the wide AoE attacks that it can do. It will take some time to get used to, but the movement is slow and can be dodged by timing it with a jump before its foot hits the ground. If you're having a hard time, you can ride Torrent while fighting this boss and then focus on attacking the legs. You can take advantage of Torrent's double jump so you can have more airtime.

place.title: Scorched Ruins
walk: The Scorched Ruins is a location that can be found north of the Gravesite Plain, along the main road. Before reaching the entrance, you can find a monolith that has the map fragment of the Gravesite Plain region. Make sure to check that out to acquire the Map: Gravesite Plain See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. As you follow the main road and approach remnants of the main entrance, you'll encounter Shadow Undead enemies that are hostile.

Walk to the right to find a corpse that you can loot to acquire x1 Hefty Cracked Pot. Investigate the right side of the ruins to find some steps, go up and you'll see another corpse sitting by the crumbling steps of a building. Loot the body to find x1 Greater Potentate's Cookbook (1), See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

Now check the left side of the ruins and be ready to dodge or block an ambush attack from a Hound Spirit. The enemy will attack you as you approach the steps. Check the backside and you should see some stairs and some vases and pots on the right. Behind the vases and pots, there is a body sitting against the wall that can be looted to acquire x1 Shadow Realm Rune (2), See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Walk up the stairs, and at the top, you'll see a building on the left that has an opening. Inside the building, a Shadow Undead will throw rocks at you, quickly run towards the opening, and kill the enemies.

Turn around, and look to the left, and you'll spot another body lying on a roof. Investigate the body to loot x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Go back to the opening, walk up the stairs, and exit to a balcony. Turn right, jump across to land on the roof that is covered in a cloth-like material, and walk straight to reach a small room that has a treasure chest. Open the chest to find the Blade of Mercy talisman. Also, you can check behind to find some Black Pyrefly.

title: Western Nameless Mausoleum
text: The Western Nameless Mausoleum is a location that can be found northwest of the Gravesite Plain See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. The mausoleum is an arena where you'll encounter a mini-boss upon entering the undercroft. The boss you'll fight here is the Blackgaol Knight, and defeating it rewards the player with the Solitude Set. The set comes with the following pieces:
Helm of Solitude
Armor of Solitude
Gauntlets of Solitude
Greaves of Solitude
including the Greatsword of Solitude

By the entrance of the Western Nameless Mausoleum, there is a Stake of Marika and a Summoning Pool. The summoning pool can be used to summon other players that can help you and the Stake of Marika allows the player to respawn by the entrance in case you die while fighting the Blackgaol Knight. Outside the mausoleum, you can find some gatherable items and encounter a few enemies such as Gravebirds.

title: Miquella's Followers at the Three-Path Cross
text: When you're done in this area, head north again where you see a faint light glowing from the ground, and some figures are gathered near it. Head towards them and make sure to activate the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace here. Talk to the NPCs, who you will come to know as followers of Miquella. Just like Needle Knight Leda said, these followers will offer help in your journey in tracing Miquella's footsteps. Interact with the NPCs here and make sure to exhaust the dialogues of Hornsent to receive the Cross Map from him.

You can pick up an Empyrean-Blood Burgeon and a Scadutree Fragment on the ground next to the cross. The other NPC is Redmane Freyja who you can speak with to get more info about Hornsent. Exhaust her dialogues before you continue exploring the northernmost area.

From the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace, navigate the wall to your left while facing north. Carefully stick to the wall and take the Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw from a small camp here. Then, face the east direction toward the bridge to find a way to the lower area here. If you go down here during nighttime, you can find a Larval Tear glowing. The Run-Down Traveler's Rest is directly below the bridge, and you can pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2] inside. This allows the player to craft Hefty Furnace Pots.

When you're done here, you can travel north to reach your next destination, which is the Abandoned Ailing Village. To reach the next location, stick to the edge of the cliff here and travel north. Continue until you reach a dead-end where you will find a small altar with the Revered Spirit Ash. Eliminate the nearby giant moths so you can safely take this item. Then, head back to the ramp so you can activate the Greatbridge, North - Site of Grace.

You will see a ghost facedown on the ground ahead of you. Interact with it before you proceed to Abandoned Ailing Village. Go to the edge of the cliff behind the ghost and pick up the Human Bone Shard and x2 Black Pyrefly from a corpse. Continue walking at the edge and you will find another corpse on the wooden platform where you can obtain the Ailment Talisman. Before leaving this area, go to the other side of the houses (across the ghost) and you will find a Broken Rune from a corpse.

You can now travel west toward the lake, and you will see a Ghostflame Dragon in the distance. There's a summoning pool that you can activate if you want to use it. Defeating this boss will reward you with x1 Dragon Heart and x1 Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. See the Ghostflame Dragon for information and strategies to defeating this boss. You can also pick up a Great Katana from a corpse next to the dragon. After this fight, continue exploring north where you will find a small shack below the Abandoned Ailing Village. There's a corpse outside at roof level where you can pick up Fly Mold, then, you can jump inside the house through the hole in the roof to pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [10].

Next, head southwest into an area in Gravebird statues. You can pick up the Gravebird Armor from the altar in the middle here. Then, follow the body of water leading to metal barricades scattered on the ground. This will lead to an entrance to Belurat Gaol where you can defeat an optional boss called Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze to earn Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh (Spirit Ash) as a reward.

title: Abandoned Ailing Village
text: The Abandoned Ailing Village is a location that has been inhabited by Man-Fly enemies. The village can be found northwest of the Ellac Greatbridge in the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. From the entrance of the village, investigate the east section towards the cliffside where you'll spot a statue that has an item, kill the Man-Fly enemies that are around the statue, and then pick up the item to acquire x1 Revered Spirit Ash.

Return to the entrance of the village to find the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace nearby See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. As mentioned, the village is now inhabited by Man-Fly enemies, so tread carefully and avoid aggravating them in a group, since you can potentially die from being outnumbered. To identify which is the entrance of the village, it's where you'll see a Spirit NPC. If you head to the east past the NPC at night, you will find an illuminated gravesite where you can pick up a Larval Tear.

From the entrance, check the west section of the village to find a house that you can enter. Inside, you can find a body that holds x1 Broken Rune. Go to the center of the village and head up the hill where you'll find some scaffolding. If you walk a bit to the east, towards the edge of a cliff, you can spot a glowing skull that has x1 Golden Rune (1), and there's also a body near it that you can loot to acquire x1 Human Bone Shard. Next, walk up to the scaffolding to find another corpse hanging by the edge. Loot it to obtain the Ailment Talisman See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

Now ride your mount and head to the northwest corner of the village where you'll spot a single house. Enter through the doorway, kill the Man-Fly, and loot the corpse to obtain Greater Potentate's Cookbook (10), See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

title: Run-Down Traveler's Rest
text: The Run-Down Traveler's Rest is a dilapidated cabin that can be located north of the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map and near the Ellac Greatbridge. There are no enemies around the location and there are no NPCs or merchants. However, you can find a body inside the cabin and you can loot it to obtain Greater Potentate's Cookbook (2) and 2x Furnace Visage.

title: Ellac Greatbridge
text: The Ellac Greatbridge is located southeast of Castle Ensis, adjacent to the Run-Down Traveler's Rest. This wartorn bridge is littered with barricades and rubble, making it a straightforward path to navigate. Head straight through the bridge until you reach a section occupied by Messmer Soldiers and impaled corpses on each side. Here, you can find and loot two corpses for Ballista Bolt and Lost Ashes of War. At the end of the bridge, you will encounter a stationary crossbow that fires at you. To deal with this threat, charge at the crossbow while dodging the arrows it fires, and take out the Messmer Soldier controlling it. Once the crossbow is neutralized, return to the middle of the bridge to loot the corpses you encountered earlier.

title: Clearing Belurat Gaol
text: As you enter the depths of the prison, you will find the Belurat Gaol - Site of Grace and a Summoning Pool on the right side of the Site of Grace.

This area has enemies such as Revered Spirits, large and small variations of the Living Jar, and Mutated Prisoners. This area is also a good place to farm or find Frozen Maggots The objective is to reach the bottom-most section of the gaol where a mini-boss is waiting.
## BELURAT GAOL UPPER AREA

As you formally set foot in the location, head down the steps on the left and be ready to block or dodge, a Shadow Undead will ambush you as soon as you approach a doorway along the steps. Head inside the room on the left and you'll find a body you can loot to find x6 Frozen Maggot. Go back outside and continue going down the steps until you reach the end where the ground collapses. Kill more of the Shadow Undead enemies, and if you look to your left, you'll find another doorway. Be ready again for another spirit who will try to ambush you, kill the enemies, and loot the body lying on the ground to find x1 Silver Horn Tender.

Go back outside and cross the narrow path to reach the other end. But tread carefully since enemies are roaming around and blocking your path. Kill the two spirits and before you go through the doorway ahead, there is another body you can loot by the edge of the cliff. Loot it to find x4 Frozen Maggot. Go through the doorway and look to your right to see a hole that you can jump through. Proceed to this path, and then jump through the hole on the left side to continue your descent.

Enter the room that looks like a storeroom that is filled with crates, cages, and tables. Kill the enemies and loot the body next to the shelf with barrels on the left side to find x1 Broken Rune. Exit the room, but before you enter the next room on the left, break the crates on the right to find another corpse lying by the edge of a cliff to find x1 Thawfrost Boluses. As you pass through the connecting room, you'll see a Ghost Prisoner NPC that you can speak to who begs for forgiveness and fears the jar.

place.title: Belurat Gaol
walk: Belurat Gaol Walkthrough Video

The Belurat Gaol is a location situated under the Belurat Tower Settlement, to find the entrance of the prison area, head west from the Abandoned Ailing Village or the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace. You'll easily identify when you're near the entrance when you arrive at the area that is surrounded with water and prison cages. As you enter the depths of the prison, you will find the Belurat Gaol Site of Grace and a Summoning Pool on the right side of the Site of Grace.

This area has enemies such as Shadow Undead enemies, large and small variations of the Living Jar, and Jar Innards. This area is also a good place to farm or find Frozen Maggots The objective is to reach the bottom-most section of the gaol where a mini-boss is waiting.

title: DESCENDING THE GAOL
text: Upon exiting, you'll come across a section of the prison where you'll see large jars chained together and onto the ceiling. Before you make your descent by using the jars as platforms, look ahead to find another doorway that leads to a room with jars and crates. There is a body here that you can loot to find x1 Shadow Realm Rune [3], but at the same time, you'll fight against a Mutated Prisoner, humanoids that have mutated and erupted from their jars. Once you've cleared the room, return to the hanging jars to start descending to the bottom area (there's a body on top of the hanging jar that has x1 Glass Shard). As indicated in the image above, you'll want to try and make your way down towards the side of the room that has a wooden platform. There is a chest there that contains x1 Hefty Cracked Pot.

After getting the item, continue to the bottom and proceed west. Clear the enemies along the way and pass through the doorway where you'll enter a shrine-looking section of the gaol. Drop onto the bridge and fight your way against more enemies. When you reach the opposite end, as you approach the altar, the ground beneath you will collapse and you'll fall into a mini-labyrinth that's filled with small and large jars. Take caution here as both Living Jar and Mutated Prisoners are hiding in corners, waiting to ambush you.

Take the time here to explore the section with pots since there are some items that you can loot: x1 Lost Ashes of War, x2 Smithing Stone [6], x1 Greater Potentate's Cookbook (11). There are also x1 Hefty Cracked Pot, and x1 Innard Meat looted off the bodies that are on top of the large jars. Once you're done clearing the room, proceed east to find the exit leading to the next section. Kill the Living Jar and loot the body sitting on a prison cage to find x2 Smithing Stone [3].

Before advancing the dungeon further, head west on your compass, and you will find a jar that is slightly at a lower level than your position. Jump on it and it will take you up high. Once it stops, jump towards the following platforms and continue forward. You will find Greatjar on a pedestal. Move forward and drop down to find yourself again in the Jar Labyrinth. Resume your previous way, to continue advancing in the dungeon.

Next, jump across to reach the opposite side of the area to find a golden mist door, and fight the Mutated Prisoners. Position your compass towards the South, and you'll see a chained jar that you can jump on. Use it as a platform to jump across a broken pillar, and continue jumping down until you reach the end, where you'll find a gold mist door. Before you enter, make preparations, as you'll fight against the Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze upon passing through the mist.
## BELURAT GAOL BOSS: DEMI-HUMAN SWORDMASTER ONZE

The Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze boss is an agile boss capable of leaping into the air, using lunge attacks, and executing deadly combos similar to a samurai. In our playthrough, our character's build focuses on melee and we had a shield equipped to mitigate attacks as much as possible. As soon as you enter prepare to dodge or block as the boss will teleport to you and follow up with a swinging attack. Since we were facing the boss without the help of other players, we decided to summon the Black Knife Tiche to keep things in check.

The Black Knife Tiche in our opinion is good against this boss since it also moves fast and is capable of attacking its target in close or mid-range. As soon as the boss switched its attention towards our summoned spirit, we took the opportunity to land some attacks before it switched its attention to the character. Play it safe and keep an eye out for its movements since the boss moves quickly. Defeating it rewards the spirit ash Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh. To return to the entrance, use the pool of energy at the center of the boss arena to teleport to the entrance of this dungeon.
See the next tab for the Second Path: Western Gravesite Plain Navigation.to return to the tab selection.

title: Gravesite Plain (Western)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Belurat Tower Settlement - Navigating Western Area of Gravesite Plain
Reach Cliffroad Terminus
Head to the gravesite to get Larval Tear and Scadutree Fragment
Go to Prospect Town: Get String-Seller's Bell Bearing and Outer God Heirloom

Look for the Forager Brood who will give you the Forager Brood Cookbook (2). This NPC can be found next to the illuminated gravesite at night, which surrounds a Larval Tear at night. NOTE: Harming any of the Forager Broods will cause Moore to appear and invade your world. If Moore dies, this will also cause the Forager Broods to permanently disappear and end his questline.
Get the Incursion Painting in Artist's Shack,
Go to the Church of Benediction

After exploring the northern area of Gravesite Plain, return to the Three-Path Cross to continue your journey. Go toward the tall archway that Freyja is facing in the west. You will come across Shadow Undead here that you can eliminate for a chance to get Rada Fruit from them. Go to the left after exiting the archway and navigate the stone steps here. Stay along the ledge and continue heading south. You will encounter hounds and giant bats in this area. At the end, turn left and you can activate the Cliffroad Terminus Site of Grace right after you turn.

title: Prospect Town
text: Prospect Town is a small location where players can find valuable items, it is situated on the west area of the map within the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. The area is easy to investigate since most of the houses and buildings are destroyed and left the town an open area filled with rubble and remnants of the town. The location is also a good spot to gather materials such as Rada Fruit and Sanguine Amaryllis.

It is highly recommended to use a mount when exploring the area, so that you can more easily jump and reach high grounds. Investigate the south section of the town where you should find remnants of what seems to be the plaza area of the town. There are 2 Bloodfiends here. In this area, there is a small room near a set of stairs where you can spot a corpse, looting it yields x2 Beast Blood. Walk up the stairs to reach the upper area where you'll face 6 more Bloodfiends.
Next, just head up to the small church-like building to find a treasure chest. Open the chest and pick up the item to receive the Outer God Heirloom talisman

Be sure to explore to the east of Prospect Town. At nighttime, there is a patch of illuminated tombstones with a Larval Tear Next to that is a friendly Kindred of Rot who will give you the Forager Brood Cookbook [2] if you interact with it. Also nearby, if you continue moving east towards the area with trees and deer, you will spot a corpse that has an item. Pillage the body to find x1 Greater Potentate's Cookbook (5).

title: Exploring Cliffroad Terminus
text: From here, follow the dirt path and head south. This will lead you to a gravesite with more Shadow Undead. Go near the edge and look for an item on the ground near the gravestone heads to obtain the following items:
Scadutree Fragment
Silver Horn Tender
Rada Fruit
Make sure to eliminate the Shadowpot enemy standing here with other Shadow Undead. This enemy drops a Scadutree Fragment upon eliminating it.

There's also a Grave Glovewort that you can collect from one of the corpses here. After this area, head to the opposite side of the cliff and go toward the pond. You will encounter Hounds and Bloodfiend enemies here along the way. At the edge of the pond, you will see a small altar where you can pick up a Revered Spirit Ash. Then, head south of the pond where a hound and Bloodfiends are gathered. You can pick up a Great Arrow and a Smithing Stone from their gathering spot.

Continue exploring until you reach the edge south of the pond. You will find a non-hostile servant here who will give you the Forager Brood Cookbook [2] when interacted with. There's also a nearby illuminated grave where you can pick up a Larval Tear from the center. (This area may only be spotted at night.)

As you approach the town, look for an item hanging from a wall in a ravine. Shoot and break the hanging pot with a bow to obtain the String-Seller's Bell Bearing. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map, you can use this item to offer to the Twin Maiden Husks to unlock the option to buy String. Head west this time and enter Prospect Town or what remains of it. This area is infested with Bloodfiends and Hounds in every corner. Inside the building to the west, you can pick up Beast Blood from the corpse next to breakable jars. Go towards the southern area of Prospect Town where you see 3 Bloodfiends gathered in the open area. Eliminate them and look around the pillars to pick up Sanguine Amaryllis from a corpse. Continue walking up two sets of wide steps and enter the building to your left. Inside, you can obtain an Outer God Heirloom from a chest.

Exit the town to continue exploring the southeast and go past the servant who gave you the cookbook. You will encounter creatures here with lightning elements, and lightning can also strike occasionally. You may also pick up Yellow Fulgurbloom and other items from slain creatures. You will see a corpse in the distance and you can go up to it to take the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [5].

title: The Artist's Shack and Church of Benediction
text: Continue navigating this area and go toward the cave where you will encounter a Giant Rat and another Curseblade. You're heading toward where you interacted with the first Site of Grace in the Shadow of Realm but in the area above it.

For clarity, we recommend returning to the Cliffroad Terminus, then head southeast and follow the dirt path where you will come across lightning rams. Once the dirt path ends, face south and go towards the south by jumping up the mountain through the stones. Face southeast and proceed to the edge of the cliff. You will see the "Incursion" Painting inside the Artist's Shack. See the location on Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Map

After going here, explore the southern area to reach the Church of Benediction. Carefully jump down to reach the ground and go toward the center and pick up the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman from the altar. Then, face north and exit the tall and slim archway toward the cliff. Pick up Pata and the Oathseeker Knight Set here from a corpse near the ledge.
You can go down here and scale the wall while riding Torrent. This gives you access back to the Gravesite Plain without going back to the Site of Grace in Crossroad Terminus.
See the next tab for the Belurat Tower Settlement Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

place.title: Artist's Shack
walk: Information on how to complete the area and relevant tips for the player go here

title: Church of Benediction
text: The Church of Benediction is a small location that can be found south of the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. There are no hostile characters and NPCs found in the Church of Benediction, however, there is some loot you can find inside and near the church. Head inside the church and investigate the statue of Marika to find the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman. And if you check the edge of a cliff, near its doorway, you'll spot a corpse hanging. Loot the body to find the Oathseeker Knight Set which contains the following pieces:
Oathseeker Knight Greaves
Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets
Oathseeker Knight Armor
Oathseeker Knight Helm
including the Pata weapon.
There is also a glowing skull on the ground near the doorway of the church, breaking it will drop a Golden Rune (1).

title: Belurat Tower Settlement
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Belurat Tower Settlement - Inside the Legacy Dungeon
Return to Three-Path Cross - Site of Grace, then head west to meet Moore and Sir Ansbach
Defeat the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign
Take the Storeroom Key and unlock the door near the Small Private Altar Site of Grace to meet Hornsent Grandam
Take the Well Depths Key and head to the Sewers
Navigate the Stagefront section of Belurat Tower Settlement
Defeat the Divine Beast Dancing Lion
After defeating the boss, pick up the Tower of Shadow Message
Equip the Divine Beast Head armor piece and return to Hornsent Grandam to receive Watchful Spirit (Spell)
IMPORTANT: After exploring Belurat Tower Settlement, you must speak with Redmane Freyja at the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace to progress her questline
Return to the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace and go toward the tall archway once again. This time, head up the wide steps to reach another Miquella's Cross and meet more allies.
Belurat Tower Settlement
Gravesite Plain
150 - Above
Divine Beast Dancing Lion

Belurat Tower Settlement is a Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. It is exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. The tower was said to be a place where practitioners and experts would practice the ancient form of hexing arts. It was also a place where individuals who have caught the "fly sickness" have succumbed to death or the disease that transformed them into hostile flesh-eating creatures. And since unimaginable actions and magic were practiced, those who have met their demise now roam the tower as lost Revered Spirits, waiting to kill anything or anyone who explores the area. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

place.title: Belurat Tower Settlement
notes: Notes go here

title: Small Private Altar Site of Grace
text: NOTE: If this is your first time encountering the NPC Invader, Fire Knight Queelign, defeating him drops the Crusade Insignia talisman. However, if it's your second encounter, he drops the Prayer Room Key and Ash of War: Flame Skewer. For added information, the other location where Fire Knight Queelign appears as an NPC Invader is at the Church of the Crusade.

Proceed through the doorway on the right to find a storeroom. Climb up the ladder and you'll see a body sitting against a wall next to another arched doorway. Loot it to find the Storeroom Key. The Storeroom Key can be used to unlock the door near the Small Private Altar Site of Grace. Inside that room, you can find an NPC Hornsent Grandam.
## The Toxic Depths

You can also find the following items at the sewer level, so make sure not to leave this section until you find the following items we've listed. These items are looted from dead bodies. x4 Whiteflesh Mushroom near the section leading to the shortcut, x5 Knot Resin on the ruins where you'll find a group of Man-Fly enemies, x3 Beast Liver on the island where you fight the dual sword-wielding Horned Warrior. x1 Poisoned Hand is located east, next to a church. x8 Serpent Arrow on top of the roof of a sunken building. x1 Neutralizing Boluses behind one of the buildings in the south section, as well as x2 Smithing Stone from a corpse hanging by the edge of a building roof.
## Belurat Tower Settlement: Stagefront

Next, head up the steps, and you'll find a group of Revered Spirits gathered around a large tree. Kill the enemies and on the left side of the tree, you'll find a broken statue that has an item. Loot the item to acquire x1 Revered Spirit Ash. Continue west and head inside a tower building.
## Down, Down, Down

Keep following it, and you will acquire x10 Lordsworn's Bolt from a dead body at the end of it. After looting the body, follow the ledge to the other direction going down, and you'll be at a broken section of the ledge. Drop down it, and you will land near a hostile Shadow Undead. Kill it, then pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] nearby. Go down the stairs, and you'll find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver from a dead body.
## Belurat Tower Settlement Section
To progress further, sprint jump down the window south of the dead body containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver.

title: Gravesite Plain (Eastern)
text: Exploring Eastern Gravesite Plain, and other areas outside of Castle Ensis
Return to Three-Path Cross - Site of Grace: Cross the Greatbridge
Explore Fog Rift Catacombs
Clear the Ruined Forge Lava Intake
Reach Pillar Path Cross - Site of Grace and meet Thiollier

Find Igon. Exhaust his dialogues. (NOTE: Speak with Moore after talking to Thiollier. You will receive Black Syrup from Moore and you will take it to Thiollier to receive Thiollier's Concoction. This item can be used to unlock an alternate ending for the Dragon Communion Priestess's quest to receive Dragonbolt of Florissax (Incantation) and Ancient Dragon Florissax (Ash Spirits).
OPTIONAL: Reach Rivermouth Cave through an alternate path by following Ellac River going north (behind Thiollier)
Unlock the Site of Grace in Dragon's Pit
Reach Suppressing Pillar

title: The Third Path: Crossing the Greatbridge
text: After clearing Belurat Tower Settlement and the Western Gravesite Plain, return to the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace. Speak with Redmane Freyja, exhaust their dialogues, and head towards the bridge to your northeast. There are metal barricades along the bridge and as you get closer to the middle, a soldier manning the Ballista will start firing here. Pay attention to the items along the way to pick up Lost Ashes of War and Ballista Bolt here. Take out the enemy manning the ballista then go after the soldier tents on the side of the bridge and you can go through them and eliminate enemies as you go.

After crossing the bridge, you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment in the middle of the camp. You can also see the nearby Castle Front - Site of Grace behind the tent. Wallk towards it to activate it. To continue exploring, you will head to Fog Rift Catacombs. You can reach this place by heading west from the Castle Front - Site of Grace (front of Castle Ensis). You will pass through a small group of army here under a wooden scaffolding. Keep heading west and follow the trail here behind them. You will see gravestones along the way here and make sure to stay on the middle path so you don't come up a cliff. As you head further you will see 2 Ghostflame lanterns in the nearby north direction marking the door to the catacombs.

title: Elder's Hovel
text: The Elder's Hovel is a shabby cabin located southeast of the Castle Front Site of Grace of Castle Ensis. There are no nearby enemies or bosses around the location but you can find some materials around such as Rada Fruit and animals such as Sheep. Inside the run-down shack, players can find a corpse that can be looted to acquire the Talisman of the Dread. Just next to the body is a Spirit NPC sitting on a chair. If spoken to, the spirit responds with:
"O Bayle, tyrant drake, do your wounds yet ache?"
"Is your fury still yet to crest its zenith?"
"Hurry, hurry, and lay it all to waste!"
"Lay waste to the proud, the conceited, each, every last one of that arrogant lot."

title: Clear Fog Rift Catacombs
text: Fog Rift Catacombs is located west of the Church of Crusade and north of Fog Rift Fort. The entrance of the catacombs leads to an elevator that goes down. You'll immediately find the Fog Rift Catacombs Site of Grace and a tunnel path straight ahead. Head through the tunnel entrance and prepare yourself for an Imp that will ambush you. At the upper right side of the room is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort [1].

After retrieving that item, turn left through another tunnel entrance which leads to a large open room. Upon exiting the tunnel, immediately turn left towards a safe spot because half of the room is rigged with a spike trap that descends from above. Wait for it to come down, and once it goes up, immediately run to the other side where a Lion Head Goblin is waiting for you. Take out the Goblin and head straight to the next tunnel entrance leading to a large hallway. Turn right and head straight towards the stairs going down, but before heading down, pick up the Yellow Fulgurbloom to your left.

After collecting the plant, head down the stairs and turn right into another tunnel in the catacombs. You'll see two corpses that give you the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] and a Lizard Greatsword, along with a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant. Head back to where you turned right earlier, and this time, turn left down another set of stairs. This will lead you to what looks like a dead-end ledge, but wait a few seconds for the spike trap from earlier to fall down. Once it falls, hop on top of it, and it will lead you to a secret platform with a Lion Head Goblin, a corpse that gives you x3 Knot Resin, and a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant.

After looting the platform, hop on the spike trap again, but don't go back yet. Instead, wait for the spike trap to take you back up again, and this time, look for a tunnel entrance to the left that you can drop onto. Once you enter the tunnel and the room, turn left again until you cross a bridge and a set of stairs going up. Here, you'll encounter Messmer Soldiers guarding a room. Head inside the room after defeating the Messmer Soldiers, and you'll face a Black Knight. Defeat the Black Knight, then pick up the Great Ghost Glovewort. Go outside the room, then turn left to jump on top of a spiked platform, then go through a hallway. Follow the pathway and you will find the Black Knight Commander Andreas summon at the end.

Make your way back to where you first saw the spike area from a ledge. Instead of hopping back on, wait for it to drop and go up. Then immediately drop down and enter the tunnel entrance behind you. The small room here contains a Yellow Fulgurbloom. Inside the room on the left side is a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and follow the tunnel path with three Yellow Fulgurblooms.

After looting the plants, walk to the right and drop down to the area from earlier where you saw the spike trap. Drop down again and stand at the tunnel entrance behind you from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, then immediately run to the other side where a set of stairs goes down. Here, you'll find a corpse that gives you x2 Dragonbolt Grease.

Head down the stairs to find another elevator that goes further down. Upon reaching the ground, head straight towards a room with two Lion Head Goblins and loot the corpse and plant under the stairs to get x4 Rada Fruit and a Yellow Fulgurbloom. From under the stairs, head straight towards the tunnel entrance on the other side of the room, but loot two more Yellow Fulgurblooms to the left.

Inside the small room, clear out the two enemies and loot the corpse on the upper right for a Grave Glovewort [2]. After looting the corpse, head out of the room and turn right towards another tunnel entrance with stairs going further down. This leads to an open hallway with spike traps covering half of the hallway. Just as before, run to the left towards a safe space and wait for the spike trap to drop. Once it drops, hug the wall and run straight until you see a hole to the left where you can drop down into what appears to be a sewage area. Once you land in the sewage, head straight for the tunnel entrance ahead and loot the corpse for a Ghost Glovewort [4].

On the left side of the first sewage room is an entrance to another room. Enter and turn left towards another room containing three Yellow Fulgurblooms and a corpse that drops an Electrocharge. Exit that room, turn left towards a ladder going up. Climb the ladder and drop down from the platform to find yourself near the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run towards the other end of the hallway. Get to the second safe spot to the left, past the hole you dropped into earlier, and loot the corpse there to get a Glass Shard. Wait for the spike trap to drop again, then run towards the stairs leading to a casket above that you can loot for a Shadow Realm Rune [3].

Once you're done looting, stay on the ledge of the platform you're standing on in front. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and you'll see a small square space on the side of the spike trap that you can hop onto. Hop onto the square platform and let the spike trap raise you to a secret platform above with a chest containing the Ash of War: Blinkbolt. After looting, hop on top of the spike trap again and run to the other side until you see a small platform to the right to drop onto. You'll see an altar that changes the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the Sword of Darkness.

To the left is a ladder going down. This ladder leads to a secret room with a corpse that gives you a Ghost Glovewort [5]. Loot it, then immediately look to the left to see another hole to drop into. This hole will drop you back to a safe spot from the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run to the other side this time instead of the platform from earlier. Be careful in the safe area here as it connects to another spike trap area.

Wait for the spike trap on the other side to drop, then cross towards a tunnel entrance. Loot the corpse in the middle first for a Broken Rune. Head through the tunnel entrance to find another elevator that goes down. Drop here and head straight until you reach the yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss. For a comprehensive boss guide on the Death Knight, you may go to this page.

title: Clearing the Ruined Forge Lava Intake
text: After clearing Fog Rift Catacombs, proceed to the riverside of Ellac Greatbridge by riding Torrent to the southern area. Eliminate the soldiers here for a chance to get Smithing Stone from them. Then, look for the corpse outside a tent to obtain a Spread Crossbow, a modified crossbow that can load multiple bolts and fire them simultaneously to create a spread of arrow bolts. From here, head east towards a gravesite where you will see Bloodfiends fighting Messmer soldiers. Continue riding ahead until you see the toppled pillars with lanterns. You will see a small entrance that will lead to Ruined Forge Lava Intake.

By the entrance is where you'll find the Ruined Lava Forge Intake Site of Grace. Head down the stairs, turn right, and then climb down the ladder (or jump down). Go forward and turn left into a dead-end room where you'll encounter a Stone Golem enemy. Kill the enemy and then check the floor of this room to find items such as x1 Gas Stone, x1 Smithing Stone [4], and x1 Smithing Stone [1]. There is also a corpse in this room, sitting against the wall from where the Golem was standing. You can loot the body to obtain x4 Smithing Stone [5]. Proceed to the opposite side where you'll encounter a Fire Blob.

Continue going straight until you enter another room where you'll spot a body lying on the ground, near the railings. Loot the body to find x7 Smithing Stone [2] and also x1 Smithing Stone [1], x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the floor, near the corpse. Proceed to the next section on the left side of the body, then walk to the end, and climb down the ladder. On this floor, you'll encounter more enemies, some smithing stones, and x2 Gas Stone that you can pick up. From the ladder, if you look to your right, you'll see some shabby stairs. If you check below, you'll find a corpse that can be looted to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [2].

Head up the stairs and you'll find more smithing stones that you can pick up on the ground, including another body that you can loot to acquire Greater Potentate's Cookbook (13). Around the cookbook item, you can also pick up x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. If you look behind, you'll find a broken pillar that you can use to walk on. Reach the other side and walk around the narrow pathway where you should find x3 Smithing Stone [7] that you can pick up from the floor.
Turn around, and jump across to reach the narrow sides of the platform. You should spot another corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow sides. Loot it to acquire x2 Smithing Stone [4].

Go back to the narrow platform and approach the broken pillar that you used to cross, you should find a path that leads to a ladder that you can climb down. On this section, you'll find more smithing stones you can loot, x1 Glass Shard from a body, and a lever that you can pull. Pulling the lever will bring down a large pillar that you can use to cross and reach an upper section of the forge. Next, climb back up the ladder to go back to the previous room, jump down, and proceed west towards a doorway. But before you go through that doorway, look to the left and you'll find another path leading to a dead end. You should find another Golem sitting in front of a corpse that can be looted. This body holds x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Retrace your steps and head to the doorway, towards the next section.

As you enter the next section, you'll spot another body ahead, next to another Golem, and on the right, is another ladder you can climb down. Before climbing down the ladder, kill the Golem enemy and pillage the body nearby to acquire the Smithscript Dagger and a Smithing Stone [4] near it.

Now jump onto the large pipe and walk to the end. Be wary of the Fire Blob that will drop from the ceiling when you're about midway to the top. Look to your right and you'll find a small room with an altar inside. Jump across and interact with the altar to receive x1 Anvil Hammer and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. You can fast travel to the entrance by interacting with the white teleporter that appears next to the altar on the right. Then, teleport to the Castle Front so you can continue exploring the east side of Castle Ensis, leading to Pillar Path Cross - Site of Grace and the Dragon's Pit.

place.title: Ruined Forge Lava Intake
walk: Ruined Forge Lava Intake Video Walkthrough

The Ruined Forge Lava Intake location can be found southeast past the Ellac Greatbridge See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. By the entrance is where you'll find the Ruined Lava Forge Intake Site of Grace. Head down the stairs, turn right, and then climb down the ladder (or jump down). Go forward and turn left into a dead-end room where you'll encounter a Golem Smith enemy. Kill the enemy and then check the floor of this room to find items such as x1 Gas Stone, x1 Smithing Stone [4], and x1 Smithing Stone [1]. There is also a corpse in this room, sitting against the wall from where the Golem was standing. You can loot the body to obtain x4 Smithing Stone [5]. Proceed to the opposite side where you'll encounter a Lava Slime.

Now jump onto the large pipe and walk to the end. Be wary of the Lava Slime that will drop from the ceiling when you're about midway to the top. Look to your right and you'll find a small room with an altar inside. Jump across and interact with the altar to receive x1 Anvil Hammer and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. You can fast travel to the entrance by interacting with the white teleporter that appears next to the altar on the right.

title: Heading to Dragon's Pit
text: NOTE: This section only tells you how to get to Dragon's Pit and where to find important NPCs along the way. We recommend clearing this dungeon later on after you have cleared Cerulean Coast and you're headed to Charo's Hidden Grave.

When you're done exploring Ruined Forge Lava Intake, you will head back outside, then take the path leading south, or teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace and follow the path. On the way, you will encounter some soldiers gathered at a small camp. Eliminate this small group and then pick up the Swift Spear from a corpse next to the wooden barricade.

After this area, stick to the left side and scale the cliff. There's a Site of Grace that you need to activate so you can come back to it later. This is the Pillar Path Cross that overlooks the area below you. You can also pick up a Scadutree Fragment, 2x Empyrean-Blood Burgeon here next to the cross. You will find Thiollier here seated near the ledge. Speak with him and exhaust his dialogues.

The Rivermouth Cave may also be accessed by going through the path behind Thiollier, however, it is recommended to access this area later by traveling from Scadu Altus, head to Rauh Base, and after Temple Town Ruins. This eliminates backtracking and minimizes the long travel time going there; unless you really want to get the rewards of the dungeon early in your playthrough.

ALTERNATE: From the Pillar-Path Cross - Site of Grace, jump down the rocks behind Thiollier's initial location. Head towards the river and then follow the river going north. This will take you to Ellac River Cave - Site of Grace. Then, continue traveling north to reach the entrance to Rivermouth Cave. This alternate path is recommended if you haven't reached Scadu Altus yet and want to get your hands on Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes, a unique ash dropped by the dungeon boss. (See the Scadu Altus tab for the Rivermouth Cave exploration).

Whether or not you choose to clear Rivermouth Cave, you will return to the Pillar Path Waypoint and then return to the dirt path. Continue south until you hear a screaming man. This is Igon, a Drake warrior who is screaming in pain. Make sure to talk to him until you exhaust his dialogues and you will find out that the cause of his pain is a powerful boss. NOTE: Do not kill this NPC. It is important to keep him alive because he will play an important role against this boss later on.

For now, head south and stay on the path. Players have reported that a hostile NPC version of Ancient Dragon-Man appeared here. Keep going until you see the hole to your right with a lit lantern on the ground. Go inside and activate the Dragon's Pit - Site of Grace at the bottom of this section. For now, we don't recommend exploring this dungeon yet. Instead, come back here much later after exploring Cerulean Coast, which is when you're going to Charo's Hidden Grave from the Dragon's Pit.

Dragon's Pit serves as the connector that will let players access Jagged Peak, Grand Altar of the Dragon Communion, and Charo's Hidden Grave. At this point, we don't recommend exploring this area yet so you can progress the story, meet important NPCs, and advance their questlines.
This refers to all NPCs that will be affected when Miquella's charm breaks later on.

place.title: Dragon's Pit
walk: Dragon's Pit is found by following the path southwest nearby Igon, from the Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace. Its entrance is a tight cave marked by torches outside. Once you enter the cave, you will eventually encounter the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace. Continuing through the cave, you will enter a more spacious part that resembles a ritual room. There are skeleton enemies here. Afterward, loot the corpse at the back of the ritual area inside a mini cave to obtain a Smithing Stone [1].

title: Suppressing Pillar
text: Head back outside to locate the Suppressing Pillar. It can be found in the east part of the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Upon arriving, simply enter the pillar to find a lift, ride it to the top, and you'll spot a treasure chest that contains x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. There's nothing much else to do here but you can also find a headstone to read a message that says:
"The very center of the Lands Between.
All manners of Death wash up here, only to be suppressed."

On clear weather, the top of the Suppressing Pillar provides the best preview of all of the regions of the Realm of Shadow. After reaching the Suppressing Pillar, you will again return to the Castle Front - Site of Grace, use up all your Scadutree Fragment and Revered Spirit Ash to get ready to enter Castle Ensis.
See the next tab for the Castle Ensis Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

walk: The Suppressing Pillar is a tall structure where players can find a single item at the top. It can be found in the east part of the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Upon arriving, simply enter the pillar to find a lift, ride it to the top, and you'll spot a treasure chest that contains x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. There's nothing much else to do here but you can also find a headstone to read a message that says:

Castle Ensis is a Minor Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. Castle Ensis is a dungeon exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Castle Ensis can be located north-northeast of the Three Path Cross checkpoint (site of grace). Castle Ensis is a small castle where players can encounter scholars of magic, deadly hounds, noblemen capable of using magical attacks, and soldiers of Messmer.

place.title: Castle Ensis
notes: Notes go here

title: Castle Ensis Entrance
text: After clearing the building, follow the path leading to a staircase heading up. Before heading up the stairs, you can loot a corpse on a cliff on the west side for a Somber Smithing Stone [1]. Then, climb the stairs going up. In the middle of the stairs, you can find a cliff that you can get to, which you can loot a corpse for a Broken Rune. Keep following the stiars going up, and you will encounter a Messmer Soldier along with a Rotten Stray on the right side. On the left side, another Messmer Soldier and a Rotten Stray will be heading down the stairs. Defeat the enemies, then climb up the stairs to get on top of the wall structure. Climb up the ladder in the area, then open the chest to obtain the Milady light greatsword. Afterwards, head back down the stairs then follow the cavern opposite of the stairs.

At the end of the cavern, you will be near the entrance to Castle Ensis. Right at the exit of the cavern, you can loot a corpse for x2 Flight Pinion. Follow the ramp heading up, and you will find two Messmer Soldiers gathering around a fire. Defeat the enemies, then jump down the ledge near the area. You can find a corpse containing x10 Bolt here. Head inside the cavern, and you can loot a dead body hanging by a ledge for x3 Glintslab Firefly. Drop down, and you'll find yourself in the short cavern you were in earlier. Go back outside, then go up the first small ramp.

On the first level of the ramp, you can find the Loyal Knight's Cookbook inside a chest in a room on the left side. Head back outside, then go up the second ramp. You will encounter a Black Knight here, so be prepared for combat. After defeating the Black Knight, head up the second ramp. In the middle of the second ramp, you can find a small opening which leads to a corpse. By the corpse, a Rotten Stray will be waiting around the corner to attack you. Defeat the Rotten Stray, then loot the corpse for a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot. Go up the third ramp, and you'll find a closed gate. On the left side, you can find a Scadutree Fragment and a Castle Cross Message. Nearby, you can activate the Castle Ensis Checkpoint Site of Grace. You can pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [1] on a corpse west of the Site of Grace.

title: Opening the Closed Gate
text: After clearing the right path, follow the path on the left side. Jump on the rocks of the waterfall. After arriving at the top of the waterfall, you'll find a ladder on the left side and a cavern on the right. Go to the right path, then loot the corpse by the entrance of the cavern to get x3 Drawstring Royal Magic Grease. Go inside the cavern, which will be short, and you can loot a corpse for x4 Knot Resin. Head outside the cavern, then go up the ladder. As you enter the room, two Messmer Soldiers will attack you. Defeat the soldiers, then head out the room through the doorway.

The area outside will lead you to the other side of the locked gate you found earlier. Go inside the room across, then push the lever to open the gate. After that, you can head up the stairs to get to a bridge with four Messmer Soldiers. The first three soldiers will use melee, while the one farthest from you will use a heavy crossbow. Clear the bridge, then you can loot a corpse near the bridge for x3 String. Follow the path going south, being careful of a Rotten Stray hiding behind the bush right as the path gets tighter. At the end, you will be on a cliffside path.

Follow the path on the right, and you will face two Noble Sorcerers. On the left, you can loot a corpse for x2 Glintslab Firefly. After defeating the two enemies, you can defeat the third sorcerer by going on the path just right before the staircase which leads to a ladder going up a rampart. Climb the ladder, then defeat the Page you will encounter. Loot a corpse nearby for a Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Afterwards, you can jump on the cliff to defeat the third Noble Sorcerer. Head down to where you came from, then go up the stairs.

At the top of the stairs, you'll be right outside of a structure guarded by an NPC Invader, Moonrithyll, Carian Knight. Moonrithyll drops the Moonrithyll's Knight Sword after defeating her. You can then head inside the chapel. Inside the chapel, you can find a Spirit NPC in front. In front of the spirit, you can pick up Rellana's Cameo. Afterwards, you can head to the hallway near the entrance to the chapel. A Lazuli Sorcerer will attack you as you walk through the hallway. You can obtain a Shadow Realm Rune [2] from a corpse along the hall. You can also find a room containing a Lazuli Sorcerer, which would be a good choice to defeat now so you won't be surrounded by enemies later.

Head out the room, then go around the corner. You will be attacked by another Lazuli Sorcerer hiding by the corner. After defeating the enemy, follow the hallway until you get outside of the structure. Be careful here, as a Noble Sorcerer will be attacking you from the top of a structure. Head up the stairs, picking up the Glintslab Firefly from a corpse on the way, then open the gate on the south side.

title: Scadu Altus
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Scadu Altus
Activate Site of Grace after eliminating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, and exit through the newly-opened gate
Head North and follow the dirt path to activate Highroad Cross - Site of Grace

Exhaust dialogue of nearby NPCs: Leda and Hornsent. Pick up Monk's Missive and Cross Map. (NOTE: You need to return to Three-Path Cross Site of Grace to speak with Redmane Freyja after this interaction)
Pick up Map: Scadu Altus to reveal nearby locations
Defeat Furnace Golem
Take the Larval Tear east of the army camp in front of the Shadow Keep Main Gate. This is located east of the camp in the illuminated gravesite (nighttime only)
Head to Church of the Crusade: Defeat Fire Knight Queelign and obtain the Prayer Room Key

Look for the injured Forager Brood north of the Church of the Crusade. Help the pest by dropping a Warming Stone or Sunwarmth Stone next to it. (NOTE: The Forager Broods are important to Moore and if you harm one of them, Moore will appear as an invader. If Moore dies, all Forager Brood will permanently disappear from your current world and prevents you from collecting the rest of the Cookbooks)
Locate and explore Fog Rift Fort
Reach Moorth Ruins and do Dryleaf Dane's quest there.

Locate the 2 Forager Brood: The first one can be found northwest of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past while the other one is at the northern section of Moorth Highway (the path on the way to Rauh Base)
Explore Moorth Ruins to reach the well that leads to Bonny Village and Bonny Gaol
Discover the Spiritspring near Fort Reprimand and reach Scaduview Cross - Site of Grace
Clear Fort of Reprimand
Complete Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
Explore southeast of Scadu Altus
Visit Whipping Hut

Cross the Bridge to Eastern Scadu Altus: Take note that you will receive a loud notification here about a rune breaking. NOTE: You may have received this notification earlier if you traveled close to the Main Gate of Shadow Keep. It is important to speak with all NPCs before you formally enter Shadow Keep to progress their individual questlines.
Go to Rabbath's Rise and get the Larval Tear west of Rabbath's Rise, you can see the illuminated gravesite (nighttime only) before you formally enter the Cathedral of Manus Metyr
Reach the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and initiate the questlines of Count Ymir and Jolan

After defeating Rellana in Castle Ensis, exit through the newly opened gate. This new area here takes you to Scadu Altus, the second region in the Realm of Shadow. You will meet Needle Knight Leda and Hornsent in this location. While in this area, make sure to activate the Highroad Cross - Site of Grace and pick up the Scadutree Fragment and an Empyrean-Blood Burgeon. Talk to both of them and exhaust their dialogues. Ask Leda about Hornsent and she will tell you about the order that Marika gave to Messmer to cleanse the townsfolk by fire. Then, interacting with Hornsent will give you a Monk's Missive and a Gesture: May the Best Win. He will also give you a New Cross Map which shows additional Miquella's Cross locations drawn.

Head north to pick up the Map: Scadu Altus to navigate easily. Eliminate the Furnace Golem that you will come across outside the Shadow Keep, which is the large building that you can see nearby. The Furnace Golem mostly roams the army campsite found in front of the Shadow Keep's main entrance. It drops x1 Crimsonburst Dried Tear and x1 Furnace Visage, but you can also skip fighting this elite enemy and just continue roaming if you find it too difficult.

Look for the Marika Statue within the encampment outside of Shadow Keep Main Entrance. You will see the statue on the right side of the stonewall while facing north (and the Furnace Golem if it's still alive). You can pick up a Scadutree Fragment here.

title: Church of the Crusade
text: After defeating the Furnace Golem, head west to reach the Church of the Crusade. Go inside and walk down the aisle here and you will be invaded by the Fire Knight Queelign NPC. If this is your 2nd encounter with Queelign, you will receive the Ash of War: Flame Skewer and a Prayer Room Key.
You will encounter the same NPC invader in the following areas:
Belurat Tower Settlement
Shadow Keep

Going back to the Church of the Crusade, On the altar behind the burning pot, make sure to pick up the x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the tall statue of Marika. On your way out, look to your right and pick up Rune Arc next to the toppled pillars.

Outside the church, head northeast and go to the very edge. You will find an injured Forager Brood here who is unable to move. To help it, drop a Warming Stone next to it then wait for it to get up. Rest at a nearby Site of Grace, come back to the location to receive Forager Brood Cookbook (4) and x3 Shadow Sunflower from it.

place.title: Church of the Crusade
walk: You can reach this area by going west after the army encampment in front of the Shadow Keep - Main Gate in Scadu Altus. Go inside and walk down the aisle here and you will be invaded by the Fire Knight Queelign. If this is your 2nd encounter with Queelign, you will receive the Ash of War: Flame Skewer and a Prayer Room Key upon defeating him.

Going back to the Church of the Crusade, walk over to the altar behind the burning pot, and make sure to pick up the x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the tall statue of Marika. On your way out, look to your right and pick up Rune Arc next to the toppled pillars.

title: Fog Rift Fort
text: Fog Rift Fort can be accessed from the Scadu Altus West Grace See Elden Ring Map by dropping down the rocky platforms and landing on one of the fort's towers. Drop down from the tower by jumping or using the ladder, and you'll encounter Messmer Soldiers on top of the fort's walls. Once you take them out, look to your left and you'll see a corpse that you can loot, which has x10 Fire Arrow.

Afterward, follow the path until you reach the second wall tower of the fort. You can find a corpse containing x8 Redflesh Mushroom by the barrels in this room. Head out, and you'll encounter a wooden bridge to your right guarded by six Messmer Soldiers. The wooden bridge leads to a rocky platform with another corpse that you can loot for the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (3).

After looting the corpse on the rocky platform, head back to the wall of the fort by crossing the bridge again and continuing on the path. Turn left to another bridge that leads to a small stone house on the other side, where you'll encounter a boss. For a complete guide on how to beat the boss, check out Black Knight Garrew. This boss drops the Black Steel Greatshield. After slaying the boss, head inside the stone house he emerged from and open the chest, which contains a Smithing Stone [7].

Next, head towards the small opening between the cliff and the left side of the stone house. Drop down on a ledge. Follow the stairs, and climb two sets of ladders to reach the top of a tower with a treasure chest containing the Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman. Drop back down the ladder and jump on the cliff in front of it, then jump down to return to where the boss was. Now, head to the right of the stone house and access a small part of the wall path. You'll encounter two more Messmer Soldiers and find another corpse holding x1 Somber Smithing Stone [2]. Once you've cleared out the walls of the fort, head back to the bridge that connected the wall path and the boss area, then turn left to a wooden platform with a ladder going down. This will lead you to the grounds of the fort where more Messmer Soldiers await you. The first three soldiers you'll encounter are stationed to the left of the ladder near a spike barricade. After taking them out, you'll find a corpse in the middle of the barricade that holds the Messmerfire Grease.

After looting the corpse, be careful when combatting the rest of the soldiers on the ground. Luckily, they are spread out and in the open, so you can take them out one by one using a ranged weapon. These soldiers are also stationed next to fire turrets. There are two fire turrets in front, two on the opposite side of where you are, and one on the right.
Once you've cleared out the ground, head to the opposite side of the ground where you'll find some tents. One of these tents contains a chest with the Serpent Flail.
This is your last stop before heading southeast to travel to Moorth Ruins where you will meet Dryleaf Dane and unlock the area that leads to the eastern Scadu Altus.

place.title: Fog Rift Fort
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Fog Rift Fort Video Walkthrough

title: To Moorth Ruins
text: Return to Highroad Cross - Site of Grace and read the Monk's Missive. From here, head to the path leading to the southeast to Moorth Ruins. You will find Dryleaf Dane here who you will challenge to a fight. He is standing near the Site of Grace and next to Miquella's Cross. To prompt this, use the Gesture: May the Best Win while facing him. He will drop Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat upon defeating him. After this encounter, continue exploring Moorth Ruins by going to the west of Moorth Ruins to locate a camp. Look for the Marika statue and take the Scadutree Fragment in front of it.

Return to Moorth Ruins where you will be fighting phantom enemies and this enemy type can be difficult to see at night. The Moorth Ruins are explored vertically, it will lead to an area deeper into the ground as you jump from one platform to another. Before entering the area below, look for the Shadowpot on the outskirts of Moorth ruins. You will find it near a collapsed building close to a withered tree. Eliminate this enemy to obtain a Scadutree Fragment.

Next, locate the entrance of a collapsed building to the southeast. Then, exit towards the broken roof. You can pick up a Shattered Stone Talisman from a corpse here. See it on the SOTE Elden Ring Map

Continue navigating to the area below you by jumping near the wall. You can summon Torrent here to negate some of the fall damage. At the bottom, you will be fighting 3 Mage enemies and you can take the Golden Arcs from the chest inside the small building. Walk towards the northwest where you see a slanted piece of structure. Jump down the balcony near it and to the ground. You can pick up a Shadow Sunflower from a corpse below the balcony. Then, head to the small cave opening here with a faint ghostflame. At the end of this cave, use the ladder to reach Bonny Village.

place.title: Moorth Ruins
walk: Return to Scadu Altus Site of Grace and read the Monk's Missive. From here, head to the path leading to the southwest to Moorth Ruins. You will find Dryleaf Dane here who you will challenge to a fight. He is standing near the Site of Grace and next to Miquella's Cross. To prompt this, use the Gesture: May the Best Win while facing him. He will drop Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat upon his death. Walk toward the area behind him and you will arrive at Moorth Ruins. You will be fighting phantom enemies here and this enemy type can be difficult to see at night. There are two holes in the area which will lead you through an underground path.
The first hole can be entered through the door of a collapsed building to the southeast. You will find a broken roof, where you can pick up a Shattered Stone Talisman from a corpse.

From the roof you can see the bottom of the ruins, which can be accessed through the second hole. To reach it, return to the building's entrance and walk forward a bit, you should spot an L-shaped building in the distance, which contains another underground path.

In this area you will fight two shadow dogs and find 3x Whiteflesh Mushroom and 2x String. Jumping further down and heading towards the back of the tunnel you will find a Golden Horn Tender, then towards the front of the tunnel you will jump down a ledge where you will se a chest containing Golden Arcs, guarded by 3 Mage enemies who cast Golden Arcs. You will then jump down into a balcony and to the ground. You can pick up a Shadow Sunflower from a corpse below the balcony. Then, head to the small cave opening here with a faint ghostflame. At the end of this cave, use the ladder to reach Bonny Village.

title: Bonny Village
text: Use the Site of Grace after exiting the well in Bonny Village. Look around and you will see multiple jars in the area. This area appears to be filled with them in every corner but they are not alive. You will be fighting Shadow Undead here and encounter a Greater Potentate. You will find Redflesh Mushroom in the area or pick them up after defeating shadow enemies.

Keep heading down the path towards the village, look at the houses on the left side, and pick up the Kukri under a small roof. When you see the broken bridge in front of you, turn around and look at the area to your right. You can pick up the Bonny Butchering Knife from a corpse here.

Make your way to the broken bridge and try to take out the ghost hounds here from a distance. You can also see the loot that they are guarding here. When it's safe, jump down the area and take Human Bone Shard and 2 Living Jar Shard from the corpses. Now, follow the path to the northwest until a figure comes into view. Don't worry, this area is safe. You can pick up the Revered Spirit Ash from this small altar. Now, teleport to the Bonny Village - Site of Grace and jump to the other side of the bridge. Head north past the orange trees here and you can see a corpse in the middle of the open ground. Pick up the O Mother Gesture here. After doing so, go to the bridge south of Bonny Village.

You will find spiked barricades and broken cages on either side of the path. Continue following this path and be careful of the 2 Giant Scorpions that will attack you from either side. Keep an eye out for an opening to the right side of the wall. When you see it, enter the cave to go to Bonny Gaol.

place.title: Bonny Village
walk: Use the Site of Grace after exiting the well. Look around and you will see multiple jars in the area. This area appears to be filled with them in every corner but they are not alive. You will be fighting shadow enemies here and encounter a Greater Potentate. You will find Redflesh Mushroom in the area or pick them up after defeating shadow enemies. Keep heading down the path in the village and look at the houses on the left side and pick up the Kukri under a small roof. When you see the broken bridge in front of you, turn around and look at the area to your right. You can pick up the Bonny Butchering Knife from a corpse here.
notes: Note: crossing the bridge to the east of the village and continuing north will trigger a story event (identical to the one that triggers when approaching Shadow Keep) which may lock you out of certain NPC dialogue and items if their questlines are not progressed far enough.
