Based on the Bonny Village phantom dialogue (near the Whipping Hut), the Tooth Whip found east of the village, the Bonny Butchering Knife, and the multitude of jars littering the village, this place seems to have played a significant role in the Hornsent rituals which involved stuffing Shamans (Queen Marika's kin) into jars to be turned into saints, which resulted in the creation of the Jar Innards monstrosities.

There appears to be the discarded flesh of a giant snake, likely the molten skin of Eiglay the God Devouring Serpent, or possibly Messmer's Base Serpent, near the location of the O Mother Gesture. This is possibly the snake that Queen Marika is seen reaching into, in the Shadow of the Erdtree trailer. None of the lore items elaborate on its placement so the significance of it is unknown.

title: Bonny Gaol
text: Inside the Gaol, you will find jars suspended in the air with chains holding them up. You will be fighting Living Jar, Jar Innards, and other types of enemies down here. Take the path to your right and defeat the first enemy here. Look behind you and enter the small room. Watch out for the hiding enemy to your right here. Then, pick up the Frozen Maggot from the corpse. Exit this room and then go to the area across the room you just entered. You can ignore the room to your right as you can't go to the item right now. Inside the second room, you will see an item on a corpse in the corner. Be careful as you approach this chair because 3 Shadow Undead will attack you. After defeating them, take the Bolt from the corpse.

Open the door to your right and eliminate the single enemy sitting here. Then, go down the hole next to the flaming lantern. You can pick up a Broken Rune as soon as you jump here. As you walk towards the eastern area and enter the small cave. You will be fighting rats and giant rats in this section. After that, go past the wide area and enter through another narrow cave to your right to take the Smithing Stone from a corpse. Return to the path and use the ladder at the end of this narrow cave and as you exit, watch out for the living jar that will attack you. It can extend its innards to shoot a projectile but you can stagger this enemy with a heavy attack. Inside this room, take the Stalwart Horn Charm +2. Then, jump back to the room where you first saw this unreachable item.

Return to the sewer area where you jumped down. You will see an unreachable item in the western area because of the grills blocking the way. Look for the narrow area here and watch out for the slug-like enemies down here. They can be difficult to spot because of their color so listen closely to their sounds. This path will lead to a Broken Rune that you can pick up from a corpse. Then, look behind you to reveal another pathway where you can pick up the Invigorating Cured Meat to your left. Then, go to the right path to jump down to the lower levels of the gaol.

The river will serve as the path here, so follow the stream. To your right, you will fight a Living Jar here. There's also a Broken Rune, the one that you saw from when you first entered Broken Gaol. Fight the next cluster of enemies here near the water and pick up the Warming Stone next to the pillar behind them. Continue following the stream of water until you see an opening at the end. Watch out for hiding enemies here and make sure that you are ready for them. They will come out as soon as you step near an item. Take the Innard Meat on the ground here. Next, defeat the Living Jar next to the door, then look behind you to see a broken jar. An enemy is hiding here and will reveal a Raw Meat Dumpling under them. Go to the next room and exit through the tall archway. This will reveal just how big the Bonny Gaol is.

When you reach the area where you can see broken jails on the wall to your right, you need to watch out for an enemy that will jump at you in the next room. They can drain a chunk of your HP so you need to be ready for them or dodge early to avoid getting damaged. Then, exit through the closed door to the left corner of the room. This will take you to the jar used as a lift that will take you to the depths of the gaol. Jump on top of it and jump to the bridge. Before crossing the bridge, you need to activate the switch on the bridge and then jump on top of the jar again.

Doing this will take you to the top level of Bonny Gaol and you can pick up the Night Set from a corpse. Then, go up the stairs and defeat the Living Jar here blocking the door. Behind it, you can pick up the Shield of Night on the ledge. This time, you can now jump down the lift and cross the bridge. As you reach the other side, watch out for the 2 hiding Living Jars. Take them out as fast as you can and use heavy attacks to stagger them. Then, jump down on the left side of the bridge. Follow the path ahead and get ready for the boss fight.

You will be fighting Curseblade Labirith here, a boss that wields dual blades and can turn himself invisible. You will receive Curseblade Meera upon defeating this boss. You can visit his page for a strategy on how to beat him. After this area, return to the Moorth Highway - Site of Grace. You will clear the rest of the dungeons west of Scadu Altus before crossing to the other side.

place.title: Bonny Gaol
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Bonny Gaol Video Walkthrough

After entering from outside, you'll first encounter the Bonny Gaol site of grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map and a Summoning Pool statue. Proceeding onwards, you'll find yourself at a massive icy cavern, with jars suspended by chains from the ceiling.

Take the path to the right, and a Jar Innards enemy will emerge up ahead and start attacking you. Once you're by the large metal grate where you can see a currently unreachable item, there will be multiple ways to proceed. To the right of the grate, you can enter a room where a Shadow Undead can be heard grovelling. Shadow Undead that are grovelling, kneeling, or sitting at tables don't attack you unless you attack them. Loot the body it was grovelling over for x8 Frozen Maggot, but watch out for the Jar Innards that will crawl out of an overturned jar to attack you.

After exiting the room, you'll see two hanging jars to the left, below the path you're on. Carefully jump down to the lower jar - it's actually a lift that will lower you to an area with two rooms. The closest room leads to a Shadow Undead that will run at you from behind some boxes, and x3 Frozen Maggot around the room that you can loot. Proceed to the second room, but beware the Jar Innards that will run out of the room as you approach. Entering the room, there will be another Jar Innards that will burst out of a jar to attack you, and a Hefty Cracked Pot that you can loot. Jars that Jar Innards can burst out of are always visibly cracked. Return to the ledge near the jar lift, where you can step on a stone sigil to call it back down. Ride the jar lift back up.

Proceed onwards from the original path, ignoring an open room to the right (you'll return here later), and enter a room with multiple cages. There's a Shadow Undead sitting at a table, as well as a corpse with x10 Bolt that you can loot. Be careful as you approach the corpse, as 3 Shadow Undead will lunge at you. Avoid their grab attacks, as they will latch onto you and bite you, and can drain significant amounts of your HP.

Open the door to your left, entering a room with 3 more Shadow Undead - one of them will lunge at you as you proceed onwards. Next to a lit brazier, there's a hole you can jump down which leads to a dark cave. You can pick up a Broken Rune close to where you landed. There are two ways to proceed - east and west. Head east, where you'll encounter multiple Giant Rat enemies. In the wide area with the big Giant Rat, you can enter a narrow cave to the right to take x4 Smithing Stone [2] from a corpse. Return to the path, continuing on until you reach a ladder you can climb up. At the top of the ladder, watch out for a Jar Innards that will burst out of a cracked jar. Before exiting through the hole in the wall, be sure to grab the Stalwart Horn Charm +2 talisman from a nearby corpse. Now, proceed through the hole in the wall, where you'll find a kneeling Shadow Undead and a Frozen Maggot - this is the room you ignored earlier. Exit the room.

Make your way back to the dark cave area that you jumped down to. This time, head west. As you proceed, you'll find an area where multiple Skeletal Slime enemies will drop from the ceiling. If you look around, you'll see that there are 2 paths to take from this area. Feel free to ignore the northwest path, as you'll just end up in a room with more Skeletal Slimes and just one Broken Rune that you can loot. If you take the south path, you'll encounter even more Skeletal Slimes. Just before you jump through the hole in the brick wall, if you turn around and head north, you'll find another Skeletal Slime waiting to drop from the ceiling, and an Invigorating Cured Meat on a corpse. Now, head through the hole to reach a new, lower area of the gaol, with mounds of countless dead bodies.

Follow the water, proceeding onwards until you reach a large area with light coming in from the ceiling. This area has many Living Jar enemies, both large and small. On the right (south) side of the room, there will be a Lost Ashes of War, behind one of the large stone pillars and in front of a large Living Jar soaking in a waterfall. On the left (north) side of the room, there will be a large Living Jar resting, and a corpse by a grate that you can loot a Broken Rune from. In total, there are x4 Frozen Maggot in the area. Once you're done with this area, head to the east end of the room and proceed through an opening into the next area.

There will be an Innard Meat ahead of you that you can loot, but watch out for a Jar Innards that will burst out of a cracked jar hanging above you. As you head to the north side of the room, a Jar Innards will run out from a broken jar. Kill it, and then to the west side of the room, there will be a broken jar that with a Jar Innards that crawls out as you approach it. The broken jar it crawled out of contains a Raw Meat Dumpling. In total, this room contains x3 Frozen Maggot. Heading into the next room, you'll see a Frozen Maggot, as well as a hanging cracked jar containing yet another Jar Innards. Exit the room, where you'll see the large cavern with hanging jars again.

Take the stairs to the left, where you'll see multiple Shadow Undead up ahead. Once you're at the bottom of the stairs, if you turn left, you'll find a corpse in an open cell that you can loot for a Silver Horn Tender. Towards the ledge, there is a Frozen Maggot you can pick up, and 4 Shadow Undead, of which one of them is standing up and will turn to fight you. Opposite to the ledge, there will be another open cell, this time with a Shadow Undead and x3 Frozen Maggot. Just before you enter the next section, there will be another Shadow Undead that will lunge at you. You'll find a Frozen Maggot in the same room. Proceed to a door that you can open to enter a room with 2 Shadow Undead at a table. Upon exiting the room, you'll find yourself at a ledge where a jar is hanging below you. Get on it and it will start lowering, but instead of getting off the jar, stay on it and it will automatically take you all the way up to another area. If you got off the jar by accident and are now on the bridge, there's a sigil nearby that a Shadow Undead is grovelling over, which you can step on to call the jar lift back down.

If you rode the jar lift up, you'll now be at the top level of Bonny Gaol, where you can pick up the Night Set from a corpse by a guillotine, in front of 2 Shadow Undead. Go up the stairs, but watch out for the Jar Innards waiting for you at the top. Behind it, you can find a ledge with a corpse slumped over it, which you can loot the Shield of Night from. Head back to the ledge that you jumped onto to reach this area. There will be a stationary hanging jar below that you can use to safely jump down, to once again reach the jar lift. This time, get off the jar lift at the bottom, to reach a bridge.

Head across the bridge, where you'll encounter a Shadow Undead that runs and cowers from you, and 2 Jar Innards waiting for you in cracked jars. Once you're across the bridge, you can jump down to an area to the northwest. Follow the path ahead, where you'll find x2 Frozen Maggot and one final Jar Innards waiting to ambush you from an open cell. Head down the stairs to where 2 Shadow Undead are walking around. Just before you cross the golden fog, there will be x2 Frozen Maggot nearby, one of which will be around some breakable crates by a ledge.

title: Path to Fort of Reprimand
text: The entrance to Fort of Reprimand will be near the Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace. See Elden Ring Map. Before going through the main entrance of Fort of Reprimand, explore the outer walls on the east side. You will encounter Abductor Virgins in this area. After defeating the two Abductor Virgins, you can find a corpse on the eastern cliff that you can loot for x8 Smithing Stone [6]. Follow the southern wall of the fort, and you can find a Blessing of Marika on a corpse near the cliff. Go back near the main entrance, then head west to the cliff. Traverse through the cliff by going northwest, and you'll find a corpse with a Rune Arc at the end of the cliff.

You will find a sealed Spiritspring here but you can't use it right away. You need to look for the stack of stones by going to the edge of the cliff here. Then, summon Torrent to ride up the plain above you. From there, head southeast to reach the edge and you will find the Scaduview Cross - Site of Grace. You can pick up x1 Scadutree Fragment here next to Miquella's Cross. When you're done here, you can either jump down the Spiritspring, or teleport back to Moorth Ruins to continue exploring Fort of Reprimand.

When you enter through the main entrance of the Fort of Reprimand, you will be in the courtyard where the execution platform is located. There will be an Omenkiller patrolling the courtyard, so be prepared for combat. After defeating the Omenkiller, you are free to explore and loot the area. You can pick up numerous items in the courtyard, such as x8 Throwing Dagger, x2 Broken Rune, x1 Ghost Glovewort [1], x5 Redflesh Mushroom, and x1 Blessed Bone Shard. In the northeastern part of the courtyard, you will find a spot you can jump on to access its basement.

When you drop down, you will find loot such as x1 Shadow Realm Rune (4), x6 Knot Resin, x1 Broken Rune, and x1 Marika's Rune. An Omenkiller will be waiting around the corner near the pile of loot. Defeat the Omenkiller, and it will drop the Iris of Occultation. As you head deeper into the basement, you will find an exit leading to a section behind the fort. You'll find x1 Messmer Soldier Ashes by a gravestone. You'll also find a ladder going up the fort, so use that to go back inside the fort.

After climbing the ladder, you will end up on top of the fort walls. Follow the path to the right, then head left, looting a dead body by the stairs containing x3 Dewgem. To the northwest of the body, you can activate the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. An Omenkiller will be on top of the wall on your right, so be prepared to fight it. After defeating the Omenkiller, you can explore the western side of the Site of Grace, finding x1 Blessed Bone Shard on a dead body on a scaffolding.

Go back to the staircase near the Site of Grace, then go right after the staircase. You will find a dead body with x1 Broken Rune. Go back up the stairs, then to the spot where you dropped earlier. You'll find a room in which you will encounter Black Knight Edreed, who uses a twinblade in combat. He can also use flying attacks to close the distance to you, so be cautious of those attacks. After you have defeated Black Knight Edreed, he will drop the Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings.

Head up the stairs, then climb up the ladder, which leads to the outside. On the southwestern part of the area, climb up the stairs. On top of the tower, you can open a chest to acquire x1 Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [2]. Backtrack your way to the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace.

You will find a path going down near where you dropped. Go down the stairs and keep following the path. You will encounter numerous Common Soldiers in this area, which you can easily kill in a few attacks. In the room as you enter the area, you can pick up x2 Festive Grease from a dead body right beside where two soldiers are. Go through the cages east of the dead body, leading you to a chest that contains x1 Flamedrake Talisman +3. Head west, then southwest to explore the area, entering another room.

In this room, you will find a ladder going down right across the door you just entered. When you go down, you will find four Common Soldiers gathering at the southwestern corner of the room. You can find pick up 7x Smithing Stone [5] on a dead body at the corner where the soldiers were gathering. There will be a chest containing x8 Smithing Stone [6]. On the southeastern part of the room, you can pick up x3 Spiritgrave Stone from a dead body.
Climb back up the stairs, then go through the doorway on the southwest. In this room, you can find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver near the path going to the execution platform in the middle of the fort.

If you want to find the Behind the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, you can access it by heading west of Bonny Gaol See Elden Ring Map and using a Spiritspring to jump over to the fort. The area contains the Site of Grace and a ladder leading to a mere Smithing Stone (8).NOTE: It is possible to access this area by standing on a pillar and doing a running jump towards the crumbled portion of the wall from where an Omenkiller enemy drops down on you.

place.title: Fort of Reprimand
walk: Shadow of the Erdtree Fort of Reprimand Video Walkthrough

title: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
text: Return to Moorth Ruins and travel southwest to The Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. Before you enter the dungeon, make sure to locate the Forager Brood west of the dungeon. This one will give you the Forager Brood Cookbook [1]. Then, you can continue inside the dungeon. Its entrance is a broken-down structure with a small tunnel entrance on the west side. Enter the tunnel and follow it until you reach a ladder that descends further underground. Climb down the ladder to find an abandoned shelter, where the Ruined Forge of Starfall Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map is located.

After setting up the Site of Grace, head immediately to the doorway and you'll find a Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [5], and x5 Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. In the first area, you'll encounter two Misbegotten enemies. One is below the small bridge that connects to the other side of the room, and the other is on the far side of the bridge. Eliminate these enemies and pull the lever on the other side of the bridge, which will open an iron door below the bridge on the left side. Near the lever, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [2]. Before heading down to the iron door, go to the opposite side of the lever to find x1 Smithing Stone [2] and a Smithscript Spear. Drop down from the bridge to take out the Misbegotten below. There's another Smithing Stone [3] and Smithing Stone [2] opposite the iron door. Just beside the iron door on the left, you'll find another Smithing Stone [2] and Smithing Stone [3]. Enter the iron door and immediately hide in a small space to the right. You'll need to take cover here for a few seconds because a Fire Blob will shoot fire projectiles from the other side of the passage.

You can pull the lever in your hiding spot to close the iron door again. Once another projectile crosses, run toward the Fire Blob and take it out. In the next area, there are two levels and another passage to the right leading to another area. From the entrance of the iron passage, go left to grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. A Golem Smith is lurking behind some rubble, so be alert and take it out. To the left of the golem are x2 Smithing Stone [2].

Once you've looted the first level of the second area, go to the other passage on the right. As before, another Fire Blob will be shooting projectiles from the far side. Run to the nearest cover on the right, but be ready to fight, as another Fire Blob will be waiting to ambush you there. Take out the hiding Fire Blob and wait in cover. Left of the Fire Blob, you can find a Smithing Stone [5] and Smithing Stone [6]. There's also a Smithing Stone [3] in the cover area. Wait for a projectile to cross, then run toward the Fire Blob and take it out. Through the second passage, you'll come across a ladder going up to the right. You can find Smithing Stone [2] and Smithing Stone [5] as you traverse through the path. Before heading up, go straight a bit to a small dead-end area and prepare to fight a Golem Smith hiding on the left. This small room contains a Somber Smithing Stone [7] by a skeleton and a Smithing Stone [3].

Afterward, head up the ladder to reach the second level of this area. Follow the path to a room filled with three Fire Blobs and a Golem Smith. There's a Somber Smithing Stone [8] by a corpse on the ground, so pick it up. Head up the broken-down rubble to the left to reach the third level and enter the passage to the right. This will lead you back to the second area you encountered earlier, and you can drop to the second level. Before jumping to the second level, look to the left to see a small dead-end room with a corpse holding the Smithing Talisman. Enter this dead-end room, and a group of Fire Blobs will drop from the ceiling, which you need to take out.

There's a Golem Smith on the right side of the area near the bridge and a Fire Blob on a small platform once you drop down. Once you take out the golem, you can loot the second level of the second area. There's a Smithing Stone [8] by a sitting corpse on the small platform. Crossing the bridge to the other side, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [6] and a Gas Stone. Once you've looted the second level, pull the lever to open another iron door on the left side. Enter the iron door and follow the path to a mid-sized room with two Golem Smiths ready to ambush you—one to the right and one to the left. Once you clear the room, you can loot it to find a Smithing Stone [6] and a Smithscript Cirque by a corpse next to the sewage waterfall.

Do not drop down the sewage waterfall as it will kill you. Instead, head back to the passage that connects the second area and the room with the sewage waterfall. Pull the lever to the left to activate the iron door. Before the iron door rises to close, immediately jump above the iron door. Once it stops, go to the platform on the right to find an entrance to a small room. This room contains an altar that you can interact with to receive the Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
## To the Eastern Region of Scadu Altus

ADDITIONAL INFO: You will notice that if you look at our Shadow of the Erdtree Map, you will see 2 locations beneath this area: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Darklight Catacombs. While these 2 are both part of Scadu Altus, their entrances can only be accessed after exploring an area beneath Shadow Keep. Read Part 1 of Shadow Keep to know the full details of draining the water in the Shadow Keep - Church District and how to reach both optional dungeons and a new area after that.

Going back to Scadu Altus Eastern Region, cross the bridge to the other side and activate the Bridge Leading to the Village - Site of Grace to the right. it was in this location past the bridge when we heard a loud audio cue followed by a notification that a great rune had broken. This significantly adds interactions you will have with NPCs. It is recommended to travel to the various sites of graces to speak with the following NPCs:
Main Gate Cross - Site of Grace: Ansbach and Moore
Three-Path Cross - Site of Grace: Redmane Freyja
Highroad Cross - Site of Grace: Needle Knight Leda and Hornsent
Pillar Path Cross - Site of Grace: Thiollier
Talking to Moore
Moore will ask you "Must we be sad forever?" Your answer here will affect his questline. You have 3 options:
Put it behind you
Remain sad forever
I don't know

If you choose the first one, he will move on from this location and you will encounter him later as an enemy. The second one will prompt him to move to a different location as well. The third option here allows you to come back and talk to him later, however, you can also make this your final choice if you progress too far in the game. This will make him stay at the same location. Regarding Moore's situation, he has a related questline that requires you to help the Forager Brood in the Church of the Crusade to acquire the Forager Brood Cookbook [7] from him. You can read the details of his quest by going to this page.

The other NPC that you need to make a choice with is Needle Knight Leda, she will ask your opinion on who she should go after. During this conversation, we recommend Hornsent so that once you enter Shadow Keep through the Main Gate, you will assist Hornsent to defeat Leda together, and you will get additional rewards.

For the rest of the conversations with other NPCs, you will not have any choices but you need to exhaust all of their dialogues. The others will tell you how they're now beginning to question their choices, and if their decisions were earnest.
After talking to all of the NPCs, you can now return to the Bridge Leading to the Village - Site of Grace that you activated after crossing the bridge in the eastern Scadu Altus.

place.title: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Ruined Forge of Starfall Past Video Walkthrough

The Ruined Forge of Starfall is located southeast of Castle Ensis. Its entrance is a broken-down structure with a small tunnel entrance on the west side. Enter the tunnel and follow it until you reach a ladder that descends further underground. Climb down the ladder to find an abandoned shelter, where the Ruined Forge of Starfall Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map is located.
notes: The last door opened by lever, pull the lever and ride the door up.

title: Whipping Hut
text: The eastern region of Scadu Altus can be accessed through the Bonny Village. Players will find access to this area from the tunnel under Moorth Ruins connecting to the Site of Grace in Bonny Village. Teleport there and head east by crossing the bridge. You will find the Whipping Hut at the edge, and you can pick up the Tooth Whip from the corpse inside the hut. You can also interact with the ghost here just outside the hut.

title: Cathedral of Manus Metyr and Rabbath's Rise
text: Follow the path towards the north where you will reach an area where you will encounter Wolves and a Furnace Golem. Defeating the Furnace Golem here will drop Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage. Continue the path ahead until you pass through Rabbath's Rise. Use the Church of High Road - Site of Grace before continuing. Head east to formally enter Rabbath's Rise here. This is a tower building with some of its steps destroyed. You will also see some glowing crystals on the ground floor.

Go through the door to your left and climb the spiral stairs. When you reach the study room with tall bookshelves lined on the walls, make sure to hit the wall with 2 arches. This is a secret wall hiding a stack of stones. Destroy it to reveal a nearby Spiritspring. You can't use the elevator yet, so you need to go outside the tower and look for the spirit spring. Summon Torrent and ride up the wind to reach the top of the tower. Open the chest to get Rabbath's Cannon. On your way down, you can now use the elevator that was previously stuck.

When you're done exploring Rabbath's Rise, you can now go to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, which is just across the Rabbath's Rise. Activate the Site of Grace and enter through the closed gates. During your interaction with Count Ymir, he will give you 2 items:
Ruins Map
Hole-Laden Necklace

Talk to Swordnight Jolan, who is leaning against a pillar. NOTE: If you can't find her here, try resting at a site of grace and reload the location. She is a servant to Count Ymir and is fiercely loyal to him. For now, there's not much that you can do to progress their quest, except to roam around the area. Head outside through the arch near Jolan which will take you to the grave area. Summon Torrent and jump over the fence to your left to explore the edges of the Cathedral. Beware of skeleton enemies here and make sure to pick up a Glinting Nail on the ground. Continue going around the cathedral and eliminate skeleton enemies as you go. These enemies also drop a piece of their armor and Cuckoo Glintstone.
In the pond area south of the cathedral, you can pick up a Greater Potentate's Cookbook [4] from a corpse. Then, head southeast where you see a broken stone chalice to pick up the Starlight Shards.
See the next tab for the Rauh Base Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

place.title: Rabbath's Rise
walk: The Rabbath's Rise is located in the eastern region of Scadu Altus. You will find it along the path after exploring Bonny Village, an area where you will encounter Wolves and a Furnace Golem. Defeating the Furnace Golem here will drop Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage. Continue the path ahead until you pass through Rabbath's Rise. Activate the Church of High Road - Site of Grace before continuing. Turn right to formally enter Rabbath's Rise here. This is a tower building with some of its steps destroyed. You will also see some glowing crystals on the ground floor.
Summon Torrent and ride up the wind to reach the top of the tower. Open the chest to get Rabbath's Cannon. On your way down, you can now use the elevator that was previously stuck.

title: Rauh Base
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Rauh Base
Travel to Rauh Base from the lake north of Moorth Ruins
Obtain the Map: Rauh Ruins
Go to Northern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Red Bear
Go to Temple Town Ruins
Find the way to Rivermouth Cave (This dungeon is part of Gravesite Plain but can be accessed from Rauh Base)to see alternate route below.
Complete Scorpion River Catacombs
Explore Taylew's Ruined Forge
Explore the vast plain in the northwest
Take the Larval Tear found northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace. Found between the glowing gravestones (nighttime only)
Defeat Rugalea the Great Red Bear (optional)

title: How to Reach Rauh Base from Moorth Ruins
text: This section covers how you can reach Rauh Base by traveling north of Moorth Ruins. There is a lake with glowing worm-like creatures and you need to go through it. You can also pick up Four-Toed Fowl Foot from a nearby corpse here.

As you reach the entrance, make sure to pick up the Scadutree Fragment from the tall Statue of Marika here. There are some enemies inside, a mix of Miranda Sprout and white-cloaked enemies here. It's up to you if you want to fight them or just run through them.

Exit to the right as you reach the small Golden Tree here, and then head outside. Once you reach the poisonous swamp past the golden tree, look for the Forager Brood (pest) along the right cliff edge. You will find it near the Deathbird-infested swamp. Interact with it to receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [5]. Then, exit the west until you get the Rauh Base flash on your screen.

Activate the Ancient Ruins Base Site of Grace as you formally enter this new location. Taylew's Ruined Forge is just northeast of this Site of Grace, but the first thing you need to do is to get the Map: Rauh Ruins so you can navigate easily. You can come back to this location later on.

To get the map, travel southwest where you see 2 Golem Warriors ahead. One is using a bow, while the other one is using an axe. It is recommended to eliminate them before you take the map since they can still attack you from a very long distance. Get rid of the archer first as it's easier to deal with them in close combat. Then, you can take on the other golem warrior. The map is just ahead, next to stone heads past the golem warriors. After acquiring the map, head southwest to locate the access to the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

title: Northern Nameless Mausoleum
text: The Northern Nameless Mausoleum can be reached by heading southwest near the entrance of Temple Town Ruins. Look for a sealed Spiritspring by the base of a sheer cliff to the south of where the Rauh Ruins map was found; the corresponding seal for the Spiritspring can be found to the south of it up a ramp by the side of the cliff Elden Ring Map, break it to unlock the Spiritspring. Jump up the Spiritspring to land on a terrace with another Spiritspring, and use it to reach the very top of the plateau where the Mausoleum is.

Just like any other mausoleum in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC, the location is an arena for a mini-boss encounter against the Red Bear. By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Red Bear page.
Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items:
Iron Rivet Set
Red Bear's Claw

title: Temple Town Ruins
text: The Temple Town Ruins is located near the Gravesite Plain, southeast of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

After clearing the mausoleum, head back to the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, follow the river going east. You will be by the ruins area with Shadowpots scattered around the ruins. Explore the ruins area, and you'll find x4 Rada Fruit on a dead body on top of a collapsed roof. You can also find x1 Revered Spirit Ash on the southern part of the ruins. Afterward, you can head west through the archway to find the graveyard section of the ruins. You can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [8] on a dead body. A Spiritgrave Stone can also be picked up on the western side of the graveyard, by the gravestones on the corner.

To get inside the ruins' structure, you can find a small opening on the southern part of the wall of the enclosed structure. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead, Shadow Pothead and Rotten Strays, so be prepared to face numerous enemies. On the southeastern corner of the ruins, you can find x3 Beast Blood by a collapsed roof, along with x1 Golden Rune [1]. Continue heading north, and you can pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [3] by a wall on the west side beside a Shadow Undead.

Head up the stairs on the east side, then go south to find a Shadow Pothead. Continue heading up the stairs covered by tattered cloth. Go on the northwestern edge of the collapsed roof, then drop down carefully to get to the area under the roof. Once you have successfully dropped down, you'll be in a small room with pots and a Shadow Undead. Go past the archway, and you'll encounter another Shadow Pothead. In this area, you can loot the dead body to obtain a Scadutree Fragment. Exit the structure through where you dropped earlier, then head northwest.

Traverse through the bridge on the northwestern side, picking up x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy along the way. You will encounter a Horned Warrior going down the stairs. After defeating the Horned Warrior, go up the stairs where it was coming down from. A structure will be at the top of the stairs containing a chest. Open the chest to find the Two-Handed Sword Talisman.

place.title: Temple Town Ruins
walk: After activating the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, follow the river going east. You will be by the ruins area with Shadow Pothead enemies scattered around the ruins. Explore the ruins area, and you'll find x4 Rada Fruit on a dead body on top of a collapsed roof. You can also find x1 Revered Spirit Ash on the southern part of the ruins. Afterwards, you can head west through the archway to find the graveyard section of the ruins. You can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [8] on a dead body. A Spiritgrave Stone can also be picked up on the western side of the graveyard, by the gravestones on the corner.

title: Rivermouth Cave Exploration
text: The Rivermouth Cave is an optional dungeon that can be accessed from Temple Town Ruins. This is still part of Gravesite Plain but this is our recommended path after defeating Rellana and unlocking a gate to Scadu Altus. This is the optimal path that minimizes backtracking. To get here, you need to reach Temple Town Ruins and teleport to the Site of Grace. Then, head south and follow the river to your left. Go past the ruins until you see the waterfall and walk over to the cliff. Carefully look down and locate the platforms that you can jump down on to reach the river below. As you reach the bottom, face the north and you will see a waterfall. Walk through the waterfall to reveal a small cave guarded by three hostile spirit eels. In the center of the cave resides the Two-Headed Turtle Talisman.
Continue navigating southwest and stick to the wall on your right side. You will see the entrance to the Rivermouth Cave a few meters from the platform.

ALTERNATE: From the Pillar-Path Cross - Site of Grace, jump down the rocks behind Thiollier's initial location. Head towards the river and then follow the river going north. This will take you to Ellac River Cave and continue traveling north to reach the entrance to Rivermouth Cave. This is an alternate path recommended if you haven't reached Scadu Altus yet.

As you enter Rivermouth Cave, you will immediately discover the Rivermouth Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. If you go to the cavern going east, you will encounter 4 wolves in an area. In the northeast side of the room, you can pillage a body for x2 Hefty Beast Bone.

As you head deeper, the path will fork. The path on the right will have two hostile wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x3 Sliver of Meat. This leads to a dead-end, so return to the path and follow the other path. This path will lead you to an area with an upper level and three wolves.

If you climb up the opening on the east side of the area, you will find a body containing loot. When you get closer to loot the body, the ground will collapse, making you fall. You can then loot the body to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [1]. The path going northwest will be a dead-end, so go down the path east. As you are traversing the eastern path, you can gather x1 Sanguine Amaryllis along the way.

The path will lead you to an area full of Bloodfiends. If you want to go back up, go to the path on your right, and you will encounter a Bloodfiend. After disposing of the enemy, follow the path west going up, in which you will encounter two wolves. Keep following the path, encountering two more wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x1 Sacred Bloody Flesh. Keep following the path, which is going north, and you will be back in the area before you fell.

If you wish to continue, you can clear the area by sneaking up on the ogres and backstabbing them. They are also easy to deal with, as you can kill them in around two hits. If you aggro them all at the same time, you can fight one of them at a time by dragging the enemies away from the area. After clearing them, you can gather a few Sanguine Amaryllis around the edges of the blood pool. On the altar, you can pick up x3 Sacred Bloody Flesh. In the northern corner of the area, near the ramp where you came from, you can pick up x6 Sanguine Amaryllis. There will be a boss fog nearby.

When you enter the boss room, you will be facing the Chief Bloodfiend. It is a more aggressive version of the Bloodfiends that you encountered earlier. It can jump towards you from afar, while also using its club more effectively than the ones you encountered earlier. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat the Chief Bloodfiend, you can go refer to this page. Once you have defeated the Chief Bloodfiend, it will drop x1 Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes. You can find the exit on the southeastern side of the room.

place.title: Rivermouth Cave
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Rivermouth Cave Video Walkthrough

title: Path to Scorpion River Catacombs
text: The Scorpion River Catacombs is located on the far western section of Rauh Base. You can get here by traveling west past Temple Town Ruins where you will come across scarlet-inflicted pest enemies. The path here is dangerous because these enemies can stagger you while riding Torrent. From the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, face the western direction and follow the river that's heading north, then to the west. You can also activate the Ravine North Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map as you are turning left. This is found on an upper section to the right side.

From the site of grace, jump down to the river below you. You will find a Horned Warrior standing in the middle of the water. You can fight it for a chance to get its armor, then, stick to the wall on your left side until you see gravestones come into view. As you reach the end here, you will see a door with 2 Ghostflame lanterns. This is your entrance to the Scorpion River Catacombs.

From the Site of Grace, head straight through the catacombs. In the first room, an Imp enemy will ambush you. Afterward, head left down a short set of stairs towards a large hallway and turn left into a small room. Inside, you'll find a corpse holding x3 Rejuvenating Boluses and two Imps guarding it. Take them out.

Exit the small room and cross the bridge in the middle of the large hallway until you find another set of stairs going down. Follow the path until you reach another large room with two Imp enemies inside. Eliminate them and head down the stairs of the large room. Just below the stairs is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort [3]. Proceed through the tunnel entrance on the same level to find another room with an Imp guarding a plant on the left that gives you Yellow Fulgurbloom. At the other end of the room is another tunnel, but before proceeding, loot the corpse beside the tunnel to get x5 Redflesh Mushroom.

Head down the tunnel and go straight through the tight path, turning right towards another short set of stairs going down. Do not immediately exit the tunnel after turning right. There's a large spike trap that launches from above. Wait for the spike to go down, then immediately run to the right to a small space that keeps you safe from the spike trap. From here, you can either run to the right to get out of the spike area or go to the corpse on the other side that has the Ghost Glovewort [3] and then run to safety after looting it.

Once you're out of the spike trap area, turn left and drop down to another level, but be careful, as there are three Basilisks waiting to attack you. After killing the Basilisks, head through the tunnel on this level to find another corpse on the left, giving you the Shadow Realm Runes [4]. Exit the tunnel, and just to the left, you'll see another Yellow Fulgurbloom.

To the right, you'll find a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and take out an Imp enemy on the edge of the tunnel enjoying the view of the next room. Drop down into the room and loot the corpse on the right for another Ghost Glovewort [5].

Then, head to the left side of the room and up a short set of stairs. Turn left to find yourself back at the spike trap area. Cross the spike trap area again, but instead of dropping down to the Basilisk area, turn right. This leads to an open hallway with Messmer Soldiers inside. Before proceeding toward the Messmer Soldiers, run to a safe space on the right as the first half of the hallway is another spike trap. Once you cross the hallway, take out the two Messmer Soldiers and then the Black Knight with its back turned. After clearing the hallway, loot the corpse on the right near where you fought the Messmer Soldiers to get a Smithing Stone [5]. In the middle of the hallway, where the Black Knight stood, loot the altar to receive the Black Knight Captain Huw spirit.

Afterward, head back to the safe area of the second spike trap and climb the ladder going up. Once you reach the top, wait for the spike trap to go down. Before it goes back up, hop on top of it to reach a secret platform above. Loot the corpse there to get a Ghost Glovewort [6]. Hop on the spike trap again to go back to the level above the ladder.

Cross the bridge to the right, and before heading straight through the other tunnel, turn left and cross the ledge. Hop on the spike trap that goes down on the left to reach another secret platform and loot a corpse for the Imp Head (lion), paying attention to the Basilisk Eyes that active as you approach.

Return to the ledge, but before going back, turn left first to the tunnel here and enter the small room at the end. Kill two Imps guarding a corpse that gives you the Knight's Lightning Spear. Afterward, head back through the tunnel. Before exiting to the ledge area, turn left and go up the stairs to a small area with two Imps. Loot the corpse on the left to get x6 Yellow Fulgurbloom.

Once done looting, drop down near the corpse to find yourself back at the crossing point of the ledge where you crossed the bridge earlier. Go through the tunnel now and take the elevator down. Once you reach the bottom, head straight through the catacomb tunnels until you reach an intersection. Turn right and wait a few seconds for a shadow fireball trap to cross. When the shadow fireball passes and goes back, tail it down a set of stairs. There's climbable rubble up ahead, but first, check if the shadow fireball has crossed. If it has, climb up the rubble and turn right to the first path.

Follow the path until you reach a giant Imp guarding a short set of stairs. Loot the corpse to the right for a Grave Glovewort [4] before taking out the giant Imp. Head down the stairs after defeating the giant Imp and you'll find yourself in another large room. Head straight and loot the corpse and plant for a Yellow Fulgurbloom and a Ghost Glovewort [8]. Then, go down the ladder to the right of the plant and corpse. Once you reach the bottom, loot the corpse to the left for a Great Ghost Glovewort.

Head back up the ladder and turn left through another tunnel and head up the stairs. At the top, peek first because there are two Shadow Fireballs that will cross. Wait for them to pass above you and then run across the bridge. You can stop in the middle of the bridge and drop down to the left onto a small area to get a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant.

At the other end of this place, where you dropped down, is a ladder going up. Climb up to find a small room with some Imps and a chest containing the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [2]. Afterward, from the ladder, turn left through a tight tunnel that leads to the second level of a previous area. Loot the corpse on the right for x2 Rejuvenating Boluses.

Turn left towards another tunnel with a corpse containing a Broken Rune and a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant on the right. To the left of the tunnel is a drop-down path back to where the Shadow Fireball trap of the bridge you dropped down from earlier was. Cross the bridge completely and turn right at the end. There's another elevator here that goes down. At the bottom, walk straight to find a yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss battle. This boss drops the Death Knight's Longhaft Axe and Cerulean Amber Medallion +3.

place.title: Scorpion River Catacombs
walk: Scorpion River Catacombs Full Video Walkthrough

First you must reach Rauh Base, which is found by take the path north of Moorth Ruins in Scadu Altus- explore east until you find a small pond and go through the ravine, then follow the cave to a swamp, past some gravebirds, and you'll emerge in Rauh Base. From here, go west to Temple Town Ruins, and from there you must follow the way north and west, past pests and scorpions. The exact location is shown on the Elden Ring Map here.

Exit the small room and quickly cross the bridge (there is a basilisk statue that causes constant Death Blight build up while in its line of sight) in the middle of the large hallway until you find another set of stairs going down. Follow the path until you reach another large room with two Imp enemies inside.

Eliminate them and head down the stairs of the large room. Just below the stairs is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort (3). Proceed through the tunnel entrance on the same level to find another room with an Imp guarding a plant on the left that gives you Yellow Fulgurbloom. At the other end of the room is another tunnel, but before proceeding, loot the corpse beside the tunnel to get x5 Redflesh Mushroom.

Turn left towards another tunnel with a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant on the right. To the left of the tunnel is a drop-down path back to where the Shadow Fireball trap of the bridge you dropped down from earlier was. Cross the bridge completely and turn right at the end. There's another elevator here that goes down. At the bottom, walk straight to find a yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss battle. This boss drops the Death Knight's Longhaft Axe and Cerulean Amber Medallion +3.

title: Taylew's Ruined Forge
text: After clearing Scorpion River Catacombs, return to Ancient Ruins Base - Site of Grace and head north. You will come across enemies here and at the end, you will find the entrance with lit lanterns on each side. To proceed, head to the next area by heading through the nearest tunnel. You will eventually see a balcony where you can see stored lava underneath the ruins. Near your location, there's a dead body and upon looting it, receive a Shadow Realm Rune [3]. Follow the hallway and eventually, you will come across a ladder and use it to reach the lower part of the area. Follow the hallway and you will eventually come across debris and broken stone floorings that should be able to cross by jumping.

To proceed, follow the hallway and find a stone golem. Note that this enemy is resilient to physical attacks and has a lot of health. However, it is rather slow so plan your attacks and stance and break the said golem until it dies. After beating the Stone Golem, get the nearest loot which is the Smithscript Axe. Continue progressing in the dungeon by exiting back from where you came from and this time, access the lower parts by jumping into the broken part of the hallway.

Follow the hallway and you will eventually reach a long stone pillar that extends to the lava area underneath you and also extends to the upper part of the area. But first, access the adjacent area from where you are. You will come across another lava slime. Defeat and behind it, there is loot near the broken statue which contains the Smithscript Greathammer. Proceed by heading back to the stone pillar and this time head to the upper area by accessing the upper part of the stone pillar.

You will eventually notice that there are two platforms that you can jump off to. Access the one on the left and you will come to access two Stone Golems. This encounter will be challenging as both so proceed with caution. One thing to note is, that there's a red stone located at the back of these golems and these are the weak spots of these entities.

After defeating both of the golems, head to the nearest balcony where a dead body lies. Loot the body and get an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Head back to the area where you fought the two Stone Golem, loot another dead body, and receive x5 Smithing Stone [4].

To proceed, head back to the stone pillar and use it to get across to the adjacent platform. There are three directions that you can head from here. However, we suggest heading to the lower area by jumping from the platform you are in right now.

You are in the correct area if you landed in Lava Slimes. Follow the hallway and there's a nearby dead body that you can loot. It contains a x3 Smithing Stone [8]. Proceed by heading to the other hallway near the location where a ladder that you can access. Use the ladder to proceed.

After the ladder, you will be greeted with Lava Slimes. Take them out and notice that there's another area or platform where you can jump off too. However, a Lava Slime and another Stone Golem are waiting on the other side.

Take these enemies out and there is another dead body which you can loot. Loot it and get a x1 Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Head to the other hallway near the ladder and find yourself on another balcony. There's a nearby lever that you can interact with. Pull the lever and notice that the stone pillar will change its position so you can access the other side of the area.

To proceed, notice that there's another chained ironed platform that you can jump off to be able to return and access the pillar. But before heading to the stone pillar, notice that there's another hallway near which leads to a dead end.

There's another dead body that you can loot which contains x1 Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Head back to the previous hallway and this time, head to the other hallway which leads to a room filled with Stone Golems and Lava Slimes. You are in the right area if you notice the Elite Stone Golem that has some kind of burning ember on its head.

Deal with this enemy first and try to lure it from the pack. Be careful though as it can throw lavas at you by using the said ember. After dealing with all the enemies around this area, notice that there is debris that you can use to reach the upper area. Once you reach the upper area, notice that there's an important item to loot.

Loot the said item and receive an x1 Smithscript Shield. We are about to reach the end of this dungeon and proceed by heading back to the Stone Pillar and you will notice there's another area that you can reach on the left while climbing the stone pillar.
Reach the said area and notice that there's a ladder that you can take to proceed. Do so and you will find an altar near your location.

Interact with this Altar and you will receive the following, x1 Taylew the Golem Smith and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. This is the end of the dungeon and access the teleporter so you can exit the dungeon. This is your last dungeon exploration in Rauh Base. If you have been following this walkthrough, you will now be heading to Shadow Keep to clear the Church District. You can teleport to the Church District Highroad - Site of Grace near the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.
IMPORTANT: This is another reminder to speak with all NPCs before you enter Shadow Keep, after you receive the loud notification that a rune has been broken, and a powerful charm too.
See the next tab for the Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base) Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

place.title: Taylew's Ruined Forge
walk: Taylew's Ruined Forge Full Walkthrough Video

Taylew's Ruined Forge is one of the latest optional dungeons in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree. Just like the other optional dungeons, it is crawling with interesting items to collect. Starting from the entrance of Taylew's Ruined Forge where the Site of Grace is located. Players can progress in the dungeon by heading through the inner section of it. However, if you haven't found the dungeon yet, click the link here so the interactive map will be able to guide you and find the location of the dungeon.

To proceed, head to the next area by heading through the nearest tunnel. You will eventually see a balcony where you can see stored lava underneath the ruins. Near your location, there's a dead body and upon looting it, receive a Shadow Realm Rune (3). Follow the hallway and eventually, you will come across a ladder and use it to reach the lower part of the area. Follow the hallway and you will eventually come across debris and broken stone floorings that should be able to cross by jumping. You will also notice that this dungeon is part of Scadu Altus.

To proceed, follow the hallway and find a Golem Smith. Note that this enemy is resilient to physical attacks and has a lot of health. However, it is rather slow so plan your attacks and stance and break the said golem until it dies. After beating the Golem Smith, get the nearest loot which is the Smithscript Axe. Continue progressing in the dungeon by exiting back from where you came from and this time, access the lower parts by jumping into the broken part of the hallway.

region: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
title: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Part 1 of Shadow Keep - Church District and Scadutree Base. This section covers the Church District including draining the water in the Shadow Keep and defeating the Scadutree Avatar.
Teleport to Church District Highroad - Site of Grace
Look for the Forager Brood just outside the entrance of the Church District - Shadow Keep
IMPORTANT: Talk to all NPCs and travel to their respective Site of Graces before you enter the Church District
Enter Shadow Keep through the Church District Entrance
Use the Prayer Room Key (from Church of the Crusade) to speak with Fire Knight Queelign: Give him Iris of Grace or Iris of Occultation.
Drain the water using the lever
Reach Sunken Chapel
Fight the lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit to activate the elevator and unlock the shortcut back to Church District Entrance - Site of Grace
Reach Tree Worship Passage - Site of Grace and then, reach Tree Worship Sanctum - Site of Grace
Defeat Scadutree Avatar
Activate Scadutree Base - Site of Grace after defeating Scadutree Avatar
Teleport back to Sunken Chapel Grace
Take the big, round elevator to Specimen Storehouse
Make your way to the Storehouse, Loft - Site of Grace
Reach Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace (you will use this later to progress a questline and to explore Scaduview (Hinterlands).

IMPORTANT: To avoid breaking NPC questlines, make sure to follow this walkthrough and avoid entering the room of this legacy dungeon's main boss. Accidentally entering its room will lead to the cancellation of the Hornsent-Leda questline. Before entering Shadow Keep, make sure to speak with all NPCs, after you get the notification that a great rune has been broken. You will get additional dialogues from affected NPCs, and talking with them will progress their questlines.

From the Church District Highroad - Site of Grace, travel towards the entrance and look for the pest found west of the nearest Site of Grace on top of the tunnel road. Head to the cliff edge and seek the pest near the outer wall of the keep. Interact with it to receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [6]. The main entrance of the Church District of the Shadow Keep is located on the east side of the Shadow Keep. The direct path to finding it is to travel from the Church District High Road Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. You'll know you'll arrive when you enter a large doorway and pass through a long hallway. At the end of the hallway is where you'll formally arrive at the church district and discover the Church District Entrance checkpoint [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

The Church District is a flooded area, and the goal is to traverse the area by using high ground and finding a mechanism that drains the water. Please take note that falling into the water will result in death. Ignore the path on the left since you won't be able to use the lift until you drain the flood. Instead, jump across (using a running jump) to land on the roof of a building, then check the right side to find a small Crab and a body next to it that can be looted to acquire x2 Crab Eggs. Continue walking around the roof to find another body that's being eaten by a Crab. Loot the body to obtain x4 Thin Beast Bones. Continue south and you'll find another body being eaten by a Crab, check the body to find x2 Strip of White Flesh.

Next, jump on the floating log to reach a large broken-up circular platform. The path here is fairly straightforward, try to reach the opposite end by using the floating logs and wooden platforms, and make sure to loot the body on the circular platform to find x1 Great Grave Glovewort. Retrace your steps to the rooftop of the building where you looted bodies and killed the small Crabs, and this time, head west where you can jump across to progress (see the second image above for reference).

Once you're across, walk around the sides to reach the platform and loot the body that is guarded by Ignited Putrid Corpse enemies to obtain x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump back onto the sides of this building so you can walk to the top and proceed west where you'll have to do a running jump to safely land on top of another roof of a building. On the roof of the building, you should encounter a Fire Knight enemy walking around. Kill it and then loot the body that's near the spot where the Fire Knight enemy was walking to obtain x3 Ember of Messmer. Keep going straight until you reach a wall, then turn around to find a body sitting against one of the roof's structures. Loot it to acquire x1 Slumbering Egg [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

place.title: Shadow Keep
walk: ## Storehouse, Back Section

If you look over the railings from the Back Section Site of Grace, you can safely jump onto the bookcases and drop to the First Floor Site of Grace. This lets you explore the rest of Shadow Keep without the need to fight the Golden Hippopotamus that guards the Main Plaza.
## Summon Signs

If you interact with the red sign, you will be summoned to assist Needle Knight Leda in defeating Hornsent - This will reward you with the Hornsent Set along with the curved sword Falx. If you interact with the yellow sign, you will be summoned to assist Hornsent in defeating Needle Knight Leda - This will reward you with the Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune.
You can also opt to ignore both summon signs, and Leda's sidequest will only advance after you've defeated Messmer at the top of Shadow Keep.
## More Loot Detour

After you have arrived at the bottom of the ladder, follow the path going northwest until you come across with a dead body that has x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8]. Go back to the waterfall you passed through earlier, then go inside of the passageway behind it. Follow the path, then go down the ladder. Once you are at the bottom, go east to find a room with a painting. Pick it up, and you will receive the Domain of Dragons Painting.
notes: Notes go here

region: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
title: THE PRAYER ROOM: FIRE KNIGHT QUEELIGN
text: Next, face the east side of the compass and you should see a narrow ramp structure of one of the churches. Do a running jump to land on it safely, then walk to the top where you'll find two large openings or holes on the big roof. Slowly drop down onto the narrow structure that's on the right side, then you can walk down so you can safely run onto the other structure that is on the left so you can loot the body that holds x3 Stormhawk Feathers [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Go back and then drop down onto the opening of a ceiling (see the third image above for reference).

Below, you should immediately see yet another corpse next to a small Crab. Loot the body to find x1 Lightningproof Pickled Liver. Go around, northeast, and you'll locate a locked door, this is the Prayer Room that requires the Prayer Room Key, a key that drops upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign, encountered for the second time at the Church of the Crusade [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. If you have the key, you can unlock the door and find Fire Knight Queelign (NPC) in the flesh. Now, if you have an item called the Iris of Occultation, you can give it to the NPC, and after Queelign's dialogue, the NPC will drop a weapon you can loot. This weapon is Queelign's Greatsword. NOTE: If you give the Iris of Grace to Queelign, you'll receive the Spirit Ash "Fire Knight Queelign". The Iris of Occultation can be acquired in many ways, one way is by obtaining it as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood.

region: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
title: THE FLOODED CHURCH DISTRICT: DRAINING THE FLOOD
text: Exit the prayer room and proceed to the northwest doorway, but before proceeding further, be sure to enter the armory room on the left to find a body sitting against the wall. Loot the body to find x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero. Enter the hallway and kill the first Fire Knight enemy that you see, on the left side of the hallway, loot the body resting against the wall to find x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and continue straight down the hallway where you'll encounter another Fire Knight. The room ahead is not accessible at the moment and the doorway to the right where you'll notice Marika's statue that has a glowing item in its hand is unreachable, so exit through the first doorway on the left side of the hallway.

NOTE: In the same hallway, there are two doorways on the left, the far most or second doorway will lead you to a lift that takes you to the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep. You're free to roam here, but we highly recommend returning to the Specimen Storehouse after clearing the Main Plaza and Church District of the Shadow Keep. What you can do is enter the Specimen Storehouse, and activate the nearby Site of Grace (Storehouse, Back Section) so you can just fast travel here after exploring the Church District.

Cross the pathway where you'll encounter two Giant Bat enemies, then walk up to the short steps where you'll encounter another Giant Bat ahead. Jump over the gap, and kill the creature. Now before going straight, walk up a bit and you'll find a corner on the right. It's a dead end but there's a body that you can loot that's being protected by another Giant Bat hanging from the ceiling. Kill the enemy and loot the body to acquire x3 Hefty Beast Bone [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Next, climb the ladder next to a doorway to find the mechanism that drains the water.

You can also return to the hallway to get the item sitting on the hand of Marika's statue. You can get the item by jumping on the hand, it may require a few tries as the platform that you need to stand on is quite narrow. Loot the item to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment, then prepare to fight a group of Ignited Putrid Corpse as you jump down. Behind the same statue, you can find the Fire Knight's Seal weapon [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]

region: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
title: EXPLORING THE SUNKEN CHAPEL
text: For some clarity, we recommend that you start by fast-traveling to the Church District Entrance checkpoint [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]] since you can now use the lift near the Site of Grace. From the checkpoint, go left, use the lever to call the lift, then step on the center to ride it down. You'll now be able to explore the open area of the Sunken Chapel. At the center, you will see a large tree, only approach the tree if you're prepared to fight because a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit will emerge beneath the ground. Killing it will drop the Mantle of Thorns, and resting against the tree is a corpse holding x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5].

The second Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit is located around the east area of the sunken chapel (see the images above for reference). Defeating it will drop x1 Iris of Occultation which (if you don't have it yet) you can give to Fire Knight Queelign (see here) in the Prayer Room to obtain Queelign's Greatsword. Also in the east area, you can find open buildings. One building houses two bodies that you can loot to find x4 Smithing Stone [4] and x6 Kukri [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

There is also building another where you'll find a pack of Crabs and Giant Crab enemies, one roaming around, and the other next to another body that you can loot to find x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5]. [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. If you continue to go around this area, you'll reach the west side where you'll find the Sunken Chapel Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]

Head north towards the entrance of the main church then immediately turn left to find a corpse by a corner. Loot the body to find x3 Shadow Sunflower. Clear out the enemies then approach the small room that has Marika's statue (the same statue where you got the Scadutree Fragment and the Fire Knight's Seal weapon. Make a right and you'll enter a large room. Straight ahead, you'll see some stairs on both ends, walk up to the upper platform and investigate the railings to discover a body hanging on top of it.

Loot the body to obtain the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1], [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Walk back down the stairs and check under the upper platform to find a door. Open that door and you'll find another lift that takes you underground. Ride it to find and activate the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

region: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
title: SCADUTREE AVATAR
text: After activating the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace, follow the path going down, then cross the bridge. Enter the structure through the archway, and you'll find the Iris of Grace (you can give this to Fire Knight Queelign, see here) if you still haven't obtained it. Go down the stairs on either side, and you can activate the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. South of the Site of Grace, you can find x1 Marika's Rune on a corpse sitting against the wall.

North of the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace, you can go through the boss fog to fight the Scadutree Avatar at the Scadutree Base. The Scadutree Avatar uses its tree trunk-like arms to attack. It has different attacks, such as uprooting thorns over an area. There is a dedicated page here containing information on how to defeat the Scadutree Avatar.

After defeating the Scadutree Avatar, you will receive the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower along with Miquella's Great Rune. From here, (if you followed the tip earlier by activating the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint in the Specimen Storehouse) you can fast travel to the Storehouse, Back Section Site of Grace to start exploring the Back Section of the Specimen Storehouse.

Upon entering, look to the right immediately to see a noble corpse against the wall. Loot it to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [9]. Proceed to the left side, through the doorway, where you'll find the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint. Continue moving straight until you walk past a ladder. Do not climb the ladder first, instead, keep going straight to find some items. First, look to your left to see, another noble corpse sitting against a desk, loot it to obtain x3 Glintslab Firefly. Then at the end, you'll see a Fire Knight and three Shadow Undead standing next to another corpse, kill the enemies then loot the body to acquire x1 Carian Thrusting Shield.

Go back and climb the ladder to the top where you'll encounter another Fire Knight and two Shadow Undead reading a book. You can sneak behind the enemies to backstab them. Continue to the right side and walk carefully up the stairs to avoid aggravating the Fire Knight, roaming the floor above. At the top of the stairs, turn to the corner on the right to find a corpse to loot x3 Fire Coil. Kill the enemies on this floor, then continue moving straight. You'll discover another noble corpse sitting against a small table, loot it to obtain x4 Rada Fruit, and go straight towards the balcony to find another noble corpse that holds the Fire Serpent incantation. Go back, and look behind the bookcase to find an opening on the wall.

Through the opening, turn right and you'll find another noble corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow scaffolding. Loot the body to acquire x6 Shadow Sunflower. Continue going up, and by the ramp, you should find another noble corpse that you can loot to obtain x1 Blessed Bone Shard. Continue going up and you'll arrive at the loft section of the storehouse. Activate the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace before you proceed to explore.

region: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
title: STOREHOUSE, LOFT
text: Once you have activated the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace, proceed to the lift north of the Site of Grace to go up. You will end up on beams above the Specimen Storehouse. This level will be filled with Giant Bats roaming the area. The only path you can follow will be the one going west, so keep following it. There will be a lot of ways you can walk on the beams, but the only way you can progress through this area is through the ladder. Pick up x7 Thin Beast Bones from a body at the edge of a beam, then go up the ladder that you walk past through just before picking up the loot.

After climbing the ladder, you will arrive in a new level. If you go to the southeast section of the level, you can find x4 Smithing Stone [7] from a dead body. Following the path from the south side will lead you to a pillar blocking your way. If you look down, you can find a platform that you can jump off of, and it will contain the Wrath from Afar incantation. Next, jump on the beam to the north, then climb up the nearby ladder to the west of where you landed. You will end up on the beam that a pillar was blocking earlier. You can aggro the bats here, so be careful when attacking as you might fall off of the beams.
You can find a lift in the middle of the beam going west with an item above it, along with a Fire Knight on a nearby beam which will be hostile if you approach the lift.

If you use the lift to go down, you will end up in an area with a Fire Knight facing the other way around. You can easily dispose of the Fire Knight by backstabbing it and staggering it continuously. After dealing with the Fire Knight, you can pick up x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero on the southwestern corner of the area. The area will be clear, and you can head back up the beams using the lift. If you want to get the item above, you can ride the lift, then exit it before going down. A second lift will arrive just beside it, then do it again. Jump on the roof of the first lift just as it is arriving, and you will be able to reach the item, which is a Fire Knight Hilde summon.

If you walk across the beam going west, you can climb down a ladder. On your left, just around the corner, you can loot a body for x4 Rada Fruit. Directly northeast of the ladder you descended on, you will find another ladder you can use to descend. You will reach an area similar to the Site of Grace.

If you head outside the archway on the northwestern side of the area, you will find a lift directly on your right. Take the lift going down, then keep following the scaffolding until you reach an area with a door and a lift. You cannot open the door yet, so use the lift nearby to go down. The lift will then lead you to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

This area leads you into two areas. There is a room on the east, just beside the Site of Grace. In this room, you can pick up x1 Scadutree Fragment. After that, you will see an archway heading outside on the north-northeast side of the room. This is a boss area in which you will be fighting Commander Gaius. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Commander Gaius, you may go to this page.

Defeating Commander Gaius will give you the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider. It will also give access to Scaduview region. We don't recommend fighting him right away, instead, make your way to the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) to minimize backtracking. This covers the Church District part of your Shadow Keep exploration.
See the next tab for the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Cerulean Coast/Southern Shore
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Southern Shore (First Entrance)
Travel from Ellac River Downstream - Site of Grace in Gravesite Plain and navigate the path to Cerulean Coast
Look for the Forager Brood to receive the Cookbook. This one is located Northeast of the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace
Reach Cerulean Coast
Fight Ghostflame Dragon
Reach Southern Shore
Pick up Map: Southern Shore
Explore Stone Coffin Fissure
Summon Thiollier to fight the Putrescent Knight
Defeat Putrescent Knight
Reach Garden of Deep Purple
Progress Thiollier and St. Trina's Questline
Reach Southern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Dancer of Ranah
Make your way to Finger Ruins of Rhia by following the path in Eastern Coast
Progress Count Ymir and Jolan's Questline (Please see the Finger Ruins Walkthrough Tab)

title: Exploring Cerulean Coast
text: Teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace (this is in front of Castle Ensis). Face south, then turn left on the first dirt path. Stay on this path until a small encampment near the river comes into view. Head towards them and remain on this new dirt path. As you see the Bloodfiends and Messmer soldiers fighting, turn left again, to head towards the river. Continue down here until you get to the toxic swamp and then remain on the left side. Watch out for the Miranda Sprout of varying sizes here.

Go past the swamp and keep heading west. Keep to the left side and then jump down on the river where you see the giant Miranda Sprout. Go through the narrow entryway next to it. Once you are inside the cave, turn left, and another left until you see the site of grace. Activate the Ellac River Cave - Site of Grace before proceeding so you have a checkpoint. Next, jump down the rocks while facing south. Be careful on your way down here because you can fall off and result in an instant death. Follow the stream of the waterfall here and take your time jumping down between the stone pillars.

Once you reach the lower level, you will find gravebirds on top of pillars as you're heading south. Go through them and ride as fast as you can while sprinting with Torrent. After this area, you will jump between stone pillars again, so you need to be careful here. As you reach another lower area, you can activate another Site of Grace, the Ellac River Downstream.

Continue heading south and jump down the rocks on the right side. As you reach the lower level, you will see a giant stone pillar on your left. Cross to the other side using it as a bridge. This will take you to the ground level and you're now close to reaching Cerulean Coast. Continue riding south and go past the creatures here. As the Furnace Golem comes into view, switch to the area on the right side and remain there. It's up to you if you want this Furnace Golem, but we recommend on getting the Site of Grace first, then backtrack here to fight it later.

Continue riding south and hug this area on your right until you come across a big gap in the wall. Go through it and you will enter an area of blue flowers. You can now activate the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace directly ahead of you. Then, you can backtrack to the area where you saw the Furnace Golem. You can also locate the Forager Brood near the forest of lightning rams here. You will receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [3] from it.
